npc.aaronbrownbark.first: What is it that you want?
npc.aaronbrownbark.returning: You have come back. What can I do for you?
npc.adriana.book.gone: Where is the Book of Warfare?
npc.adriana.book.missing: I hear it is fascinating, but I have no copy to spare.
npc.adriana.book.no: Ah well. It was worth asking.
npc.adriana.book.offer: You have a Book of Warfare? Would you trade it for a Blade of Sharpness?
npc.adriana.book.yes: Great! Here is your blade. Thanks!
npc.aedenas.books.need: Those books come in series of five. Bring me a complete series for a Ring of the Lion.
npc.aedenas.books.ok: Let us do this trade quickly, then. Here is your Ring of the Lion.
npc.aedenas.return: Greetings. It is nice to see that you have safely returned from your journey.
npc.aedenas.warning: You have served us well. Seek Anrak and ask him about the Drums of Fate.
npc.aedenas.welcome: What brings you into my royal presence?
npc.aedenas.will: Your final task is to seek Glaenshenmilandira, the white-winged Seraph who can combine the items into the Will of Artherk.
npc.aloysius.disturbance: I sense a disturbance in the magic flow. It appears to come from the north.
npc.aloysius.gold: You do not have enough gold.
npc.aloysius.magushunt.again: You defeated that vile arch mage again. Take this ring of confidence.
npc.aloysius.magushunt.reward: You defeated the orcish arch mage. Take this platinum ring and 25000 experience points.
npc.aloysius.ring.info: The platinum ring is an enchanted steel ring.
npc.aloysius.ring.offer: You lost the precious ring. I can sell another for 50000 gold. Do we have a deal?
npc.aloysius.ring.sold: That is a deal. This is the last ring I will give you.
npc.aloysius.scroll: There are many scrolls in this world, my friend.
npc.aloysius.scroll.destroyed: This note is falsified. It crumbles into dust.
npc.aloysius.welcome: You appear to be lost. Perhaps I can assist you.
npc.amandra.no: How do you know I have a brother? Do not anger me.
npc.amandra.sword.fake: Have you brought the sword? Is this truly the sword you bought from Kiadus?
npc.amandra.sword.lie: This is nothing but a fake. Your task is not over.
npc.amandra.sword.missing: Have you brought the sword? Go buy it from Kiadus.
npc.amandra.sword.no: This sword is a fake. Do not let my brother escape with the real one.
npc.amandra.sword.search: Find my brother and retrieve the true Blade of Ruin.
npc.amandra.sword.start: Your brother sold a sword to Kiadus? Go back and buy that sword, whatever the cost.
npc.amelia.progress.21: Please don't "kill" me! I didn't see anything!
npc.amelia.progress.22: Have you found the High Priest yet? You must hurry and help him!
npc.amelia.progress.before42: I heard about what you did for the High Priest... that was very brave of you.
npc.amelia.progress.complete: Thank you for everything you did for us. I wish you good luck on your adventures, brave hero!
npc.amelia.unavailable: I... I don't feel like talking about that right now.
npc.annabelle.heal.message: Some of your wounds have been healed!
npc.annithae.day: Hello there. What can I do for you?
npc.annithae.night: A peculiar time to come knocking at my door... What are you doing still up at this time of the night?
npc.annithae.pearl.done: Thank you, here is your tear-shaped pearl.
npc.annithae.pearl.no: That is too bad. Come back if you ever change your mind.
npc.annithae.pearl.poor: I'm afraid you do not have enough gold.
npc.anrak.drums.complete: Done! You are the proud owner of a brand new Drum of Fate!
npc.anrak.drums.denied: I do not think you need a Drum of Fate.
npc.anrak.drums.done: I have already given you the two Drums of Fate that you need.
npc.anrak.drums.missing: You still lack the required components.
npc.anrak.drums.no: Come back if you ever change your mind.

npc.antonian.direction.1: Travel north and search the river until you find the first nexus stone.
npc.antonian.direction.2: Follow the southern road, then cross the bridge to find the next nexus stone.
npc.antonian.direction.3: Follow the southwest road across the bridge, then head south into the valley.
npc.antonian.direction.4: Follow the river west to the ocean; the nexus stone is beside the shore.
npc.antonian.direction.5: The final nexus stone is at the southernmost point of this island.
npc.antonian.direction.done: Use the Runed Stone Tablet to travel to Raven's Dust, then seek Aquinos in Silversky.
npc.antonian.direction.doneLocked: You found all the nexus stones, but you still have things to accomplish on Arakas.
npc.antonian.directions.no: Well then, what did you want?
npc.antonian.name: I am Antonian.
npc.antonian.progress.26: Hello young one. What brings you to see an old hermit such as myself? Oh! You have a Runed Stone Tablet! Did Tarnian Wolfmane give this to you?
npc.antonian.progress.27: Oh, it is you again. Are you here for some directions to a nexus stone?

npc.delilah.curse.present: It appears you bear Balork's Brand.
npc.delilah.curse.removed: Your curse is lifted. You are free again.
npc.delilah.cuthana: Oh dear! You found some! How marvelous! How can I ever repay you?
npc.delilah.find_cuthana: Please find as much cuthana as you can.
npc.delilah.gold.ask: Are you certain you want gold as your reward?
npc.delilah.gold.done: I believe you have already received what you deserved.
npc.delilah.gold.no: I am relieved to hear that.
npc.delilah.gold.reward: Very well, you shall have your reward.
npc.delilah.indebted: I am still indebted to you. Please tell me what I can do to help.
npc.delilah.praying: I must pray so the bishop does not have a relapse.
npc.delnarsteelblade.attack.0: Stonecrest is under my protection! Leave or DIE!
npc.delnarsteelblade.attack.1: You're bleeding? Come to me and bleed some more!
npc.delnarsteelblade.attack.2: Isn't it a nice day to die?
npc.delnarsteelblade.attacked.1: You got lucky on that one!
npc.delnarsteelblade.attacked.2: You're starting to make me mad!
npc.delvar.attack.bleed: You're bleeding? Come to me and bleed some more!
npc.delvar.attacked.ouch: Ouch! You'll pay for this with your life!
npc.derangedorderly.shout.0: You're making a mess here! Stop this!
npc.derangedorderly.shout.1: Aww, all this blood, I'm going to have to change the sheets again.
npc.dionysus.centaur.progress: Free a dozen of my kin trapped in skeletal centaurs and I will reward you.
npc.dionysus.centaur.reward: I gladly give you this Scroll of Horse Friendship.
npc.dionysus.centaur.reward.ask: I see that you have slain skeletal centaurs. Shall I reward you now?
npc.dionysus.heal.ask: Do you wish to be completely healed for gold pieces?
npc.dionysus.heal.done: Thank you for this generous donation. Your wounds are now healed.
npc.dionysus.heal.free: Since you are not strong enough to acquire gold on your own, I shall heal your wounds.
npc.dionysus.heal.no: As you wish. Ask me again if you change your mind.
npc.dionysus.heal.none: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.dionysus.heal.partial: You did not have enough gold, but I have healed some of your wounds.
npc.dionysus.heal.poor: You do not have enough gold pieces to be healed.
npc.dionysus.lute.day: Please come back when it's nighttime.
npc.dionysus.lute.done: Oh, you brought it back already! Thank you so much!
npc.dionysus.lute.info: The Lute of Peace needs to be recharged once in a while.
npc.dionysus.recharge.already: You're already taking care of recharging my Lute of Peace.
npc.dionysus.recharge.ask: I could use help recharging my Lute of Peace. Will you take it to Glaenshenmilandira?
npc.dionysus.recharge.done: Bravo! I expected nothing less. I give you a Lute of Peace.
npc.dionysus.recharge.night: I'm afraid it's better to ask me about this at night.
npc.dionysus.staff.ask: I have all the necessary components. Shall I create a Staff of Hope?
npc.dionysus.staff.denied: A Staff of Hope can only be made for a Lightbringer.
npc.dionysus.staff.done: Here's the Staff of Hope you asked for.
npc.dionysus.staff.info: I need two Demon Tree Woods and five Symbols of Hope.
npc.doktorspine.shout: It's time for your spine transplant.
npc.doppelganger.complete: Your body quivers with power as you absorb the doppelganger's remaining essence.
npc.doppelganger.essence: You absorb part of the doppelganger's essence into your own.
npc.doppelganger.immune: You can't seem to be able to affect the doppelganger...
npc.doremas.abort: Fine. The plan is aborted. Return to the hole you crawled from.
npc.doremas.scroll.assigned: You've already been assigned with the mission previously. If you wish to abort it, just say so.
npc.doremas.scroll.instructions: You have a scroll of evil deed that bears the crest of Shadeen? Listen carefully: create a diversion and find the combination for the bank's safe.
npc.doremas.scroll.many: You have more than one scroll of evil deed? You must discard all but one if you wish to receive your instructions.
npc.draconis.efnisien.no: Olin Haad got him then. I must wait for the traveler from the prophecy.
npc.draconis.efnisien.yes: Olin Haad did not get him. Only a dragon can sense such a thing.
npc.draconis.lore: We half-dragons protected this temple. You are the traveler who can stop Olin Haad and restore Justice.
npc.draconis.name: It does not matter now.
npc.draconis.progress.41: Who are you? Why are you here? Did Efnisien send you?
npc.draconis.work: I am guardian of Lothar's tomb, but I failed.
npc.dragon.mature: I see you have grown. You are once more worthy of addressing me.
npc.dragon.quest.ask: Deal with the tomb raider lurking in the Crypt and I shall reward you.
npc.dragon.quest.done: Thank you for taking care of the tomb raider hiding in the Crypt.
npc.dragon.quest.reward: You accomplished the task successfully. You have been awarded 5000 experience points.
npc.dragon.young: Whoever you are, you had better have a good reason for disturbing Darkfang!
npc.drardos.bones: They sent you away, you say? The ring is evil? I had no idea. Seek a blind man who can read its aura.
npc.drardos.welcome: Hello, what can I do for you?
npc.drunk.give.100: For that kind of money, it is going to rain tomorrow.
npc.drunk.give.1000: Darkfang may tell you about your karma.
npc.drunk.give.2000: The weapon you seek is probably a Gloomblade.
npc.drunk.give.250: That is worth a little tip: quests may prevent other quests later.
npc.drunk.give.more: You may want to look into the story of the Seraphs.
npc.drunk.give.poor: You're trying to spend gold you don't have...
npc.drvonpyre.shout: How is your blood pressure today?
npc.dwarthonstoneface.attack: Do not worry, this will be a clean blow!
npc.dwarthonstoneface.attacked.1: Ah! You merely did a scar!
npc.edden.robbed.female: The banker was just robbed; I am trying to catch the thief, my Lady.
npc.edden.robbed.male: The banker was just robbed; I am trying to catch the thief, my Lord.
npc.edden.thief: I have finally caught you, thief! You are going directly to jail!
npc.edden.welcome: Welcome to the king's castle. Please wipe your boots before entering.
npc.edgar.busy: It looks like it's gonna be another one of those days... speak your business and be quick.
npc.edgar.death.first: Why did you do this to me? You bastard!
npc.edgar.death.paid: Blast you, brigand! Here's your money! Now leave me be!
npc.edgar.death.reward: Blast you, brigand! Here's your money! Now leave me be!
npc.edgar.death.warning: Why did you do this to me? You bastard!
npc.edgar.refuse: I will not speak with people of your ilk!
npc.edgar.thanks: I heard about what you did for us... thanks.
npc.efnisien.busy: I do not have time to talk about that now.
npc.efnisien.help: Well? Don't just stand there! Help me out here!
npc.efnisien.letter: I'm sorry, as much as I would like to chat, you must make yourself known to Olin Haad.
npc.efnisien.lore: The assassins were sent by Olin Haad, who put the town under siege for a worthless stone.
npc.efnisien.name: Efnisien, at your service.
npc.efnisien.progress.1: Those damned guards think they can rough everybody around!
npc.efnisien.progress.2: Have you talked to Olin Haad? He is inside the cavern across town.
npc.efnisien.progress.39: Hail, friend. How may I be of service?
npc.efnisien.progress.40: Olin Haad found another way into the temple. I will unlock the door for you.
npc.efnisien.progress.41: You must stop Olin Haad! He is already inside the temple.
npc.efnisien.progress.5: He said he would turn us into undead slaves. Tell the high priest.
npc.efnisien.progress.6: The high priest sent you to Windhowl? Then stop standing around here.
npc.efnisien.progress.before39: I should be more careful with those guards.
npc.efnisien.progress.before5: If you want Olin Haad's attention, defeat the guards near his hideout.
npc.efnisien.progress.done: I am proud to have met you after your heroic feat.
npc.efnisien.work: This and that. I do not know you well enough to say more.
npc.eldantor.kit.ask: I could sell you a magic scripting kit for 20000 gold. Do you wish to buy one?
npc.eldantor.kit.done: You are now the proud owner of a magic scripting kit.
npc.eldantor.kit.gold: I will not sell a kit for less than 20000 gold.
npc.eldantor.oracle.bad: The Oracle? I am not sure.
npc.eldantor.oracle.good: If you seek your true destiny, the Oracle can help if you find him.
npc.elysana.expected: Is it truly you? I have been expecting you.
npc.elysana.gemstone.offer: A green gemstone of the Forest Spirit will cost 20000 gold. Do you want one?
npc.elysana.gemstone.poor: You do not have enough gold.
npc.elysana.ingredients.done: You found the ingredients I needed. Here are black lizardskin boots.
npc.elysana.ingredients.missing: You are missing an ingredient or two.
npc.elysana.ingredients.need: You would be an angel if you could get me the ingredients I need.
npc.elysana.ingredients.ready: You found all three ingredients? Would you like to trade them to me?
npc.elysana.night: A strange time to come knocking... I do my best work at night.
npc.eraka.traitor: We do not tolerate your kind here!
npc.ethan.busy: Unless you have money for me, I have nothing to say.
npc.ethan.double: You spent my gold? Now you must pay back double what Urik gave you.
npc.ethan.money: Give me that money. Now, about Nomad...
npc.ethan.name: I am Ethan, guild leader.
npc.ethan.need2000: Get me 2000 gold or forget about ever finding Nomad.
npc.ethan.progress.10: Give me that money so I can keep it safe. Now, about Nomad...
npc.ethan.progress.11: Let us finish our business about Nomad.
npc.ethan.progress.12: Did you find the house yet? It is somewhere in the south part of town.
npc.ethan.progress.6: You are looking for Nomad? What trouble has that little misfit gotten into now?
npc.ethan.progress.9: I heard how you dealt with Urik. Now let us see the money.
npc.ethan.progress.before42: I hope you succeed in bringing Nomad to justice.
npc.ethan.progress.before6: Welcome to the merchant's guild. What can I do for you?
npc.ethan.progress.before9: Have you talked to Urik yet? Hurry up; time is money.
npc.ethan.progress.complete: Word of your deeds has reached Windhowl. Well done!
npc.ethan.task: Urik has not paid his guild duties. Recover the money he owes; you will find him in his shop.
npc.ethan.work: I manage the merchant's guild and protect its interests.
npc.etheanan.fishing.ask: Do you like to fish by any chance?
npc.etheanan.fishing.yes: Splendid! Perhaps we could go together one day.
npc.etherealportal: An ethereal portal beckons for you to enter.
npc.evelyn.night: It's getting pretty dark, eh? Luckily for me, I have my willowisp ring that I use as a light source to guide my way.
npc.filandrius.browse: Feel free to look around as you please.
npc.filandrius.busy: Now is not the time for this conversation.
npc.filandrius.get: Bring me the tome and I will reward you. Anthor will not be a pushover; bring friends.
npc.filandrius.name: I am Filandrius, high sorcerer of this library.
npc.filandrius.progress.0: Welcome to the arcane floor. I am Filandrius, high sorcerer of this library. My specialty is foreign magic.
npc.filandrius.progress.1: Already done? Anthor is wandering on Stoneheim. Hurry up and get me that book!
npc.filandrius.progress.2: That did not take long. Thank you! Here, as promised.
npc.filandrius.progress.3: Welcome back, friend. Are you here to learn some spells or just browsing?
npc.filandrius.progress.3.soul: Welcome back, friend. You carry a Soulstone! How interesting.
npc.filandrius.progress.4: Keep searching for the other soulstones. You will need all three to enter the portal.
npc.filandrius.progress.5: A creature was waiting behind the portal? I am ready to relieve you of that red gem.
npc.filandrius.progress.done: Welcome back. What brings you to the Great Library of Althea?
npc.filandrius.work: I collect and translate ancient magic, artifacts and spells.
npc.fleshgolem.shout.last_breath: With my last dying breath, I shall kill you!
npc.forestwanderer.askHome: A voice says: Do you wish to be sent home?
npc.forestwanderer.greeting: A voice says: Hello, traveller. I see that you are lost.
npc.forestwanderer.hint: A voice says: Are you lost?
npc.forestwanderer.no: A voice says: I take it you like it here, then...
npc.forestwanderer.returning: You feel lightheaded after being teleported back on Raven's Dust.
npc.fountain.activate: You stir the Waters of Knowledge with the Branch of Knowledge. The waters form one word: ETHEREAL.
npc.fountain.after31: The waters are clearer. You can still see the word ETHEREAL in the ripples.
npc.fountain.before31: The Fountain of Knowledge lies before you.
npc.fountain.ethereal: The waters are somewhat clearer but you can still see something in the ripples: ETHEREAL.
npc.fountain.reveal: You use the Branch of Knowledge to stir the Waters of Knowledge... The waters swirl before your very eyes to form a single word: ETHEREAL. You receive 300000 experience points.
npc.fountain.unclear: The Fountain of Knowledge lies before you.
npc.gabrielarchonis.cannot_hit: Something seems to prevent you from hurting Gabriel.
npc.gaenenelthorn.cannot_hit: Something seems to prevent you from hurting Gaenen.
npc.geena.cured: You brought back brown roots? Thank you... Tell Halam I feel much better now.
npc.geena.ill: I think I have caught the terrible Goblin fever. See Mushn and ask him for a cure.
npc.geena.well: I hope I don't see too many guards tonight... Can I help you?
npc.gehenna.reaver.death: ARGHHH! Others will avenge me for this!!!
npc.gehenna.reaver.hit.0: I will cut you to pieces!
npc.geram.ale.thanks: Thank you for the ale! The 2nd number of the combination is %d to the LEFT.
npc.geram.combination.ask: Do you have a mug of fresh ale for the second number of the combination?
npc.geram.combination.done: Thank you for the ale. The second number is recorded in your quest progress.
npc.geram.combination.no: That is none of your business.
npc.geram.gold.ask: Please, could you spare a gold piece?
npc.geram.work.ask: I have no work. Would you happen to be offering me some?
npc.ghundarg.welcome: I always wondered if a human would be bold enough to come into our domain.
npc.glaen.lute.ask: Bring me at least six Magical Lutes; the more you bring, the better the odds of success.
npc.glaen.lute.done: I already recharged the Lute; now please take it back to your friend Dionysos.
npc.glaen.lute.fail: The magical energies were too volatile and I failed. You must get me new Magical Lutes.
npc.glaen.lute.need: I need at least six Magical Lutes before I can attempt the recharge.
npc.glaen.lute.success: Yes! It worked! Here's your Lute of Peace.
npc.glaen.will.ask: You are here because you need me to create the Will of Artherk. Will you give me those items so that I create this jewel you need?
npc.glaen.will.atone: You must atone for harming the Purifiers before I can help you.
npc.glaen.will.created: Artherk has granted me the ability to merge these items into the holy Will of Artherk. Here, it is now yours.
npc.glaen.will.done: You already have obtained the Will of Artherk. You can now return to Stonecrest.
npc.glaen.will.none: I have nothing to say to you.
npc.grant.belts.ask: Would you like to trade three Belts against one Collector's Book?
npc.grant.belts.info: Bring me three Belts of Skraug Strength and I'll trade them for a Collector's Book.
npc.grant.documents.ask: Are you saying you are giving me these secret documents?
npc.grant.documents.done: Here! I give you gold and this Certificate of Recognition.
npc.grant.documents.info: Bring me at least five secret documents and I'll give you a reward.
npc.grant.night.done: Bravo! You did good work. Here's your reward!
npc.grant.night.need: Please kill as many Nightcreepers as you can. For every nine you kill, I'll give you a reward.
npc.grant.pilfer.done: I knew I could count on you! Here's your reward.
npc.grant.pilfer.need: They are a real pain in the neck! Kill eight of them and I'll give you a reward.
npc.gulfrid.no: If you are not buying, leave immediately.
npc.gulfrid.oracle.bad: I do not think this is something we should discuss.
npc.gulfrid.oracle.good: Only those with godly keys can hope to find him.
npc.guntertag.traitor: You not welcome here! ME CRUSH YOU!
npc.guntertag.welcome: Guntertag Destroy! What do you want?
npc.gunthar2.progress.22: By Artherk, you saved my life! Were you successful in retrieving the stone?
npc.gunthar2.progress.23: Hurry! Bring the stone to Olin Haad before it is too late.
npc.gunthar2.progress.other: I must return to the temple before anything else happens.
npc.gunthar2.stone.no: What are you doing here? Retrieve the stone before all is lost.
npc.gunthar2.stone.yes: Artherk be praised! Bring it to Olin Haad; I will wait at the temple.
npc.gunthardoor.note: The door is locked but there is a note: I apologize for not being there to meet you. If you wish to know where to find me, talk to the priests in the temple.
npc.gypsy.choice.again: You may only choose one. Choose regeneration, renewal or quiver.
npc.gypsy.choice.ask: I have three magical objects which might be of interest to you, but you may only take one. Which will you choose?
npc.gypsy.choice.quiver: A wise choice. The other two objects will go to other adventurers in need.
npc.gypsy.choice.regeneration: A wise choice. The other two objects will go to other adventurers in need.
npc.gypsy.choice.renewal: A wise choice. The other two objects will go to other adventurers in need.
npc.gypsy.fourth: The remains of Gluriurl have returned to their guardians. We can hope again.
npc.gypsy.nomad: I can help you find Nomad, but first I must attune myself to your aura.
npc.gypsy.progress.16: Well met, Traveler sent by the winds!
npc.gypsy.progress.17: To reach the temple, go through the cave north of here.
npc.gypsy.progress.18: I see you found the temple. I can feel a Darkheart upon you.
npc.gypsy.progress.19: Hurry! Bring the stone to the temple in Lighthaven.
npc.gypsy.progress.42: Welcome again, Traveler sent by the Winds. Thank you for saving Althea.
npc.gypsy.progress.before16: Welcome. Great events will happen soon and I must prepare for them.
npc.gypsy.progress.before42: You have a long road ahead of you.
npc.gypsy.progress.complete: Good day to you. Do not let your success get to your head.
npc.gypsy.question.first_no: You lie, but that is of no consequence to me. Did you believe him when he said that you were a Harvester of Life?
npc.gypsy.question.giver: Then you are a Giver of Life. The temple awaits.
npc.gypsy.question.harvester: Then you are a Harvester of Life. The temple awaits.
npc.gypsy.question.second: Did you believe Olin Haad when he called you a Harvester of Life?
npc.gypsy.question.third: Are you a Harvester of Life or a Giver of Life, New Breed?
npc.gypsy.question.third_no: I see... there might be hope for you after all. Are you a Harvester of Life or a Giver of Life, New Breed?
npc.gypsy.reward: The gypsy gives you gifts as a token of the Council of Eight's appreciation.
npc.gypsy.seer: I see images in dreams beyond understanding. You were searching for Nomad.
npc.gypsy.silence: I see... you and I having this conversation, but not on this day.
npc.gypsy.traveler: I am a seer; the winds reveal much to me.
npc.haden.killed: You again! This time I will put an end to your miserable life!
npc.halam.bribe.ok: Thanks! You're a pal! Jagar Kar has a large collection of Nightswords.
npc.halam.geena: You're the one who cured Geena? Here, take this reward.
npc.halam.welcome: I'm really tired of those damned guards tearing up the place.
npc.harforr.heal.ask: Do you wish to be completely healed for gold pieces?
npc.harforr.heal.done: Your wounds are now healed. Please come back if needed.
npc.harforr.heal.free: Since you are not strong enough to acquire gold, I shall heal your wounds.
npc.harforr.heal.none: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.harforr.heal.partial: You did not have enough gold, but I healed some of your wounds.
npc.harforr.heal.poor: You do not have enough gold pieces to be healed.
npc.harforr.sanctuary.ask: Do you wish to set the Temple of Windhowl as your sanctuary?
npc.harforr.sanctuary.done: Your body and soul shall return here if you die.
npc.harforr.sanctuary.poor: You need 5000 gold pieces for this donation.
npc.hereticwarrior.death: I'm bleeding to death! How can this be!?! Dark One, you LIED to me!!
npc.hereticwarrior.light.0: You do not stand a chance! Even if you defeat me, more will come to take my place.
npc.hereticwarrior.light.1: Yield now, and I shall grant you a merciful death. Fight on and I'll burn your soul!
npc.hereticwarrior.ogrimar.0: Makrsh P'Tangh won't forgive your interference! There will be retribution for this!
npc.hereticwarrior.ogrimar.1: Have you no loyalty? You turn upon us, your kin? It almost makes me weep with pride!
npc.hereticwarrior.other.0: You insignificant gnat! I will be done with you shortly and return to my business.
npc.hereticwarrior.other.1: Stand aside, weakling. You have no strength, no convictions! Prepare to die!
npc.herewald.oracle.bad: It is none of my business, and none of yours.
npc.herewald.oracle.good: The Oracle is powerful. Go there prepared, wearing good armor.
npc.herewald.shop.ask: I have strong armor for sale. Do you want to look at my selection?
npc.highpriestgunthar.heartstone.unavail: I'm afraid I cannot help you with that right now, my child.
npc.idas.bank.robbed: The banker was just robbed; I am trying to catch the thief!
npc.idas.thief: I have finally caught you, thief! You are going directly to jail!
npc.idas.welcome: Welcome. Be sure to wipe your boots before proceeding inside.
npc.jamar.kalir: Kalir is still somewhere in the desert, lagging behind as usual.
npc.jamar.key.no: I do not have such a key. Kalir has it.
npc.jamar.key.secret: I do not think I want to talk about that.
npc.jamar.letter.need: I would love to get a letter from Kalir.
npc.jamar.letter.old: This letter is too old; Kalir may no longer be where it says.
npc.jamar.letter.valid: A letter from Kalir? Thank you. Please take this letter back to him.
npc.julian.robes.ok: Thank you. Here's your Gloom Staff.
npc.julian.venom.ok: Excellent. Here is the nephil spider venom.
npc.kalir.jamar.ask: If you see Jamar, could you give him a letter from me?
npc.kalir.key.no: I do not have such a key. You should ask my friend Jamar.
npc.kalir.key.yes: I am sorry for lying. I gave the key to Morindin Arrowmist.
npc.kalir.letter.give: Thank you! Please give the letter to Jamar as soon as possible.
npc.kalir.letter.invalid: A letter from Jamar? Thanks. You did not really get this from him, did you?
npc.kalir.letter.valid: Jamar wrote back! Thank you! Now I know where we can meet again.
npc.karahn.day: Good day to you, friend. What can I do for you on such a splendid day?
npc.karahn.night: Good evening to you friend. How may I help you?
npc.khan.belt: I will reward you with a Belt of Skraug Strength if you bring five maces.
npc.khan.mace.ask: Would you part with five Skraugbashor Maces in exchange for a Belt of Skraug Strength?
npc.khan.mace.done: Excellent news! You receive a Belt of Skraug Strength and experience.
npc.khan.mace.info: Bring me five Skraugbashor Maces and I will reward you with a Belt of Skraug Strength.
npc.khan.skull: A human in Stonecrest named Delnar trades valuables for a certain skull.
npc.khan.skull.denied: You might wish to rephrase that.
npc.kheral.attack.bleed: You're bleeding? Come to me and bleed some more!
npc.kheral.attack.die: Isn't it a nice day to die?
npc.kheral.attack.protection: Stonecrest is under my protection! Leave or DIE!
npc.kheral.attacked.lucky: You got lucky on that one!
npc.kheral.attacked.mad: You're starting to make me mad!
npc.khimtesar.abuse: I will not tolerate this kind of abusive language. I am taking half of your gold as punishment!
npc.kiadus.closed: Come back later when the sun is up.
npc.kiadus.no: Well, that is fine with me.
npc.kiadus.partial: You do not have enough, but I will take it anyway.
npc.kiadus.poor: You do not have enough gold.
npc.kiadus.sister.again: If you give me another 2000 gold, I may remember again.
npc.kiadus.sister.ask: A little gold would refresh my memory. How about 2000 gold?
npc.kiadus.sister.name: His sister was Amandra.
npc.kiadus.visitor.after: He said he was going to see his sister first.
npc.kiadus.visitor.before: I haven't seen anyone out of the ordinary.
npc.kiadus.visitor.found: A strange fellow stopped by with an eerie-looking sword.
