npc.remort.del aan.done: It is done. Your elemental resistance has increased.
npc.remort.del aan.empty: You have spent all your extra energy. You should now talk to Alphan again.
npc.remort.del aan.need_alphan: I cannot help you until you have spoken to Alphan.
npc.remort.del aan.not_enough: You do not have enough energy to increase this elemental resistance.
npc.remort.del aan.resistances: You can increase fire, water, air, earth and dark resistances.
npc.remort.del aan.welcome: I am here to help you increase your elemental resistances by focusing your energy.
npc.remort.epilan.done: It is done. Your maximum has increased.
npc.remort.epilan.empty: You have spent all your extra energy. You should now talk to Alphan again.
npc.remort.epilan.health: To increase your maximum health by 10, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.remort.epilan.mana: To increase your maximum mana by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.remort.epilan.need_alphan: I cannot help you until you have spoken to Alphan.
npc.remort.epilan.not_enough: You do not have enough energy to increase this maximum.
npc.remort.epilan.welcome: I am here to help you increase your maximum health and mana by focusing your energy.
npc.remortnpc1.assist: You have energy to spend. Speak with my associates, then return when it is all spent.
npc.remortnpc1.associates: Go talk to my associates. They will explain how to use your extra energy.
npc.remortnpc1.begin: When you are ready, we may begin the final stage of your transformation.
npc.remortnpc1.notready: There are many things in life that we know and understand. This is not one of them.
npc.remortnpc1.ready: You are ready for the final stage of your transformation. We can begin.
npc.remortnpc1.spend: I cannot help until you have spent all your energy. Return when you are done.
npc.remortnpc1.teleport: The preparations are complete. You will soon be transported to Lighthaven.
npc.remortnpc1.welcome: Welcome, young one. I am here to assist you in preparing for your new life.
npc.resha.bow.ask: You have enough bows. Shall I trade five for a Cloak of the Archer?
npc.resha.bow.done: Here is your Cloak of the Archer. You receive experience as well.
npc.resha.bow.info: Bring me bows of Centaur Slaying and I will reward you.
npc.resha.bow.progress: Come back when you have five bows and I will reward you.
npc.resha.oracle.bad: None of your business! Leave me be.
npc.resha.oracle.good: I know the Oracle. I failed his ascension challenges and returned as a guard.
npc.resha.quest.bows: Forget quests! What are you doing with those bows of Centaur Slaying?
npc.resha.quest.none: I have no work for you. Check with Chryseida.
npc.reynen.adriana.no: You know more than you are telling. It is none of your business.
npc.reynen.chest.key: The chest may be locked. Here is a key; you do not need to return it.
npc.reynen.chest.no: You sound as lost as I am.
npc.reynen.key.0: I have never heard of it!
npc.reynen.key.3: I do not know what you are talking about.
npc.reynen.key.4: I hid my old royal key in a chest in these caverns. It is yours if you find it.
npc.reynen.key.later: It is in a chest somewhere around here. Look around.
npc.rhodar.buy: You want to buy something, is that it?
npc.rhodar.closed: Sorry, we are closed during the night.
npc.rhodar.hammer.ask: That hammer is mine! Will you give it back to me?
npc.rhodar.hammer.done: Thanks, friend. Here are 3500 gold pieces for your troubles.
npc.rhodar.hammer.missing: You no longer have the hammer.
npc.rhodar.no: I am sorry to hear that.
npc.rhodar.welcome: We sell the very best weapons on Raven's Dust.
npc.ribcage.darkstone: A dark stone floats in the air where the heart should be.
npc.ribcage.heart: The Heart of Gluriurl floats in the air in the middle of the ribcage.
npc.ribcage.replace: With great care, you take the dark stone and replace it with the Heart of Gluriurl.
npc.ribcage.too_far: You must step closer to the ribcage to inspect it.
npc.roen.ring.give: I dreamt of your visit. A winged woman said I must give you this ring. It is yours now.
npc.roen.ring.known: The Ring of the Seraph protects its wearer against harm.
npc.roen.welcome: Greetings! What brings you into these woods?
npc.rolph.cooldown: I have already sent a report recently. Please come back later.
npc.rolph.need.registration: Register with Kirlor Dhul and bring me the letter proving it.
npc.rolph.report.given: Take this precious report to Lord Sunrock as quickly as possible.
npc.rolph.too.young: I doubt you can make it to Windhowl at your level.
npc.rolph.welcome: Welcome! Business has been booming. Everyone is buying armor these days.
npc.rondy.guess.correct: Correct! The first number is to the RIGHT.
npc.rondy.guess.poor: You need 1000 gold pieces per attempt.
npc.rondy.guess.range: The number is between 1 and 50. Try again.
npc.rondy.guess.unavailable: I don't see why you would want to play my game for now.
npc.sabrina.attacked.0: Help! I am being attacked by giant rats!!!
npc.sabrina.attacked.1: Somebody help me! There's too many of them!
npc.sabrina.bye: Farewell, and be safe on your journey.
npc.sabrina.heal: You are in need of healing? Say no more, I will restore you immediately.
npc.sabrina.name: Sabrina, at your service.
npc.sabrina.rats.done: Oh! You killed all of them? I can't thank you enough!
npc.sabrina.rats.help: Don't just stand there! Help me!
npc.sabrina.rats.most: Oh, thank you so much for your help. I am very grateful. Don't worry about me, I can take care of the rest.
npc.sabrina.welcome: Don't just stand there! Help me!
npc.sabrina.work: I teach art to the children of Lighthaven.
npc.safe.help: The combination has three numbers from 1 to 100. Type RIGHT <number> or LEFT <number>.
npc.safe.range: The safe's combination is between 1 and 100.
npc.safe.robbed: The safe has just been robbed. Try again later.
npc.safe.success: Success! You opened the safe and stole %d gold pieces.
npc.samaritan.offensive: We Samaritans do not like foul language. Leave me be.
npc.samaritan.welcome: Welcome to Windhowl, friend. How may I help you?
npc.samuel.apple.ask: I need 10 units of wax and 1000 gold to mold a wax apple. Is that fair?
npc.samuel.apple.gold: I cannot work for free. You need 1000 gold pieces.
npc.samuel.apple.jester: First get rid of the horrible Death Jester who troubles our nights.
npc.samuel.apple.locked: I do not have time to mold an apple that will end up in the trash.
npc.samuel.apple.missing: You need 10 more wax units to mold the wax apple.
npc.samuel.apple.result: The wax apple is finished. Here you go.
npc.samuel.candle.done: The candle of eternity is finished. Come back if you need another one.
npc.samuel.candle.info: I can mold a candle of eternity with five wax units and 5000 gold.
npc.samuel.candle.missing: You do not have the five wax units and 5000 gold required.
npc.samuel.jester.ask: Bring me the Death Jester's skull as proof that you vanquished this foe, and I shall reward you.
npc.samuel.jester.done: You have already helped us. The Death Jester will return in another corpse.
npc.samuel.jester.reward: You have defeated the Death Jester. Take this scarab protector and 30000 experience points.
npc.samuel.jester.unworthy: You have the skull, but you did not vanquish the foe yourself. You are not worthy of a reward.
npc.sanctuary.name: I see not why this would concern you.
npc.sanctuary.warning: You spoke the word. The sanctuary remains dangerous. Do you still desire access?
npc.sanctuary.weak: You spoke the word, but you are not yet capable of handling what lies beneath.
npc.sanctuary.welcome: Beyond this mausoleum lies Gluriurl's sanctuary. Only those who speak the word of power may pass.
npc.sanctuary.word: Speak the word of power and I shall grant you passage.
npc.sanctuary.work: I guard the entrance to the mausoleum.
npc.seban.day: Good day to you, friend. What can I do for you?
npc.seban.night: Good evening to you friend. How may I help you?
npc.sentry.accept: Bring several friends; do not try to fight her alone.
npc.sentry.decline: That is too bad. I thought you would help those in need.
npc.sentry.help: Hel abducts people outside the gates. You must take care of her for the townspeople.
npc.sentry.reward.done: Thank you for helping us. I hope the menace is gone for good.
npc.sentry.reward.given: It is my honor to present this reward from the townspeople.
npc.sentry.reward.none: I cannot reward you until Hel has been defeated.
npc.sentry.reward.ready: You dealt with Hel. The town has a special reward for you.
npc.sentry.task: Confront Hel and stop her madness. Will you help the townspeople of Windhowl?
npc.sentry.welcome: You look like you can handle yourself. I could use help from someone like you.
npc.sentry.work: I make sure no one wanders outside the gates.
npc.shadeen.attack.potion: Oh, a potion of healing? Finders keepers! *gulp* Heh! Heh!
npc.shadeen.attacked.potion: Oh my, you've dropped a potion, you clumsy oaf! Hmmm. Tasty!
npc.shadeen.death: D-Darn it... I just hate... dying... again...
npc.shadowstalker.death: NooOOoo! Mordenthal will burn my entrails for this!
npc.shardchest.blue_crystal_shard: You find a blue crystal shard inside the chest.
npc.shardchest.empty: You open the chest but find nothing inside.
npc.shardchest.first: You inspect the chest carefully, but find nothing inside.
npc.shardchest.found: You find a blue crystal shard inside the chest.
npc.shardchest.found.green: You find a green crystal shard inside the chest.
npc.shardchest.found.red: You find a red crystal shard inside the chest.
npc.shardchest.green_crystal_shard: You lift the false bottom and find a green crystal shard.
npc.skraug.shout.death.0: Og! Dat wuz fun! Oy dye guud death!
npc.skraug.shout.death.2: Agh! Oy die merry and bloody!
npc.snakefountain.far: You hear some hissing noises but you're too far away from the well to inspect it.
npc.snakefountain.gather: The well is filled with snakes submerged in greenish waters but you manage to gather some of the liquid into a flask.
npc.snakefountain.inscription: You discern an inscription on the well which reads: ~Herein lies the blood of Gluriurl~
npc.snakefountain.snakes: The well is filled with snakes submerged in greenish waters.
npc.snakefountain.too_far: You must step closer to the well to inspect it.
npc.sunrock.diamond.ok: Thank you so much! Here are 400 gold pieces.
npc.sunrock.spellbook.need: Bring me back Jarko's spellbook and you shall be rewarded.
npc.sunrock.spellbook.ok: For your good deed, I give you gold and a magnificent golden ring!
npc.sunrock.traitor: Your actions prove that you've betrayed me. You are no longer welcome here.
npc.sunrock.welcome: I welcome you to WindHowl, stranger!
npc.sweeper.scroll_reward: As you kill the Sweeper, an arcane scroll mysteriously appears in your hands.
npc.taliron.closed: I would show you what I have for sale, but it is rather late. Come back tomorrow.
npc.taliron.evening: Good evening. What can I do for you?
npc.taliron.sleep: *yawn* It's a bit late, don't you think? I hope what you've got to say is important.
npc.tarnian.believe: Take this Runed Stone Tablet. It is the key to reaching Raven's Dust without Olin Haad knowing.
npc.tarnian.busy: Perhaps we can talk about this when I am not so busy.
npc.tarnian.gunthar.no: I must be mistaken then. Good day to you.
npc.tarnian.gunthar.yes: I am pleased to meet you. I see that you have found the Darkstone.
npc.tarnian.name: Tarnian Wolfmane, at your service.
npc.tarnian.progress.25: Well met, friend! Are you the one Gunthar sent to me?
npc.tarnian.progress.26: Have you found Antonian yet? Follow the road to Windhowl, then northwest to his cottage.
npc.tarnian.progress.before42: I know you will fight this through to the end. Prove stronger than your foes.
npc.tarnian.progress.complete: Gunthar told me what you did for us. You have given us renewed hope. Thank you.
npc.tarnian.story: The Darkstone represents the heart of Gluriurl. It is the key to another temple and the skull of the dead god.
npc.tarnian.work: Olin Haad thinks he can take this town by force. I am here to see that does not happen.
npc.terwin.bribe.done: I guess I could answer a few questions about the royal keys.
npc.terwin.honest.bad: Return when you have done more good deeds than bad ones.
npc.terwin.honest.bribe: Even honest men need to make a living. Perhaps 5000 gold?
npc.terwin.honest.potion: Bring me a potion of heroism and perhaps we can become closer.
npc.terwin.honest.wait: We can talk after I have had a potion of heroism.
npc.terwin.key.bribe: An honest guard cannot discuss royal keys with a peon like you.
npc.terwin.key.info: Ask Chamberlain Thomar about the royal key, but you did not hear it from me.
npc.terwin.key.locked: The king has many keys. They are no concern of yours.
npc.terwin.potion.ask: I see you have a potion of heroism. Would you care to part with it?
npc.terwin.potion.done: Many thanks! I am in your debt.
npc.thea.key.day: Royal keys? Return when I have more time to chat.
npc.thea.key.night: A priestess once sought to give a special key to someone. She left the island afterward.
npc.thea.priestess.known: I think she went back to Arakas. You will have to find out yourself.
npc.theopold.correct: That is the correct answer. You receive 10,000 XP.
npc.theopold.first: Let us start with a simple one. What is the center of balance?
npc.theopold.no_key: Thou have the correct answer, but not the key we require.
npc.theopold.pass: Hold on to thine horse, my friend. You receive 10,000 XP.
npc.theopold.ready: Thou know our riddles already. Art thou ready to pass?
npc.theopold.riddle.ask: We have many riddles to ask. For each riddle, we require a Royal Key. Are thou ready?
npc.theopold.wrong: This is not the correct answer.
npc.theoran.dark: I have no desire to speak with individuals of your ilk.
npc.theoran.ogrimar: Prepare to defend yourself, spawn of darkness.
npc.theoran.ring.ok: The ring is blessed and infused with faith. May Artherk light your path.
npc.theoran.water.ok: Very well. Your flask has been blessed.
npc.thomar.champion: You must be a Champion of Light before I can help you.
npc.thomar.cuthana.accept: Marvelous! Give the cuthana herbs to Princess Delilah.
npc.thomar.cuthana.ask: Cuthana has miraculous healing properties. Will you find some for Bishop Crowbanner?
npc.thomar.cuthana.healthy: Perhaps a hero could restore the faith of our people.
npc.thomar.key.given: Here is the royal key I promised.
npc.thomar.key.once: You already received the key once.
npc.thomar.no: That is unfortunate, but I understand.
npc.thomar.noaccess: There are so few noble people nowadays.
npc.thomar.oath: Swear an oath of worthiness and promise never to do evil. Will you?
npc.thomar.oath.accept: Your oath is accepted. Here is the key when you are ready.
npc.thor.friend: You're bringing a friend along? Get him out of my shop and we'll talk!
npc.thor.hammer.letter: I cannot forge a hammer of finality. Lance Silversmith, a former pupil of mine, can create one. Bring him this letter.
npc.thor.hammer.no: You wouldn't know what to do with a hammer of finality.
npc.thor.hammer.repeat: I've already told you what you need to know. Depart to Arakas and meet Lance Silversmith.
npc.thor.mordenthal: Mordenthal is obviously trying to prevent you from completing your quest.
npc.thor.sword.ok: Here you are then. The sword of majesty is of such power that no one can truly wield it.
npc.thor.welcome: A good day to you, friend. How may I be of service?
npc.thorbin.beer.ask: Do you wish to buy a good mug of ale for 10 gold pieces?
npc.thorbin.beer.done: Here you go, you will not regret it!
npc.thorbin.drum.ask: Do you want to give me Baldric's drum so I can bury it six feet under?
npc.thorbin.drum.done: Thanks, friend! You receive a reward and 3000 experience points.
npc.thorbin.drum.need: If you bring me Baldric's terrible drum, I will reward you.
npc.thorbin.karma.ask: For 250 gold pieces, I will tell you about your karma. Will you pay?
npc.thorbin.karma.unknown: I am not sure what you are.
npc.thorkas.chalice.ask: You have found one of our precious golden chalices? Do you wish to give it back?
npc.thorkas.chalice.done: Thank you. I hope you find this Ring of Faith useful.
npc.thorkas.chalice.none: Bring back one of our stolen golden chalices.
npc.thorkas.heal.ask: Do you wish to be completely healed for a donation?
npc.thorkas.heal.free: Since you are not strong enough, I shall heal your wounds.
npc.thorkas.heal.none: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.thorkas.heal.poor: You do not have enough gold pieces to be healed.
npc.thorkas.holy.ask: Do you have 1000 gold and a flask of crystal water?
npc.thorkas.holy.done: Done! You now have a flask of holy water!
npc.thorkas.holy.missing: You do not have the required gold and flask.
npc.thorkas.ring.done: I have already told you I will have nothing to do with your ring.
npc.thorkas.ring.evil: This ring is EVIL! I will have nothing to do with it.
npc.thorkas.sanctuary.ask: Do you wish to set the Temple of Raven's Dust as your sanctuary for 15000 gold?
npc.thorkas.sanctuary.done: It is done, then. Your body and soul shall return here if you die.
npc.thorkas.sanctuary.poor: My order requires a donation of 15000 gold pieces.
npc.thorkas.spells: Very well, I will share my knowledge with you.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.0: I am Brownbark. If you seek answers, I can honestly tell you that I am not the one you should ask.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.1: I have left my "brethren" a long time ago in search of solitude.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.10: GreyLeaf is the powerful "Daemon" "Tree" that roams in "Ravenwood".
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.11: Bane is the mad man who attempts to control the island.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.12: Beware of the monsters that roam in the desert of Vulture's Den.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.13: Silversky is the only town on "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.14: Raven's Dust is the name of this island.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.15: Althea is the name of the world in which we live in.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.16: Artherk is the human's God of Healing and Mending.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.17: I have never seen it myself.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.18: I cannot taste the softness of flesh.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.19: I am not the Oracle. I do not have answers for everything.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.2: They have been hired by "Bane" "Blackblood" himself to cause mischiefs.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.20: It is time for you to depart, %s.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.3: He is a befuddled wizard but do not judge him hastily. He is quite powerful in the Art.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.4: If you see them, they are located to the south-west of "Silversky".
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.5: The Forest Guardian are the protectors of Light. They are allied with the "Druids".
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.6: The Daemon Trees are the evil counterpart of the "Forest" "Guardians". They do not see the Light, they only see darkness and hatred.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.7: Ravenwood is the name of the cursed forest.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.8: This is a beautiful place, isn't it? There is no hatred here. Only peace.
npc.topic.aaronbrownbark.9: I used to be allied with "GreyLeaf" but I have learned the mistakes of my ways. The "Forest" "Guardians" showed me the light. I've decided to reside in this peaceful place known as "mirror" "lake".
npc.topic.adriana.10: There have been several adventurers seeking my training, but none that seemed too unusual.
npc.topic.adriana.11: Come back if you ever need more training!
npc.topic.adriana.2: If you want help developing those fighting skills, you've come to the right place! I have a very useful skill I can "teach" you. You won't find all the tricks I can teach you in a "book", that much I can tell you!
npc.topic.adriana.3: Very good, this is what I can teach you.
npc.topic.adriana.4: Very good, then let's begin your training.
npc.topic.adriana.5: So you've met my assistant? He's alright, I guess.
npc.topic.adriana.6: I have nothing to say about him! Ask someone else!
npc.topic.adriana.7: Hey! You've got a Book of Warfare on you? Think you'd be interested in trading it? I'll give you a Blade of Sharpness in return. So, what do you say, yes or no?
npc.topic.adriana.8: Hmmm. I am not exactly the bookworm-type but if you ever get a grip on a book called the "Book" "of" "Warfare", I would be immensely grateful if you could give it to me.
npc.topic.adriana.9: I tell you, that boy's cooking is pretty amazing! If he only had a little more enthusiasm and determination, he could start his own tavern!
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.0: What? You've lost the precious platinum ring I gave you? Humpft! You should be careful, it is a precious magical item. Hmmmm, I think I could manage to sell another one to you for.. *ahem* 50,000 gold pieces. Is that a deal?
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.1: You have a note saying I bought a stolen item? AH! This note has been falsified. {The} {Deep} {One's} {note} {instantly} {crumbles} {into} {dust!}
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.10: I heard that there is a small oasis located right in the middle.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.11: The Kingdom of Goldmoon is currently ruled by King Theodore XIII.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.12: The Nightblades are a group of assassins working for "Bane".
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.13: The spellbook is the most precious thing in the life of a wizard.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.14: Ravenwood? Surely you do not want to go there by yourself. Instead, you should travel south to where the "druids" are located. The Forest Guardians up there will protect you.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.15: Since the Forest Guardians and the druids both share the same concern about nature, it is just fitting that they should hang together.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.16: The druids strongly believe in the old ways and I advise you not to harm nature in their presence lest you want to taste their elemental fire blasts.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.17: The Library of the Lost Knowledge is a mysterious place that has been undisturbed for centuries. We often sought to find its location but stories tell that the Library lies under a sea, south of a tree.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.18: I have attempted to find clues on what the future holds but failed miserably in understanding what the prophecies mean.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.19: Elysana BlackRose has much more powers than she wants to show. That is a shame that she did not want to ally with the council against our two strongest enemies: "Bane" "Blackblood" and the "orcs".
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.2: You have a note saying I bought a stolen item? AH! This note has been falsified. {The} {Deep} {One's} {note} {instantly} {crumbles} {into} {dust!}
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.20: The orcs combine the sheer strength of their savage warriors, the black magic of their filthy shamans and the might of their "siege" "weapons". Therefore, they are a serious threat to our "Kingdom" and they must be stopped otherwise they will win.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.21: They are slow to move but they CAN destroy the castle's walls.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.22: Zhakar is a powerful wizard and I urge you not to underestimate his abilities. Despite his mental illness, he is still very competent in the arcane arts and is a valuable ally to our cause.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.23: Well, well. You've learned some pretty words, haven't you? Have a nice trip, on me!
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.3: You have a note saying I bought a stolen item? AH! This note has been falsified. {The} {Deep} {One's} {note} {instantly} {crumbles} {into} {dust!}
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.4: I am always in need of some tarantula eyes for my spells. I'll pay up to 3000 gold pieces per pair of tarantula eyes!
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.5: I am Aloysius Starbolt, master wizard of this castle.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.6: Well, aside from being one of the king's many advisors, I am also a licensed spell-teacher. As a magic user, I often also need some magical components. If you come across some "tarantula" "eyes", I would gladly buy them from you.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.7: Ahh, finally, I am going to make some money... Oops, uh.. yes, ahem.. let's begin.
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.8: Bane Blackblood is a self-centered butcher. He seeks to gain dominion over the Kingdom of Goldmoon and therefore often attempts to end King Theodore's life. In fact, he has created a group of assassins named the "Nightblades".
npc.topic.aloysiusstarbolt.9: King Theodore is not exactly a competent king but we could have gotten worse...Or could we?
npc.topic.amandra.0: He goes by the name of "Haden".
npc.topic.amandra.1: Although he is my brother, I can't help but despise him for what he has done. It seems despite all the things I have done to keep him on the right path, he has strayed away from it.
npc.topic.amandra.4: I am constantly travelling in search of "adventure" to better hone my fighting skills.
npc.topic.amandra.5: The thrill of the hunt, the intensity of the chase and the joy of overcoming an adversary stronger than you, these are the things for which I live.
npc.topic.amandra.6: How do you know I have a brother? If this is some kind of foolish attempt at gaining my favor, I must warn you that it will not only fail, but it will also anger me!
npc.topic.amandra.7: A strange visitor? I have not really been paying attention to that.
npc.topic.amandra.8: Ahhh, so you wish to test your skills against mine, is that it?
npc.topic.amandra.9: Farewell, until the next time we meet.
npc.topic.amelia.0: No I swear! I was just passing by and I didn't... Huh? You're not with "them"? Oh thank god!
npc.topic.amelia.1: There were at least six of them and they attacked the High Priest. Before he even had a chance to react, he was taken away by the "brigands". I think I saw "where" they went.
npc.topic.amelia.2: I think they work for the necromancer because the guards didn't do anything to stop them... Oh please! You must do something! The townspeople don't dare oppose them.
npc.topic.amelia.3: They took the west bridge out of town... I think they went southwest after that, but I can't be sure.
npc.topic.amelia.5: Oh, I was just on my way to talk to the mayor.
npc.topic.annabelle.0: I'm Annabelle. Nice to make your acquaintance. What are you doing in these parts?
npc.topic.annabelle.10: Lighthaven is a small yet beautiful town located on the other side of the island.
npc.topic.annabelle.11: Windhowl is "Lighthaven"'s sister town located south. It's a bit far, but I heard the merchants have great merchandise up there. That reminds me, perhaps "William" will bring me back a gift when he comes back. I wonder what it could be... A silk dress, maybe? Yes, that would be nice.
npc.topic.annabelle.12: That's the island you are currently standing on. I hope you knew that or you are somewhat lost, methinks.
npc.topic.annabelle.13: I was a priestess, once... I am not ignorant in the matters of removing "curses" and "healing" the wounded.
npc.topic.annabelle.14: I can do little for you myself, but perhaps you could visit the "Old" "Hermit" and ask for his guidance. He has little power himself, but knows many powerful priests and has acquired great wisdom during his "exile".
npc.topic.annabelle.15: His real name is Theorn Lemnearan. He lives in the mountains and shuns people. Do not be surprised if he receives you coldly, but remember that he has a good heart.
npc.topic.annabelle.16: He left everything behind him to study his books and to finally have peace.
npc.topic.annabelle.18: Train you with what? I do not think I could help you.
npc.topic.annabelle.19: I have little to teach, alas, except perhaps the ways to a kinder, gentler lifestyle. *sigh* There are few students for that, nowadays.
npc.topic.annabelle.2: Oh, I do a little of this, a little of that. I'm just tidying things up until my "William" returns to me. He is a little late though.
npc.topic.annabelle.20: Mhorgwloth is the name of the "troll" who dwells around here.
npc.topic.annabelle.21: The brigands are brutes, but "Mhorgwloth" protects me from their dirty hands.
npc.topic.annabelle.22: Hmmmm... I see that "Balork" has put his evil mark upon your brow... Great sorrow it will bring you, I fear, but great achievements as well. Years ago, I could have removed it from you, but the demon's curse has grown in strength while the years have weakened my faith. Alas, I cannot "help" you.
npc.topic.annabelle.23: I have healed some of your wounds, but I cannot heal you more.
npc.topic.annabelle.24: Farewell. If you see my "William", tell him to meet me here at once.
npc.topic.annabelle.3: It seems like ages ago since he left for war. Still, he promised to meet me here, so I wait for him. Perhaps you've seen him? He's tall, dark and handsome...
npc.topic.annabelle.4: Yes, he walks around here, but he is not dangerous, not if you do not attack him. In fact, he is very friendly and always protects me from those "goblins".
npc.topic.annabelle.5: This is the Orkanis Castle, although it isn't as beautiful as it was before the "troll" established himself here.
npc.topic.annabelle.6: I do not like goblins, they are mean creatures.
npc.topic.annabelle.7: I heard that Jarko is a mad man. I hope somebody will be able to stop him.
npc.topic.annabelle.8: There are a few beings in this world that bestow curses upon innocents like you. They are truly evil beings.
npc.topic.annabelle.9: I shiver just to think of this monster! Does he still roam the dungeon below the temple of "Lighthaven", cursing people with his "Brand"?
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.1: I am Annithae Teardrop. And you are...? %s? I am pleased to make your acquaintance. I hope that your stay in our fair little town will be enjoyable.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.2: I tend to the chores I have to do around the house. In my spare time, I sometimes craft necklaces with the nice pearls I find. You see the one I'm wearing right now? I've made it myself.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.3: A tear-shaped pearl? Yes, I have a few of those. Why d'you ask, you need one? Well, I could depart myself of one tear-shaped pearl but it will cost you... let me see... 12,000 gold. I think it is fair enough since these are quite rare. Do we have a deal?
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.4: A tear-shaped pearl? Yes, I have a few of those. Why d'you ask, you need one? Well, I could depart myself of one tear-shaped pearl but it will cost you... let me see... 12,000 gold. I think it is fair enough since these are quite rare. Do we have a deal?
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.5: Alas, I don't have any of those. However, I have a friend in Lighthaven, Moonrock I think her name is, that might help you.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.6: I don't really need your help finding them as I can find them by myself but thank you for offering your help. See? I already have alot of these nice tear-shaped pearls.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.7: I misjudged you for I thought that you were a decent person. Obviously, I was wrong.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.8: I'm afraid I'm not very good at this. If you need assistance with your quests, why don't you ask Chryseida the fortune teller? Her advice is expensive and it doesn't always come the first time, but it's always accurate and reliable when it *does* come.
npc.topic.annithaeteardrop.9: I sincerely hope to see you soon.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.0: I have already given you the two Drums of Fate that you need.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.1: The only place I've been told you can find one is in a dungeon where dark warlords lurk in the shadows.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.10: Morindin Arrowmist is a skilled hunter.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.12: You are always welcome in my small home.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.2: You should ask a musician or even a bard where they get their instruments. That would probably be the first place where I'd start looking if I were you.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.3: I think you should ask the chronicler who resides in Raven's Dust. He is the only one that I know who has some. However, he'll probably expect something in return...
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.5: I do what I can to keep this house from crumbling.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.7: It is a great tool for cutting trees indeed. You would be surprised how good it can be used as a weapon too.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.8: The desert? Surely you do not want to go there. I almost prefer to stay in this damned forest then going into this infernal oven.
npc.topic.anrakbrownbark.9: Over here, King Theodore XIII has no powers.
npc.topic.antonian.0: I don't know anything about that.
npc.topic.antonian.1: Oh it's quite remarkable! My latest project, it's a device that can be used to travel long distances in the "blink" of an eye!
npc.topic.antonian.11: Oh, I am just an old hermit...
npc.topic.antonian.2: That fast yes! Very exciting isn't it? You see, the high priest of Lighthaven recently asked me to look into matters concerning magical transportation. It seems this tablet is the answer to the high priest's "prayers".
npc.topic.antonian.3: Well, the stone's magic is so "ancient" that it predates even the oldest of races, making it impossible for any other magic, including Olin Haad's, to detect its use.
npc.topic.antonian.4: From what I can tell by the engravings, the tablet acts as a kind of focus. When the bearer of the tablet places it on a "nexus" "index", the tablet's rune that matches that of the nexus stone beside it will start to glow. I believe that if you activate enough of these runes, you will be able to travel to Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.antonian.5: Beside each nexus stone is an index on which you must place the tablet. There are many of these stones scattered throughout the islands. Fortunately for you, I have already discovered the "location" of several of them here on Arakas. Seeing as you need it more than I do, I will let you keep the tablet for yourself.
npc.topic.antonian.6: I had originally sent Tarnian to activate the nexus stones, but I guess he got caught up in that crusade of his. I can give you "directions" to the stones to help you out. Oh I almost forgot, you can use the tablet at any time to come back here. When I discovered that, I had this cottage built so I could better study the tablet's behavior. You can use this knowledge to your advantage when activating the nexus stones.
npc.topic.antonian.7: Now where did I put those charts? Please excuse me a moment, I seem to have misplaced them...
npc.topic.antonian.8: While you were away looking for nexus stones, I received a message from the High Priest saying you were looking for the Nameless Bard. Unfortunately, I have no way of knowing where you will end up once you get to Raven's Dust. However, I can tell you that Silversky is on the southeastern part of the island. Maybe that will be enough for you to find it.
npc.topic.antonian.9: He's a zoologist that studies creatures that manifest some degree of intelligence. One day, he heard about this creature that could speak and he sought it out. He is now one of a few people who know where to find the Nameless Bard.
npc.topic.aquinos.0: The message said you were looking for the Nameless Bard... I'm still not sure how comfortable I feel about divulging his "location" to someone I barely know though...
npc.topic.aquinos.1: Well, if Antonian trusts you, then I suppose I should as well. He's always been a good judge of character you know. After all, he counts me among his friends! Heh heh. Alright, it's settled then. I will tell you "where" the Nameless Bard resides, so to speak.
npc.topic.aquinos.2: Because of his nature, the Nameless Bard lives deep inside a cave far to the west. Take the road out of town heading northwest, then at the second fork, the one where the road continues on north and branches off to the northwest, take the northwest route. Follow that road until it ends, then keep going west until you reach the mountain range. The entrance to the cave can be found in that viscinity.
npc.topic.aquinos.4: I am researching intelligent creatures and documenting their behavior.
npc.topic.araknor.0: You need some necromantic scrolls? Hmm, I suppose I can sell some to you. I don't have any right now so you must give me time to make some. I must warn you that they will cost no less than 10000 gold each. Do you still want me to create some?
npc.topic.araknor.1: I go by the name of Araknor the "dark".
npc.topic.araknor.10: I must contend with the dreaded necromancer known as "Jarko", also known as the "Decrepit" One. I must have his "spellbook". I MUST!
npc.topic.araknor.11: When you see Jarko, you will know what I mean by this.
npc.topic.araknor.12: The only reason the people of this town are letting me stay here is because of the vast resources that I own. If it wasn't for that, I would have been kicked out a long time ago. I have also heard a rumor that several "brigands" have started harrassing the citizens and the merchants lately.
npc.topic.araknor.13: Brigands have regrouped recently to attack any merchant who crosses the forest. It is a rather strange thing since they usually fight among themselves. They must have chosen a leader. But in any case, I don't care much about them or anything they might do. As long as they don't cross my path, I won't have to kill them.. I despise wasting valuable power.
npc.topic.araknor.14: The art of necromancy is surely the greatest of all. It gives you control over death and can bring forth people who were once themselves dead. It is a path that few follow for that it is a dark one that will surely darken your soul. But the loss of a soul is a very small price to pay for such a power! The only one with powers equal to mine on this island is "Jarko".
npc.topic.araknor.15: I can feel the power of the Stone of Life! I sense its energies, pulsating as if... it could not be.. but.. it is.. alive..? {Araknor} {swiftly} {takes} {the} {Stone} {of} {Life} Here, I will give you this strange weapon in exchange.. I think it's called Shadowblade... yes... that is it.
npc.topic.araknor.16: Jarko the necromancer dwells in the mountains in the northern part of this island. He has two main armies, the goblins and the undeads. I can deal easily with both of them, however. His "spellbook" could be very useful to me.
npc.topic.araknor.17: I am currently studying Jarko's spellbook! Yours is probably a fake one!
npc.topic.araknor.18: If you have a plain blank scroll, I can help you make a "blank" "magic" "scroll", but it'll cost you. You also need a runic scripting kit, but that's not something I can help you with. I charge 500 gold for this service, so come prepared... and wealthy.
npc.topic.araknor.2: I am the necromancer of this tower. I gather information about the dead. The townsfolk resent my presence because of my profession.
npc.topic.araknor.20: Remember, the dead will always walk the realm.
npc.topic.araknor.4: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.araknor.5: The path of the necromancer is not an easy one. As your first lesson, I can "teach" you how to cast the lesser drain spell.
npc.topic.araknor.7: Are you here to ask me to make a blank magic scroll for you?
npc.topic.araknor.8: Scroll of enchantments are scrolls which some wizards use to improve some magical items. They're not easy to make, but they're pretty handy. Don't look at me, I don't sell these scrolls. Whatever I get, I keep for myself.
npc.topic.araknor.9: I follow the dark path of "necromancy".
npc.topic.archibald.0: I am called Archibald. I only speak to Seraphs. If you're interested in visiting the "Forest" "of" "No" "Return", I'm your man.
npc.topic.archibald.2: I'm just a traveller. Did you know I've been to the "Forest" "of" "No" "Return"?
npc.topic.archibald.3: I know this spell that can take someone there. To get back, though, you're on your own. Do you want to go?
npc.topic.archibald.4: Maybe I'll see you later then.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.0: I am Sir Arganor Iargh. How are you faring, my friend?
npc.topic.arganoriargh.1: I am the chief trainer of this "town". I can "teach" you how to use your strength to inflict great damage in combat.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.2: Very good, this is what I can teach you.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.3: I do not have time to train you. Talk to Garnir if you need some training.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.4: He shouldn't be too far. I'm sure you will find him.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.5: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady but somewhat odd, even though I've never seen her myself.
npc.topic.arganoriargh.7: You are in Windhowl, the greatest town in the kingdom of Goldmoon.
npc.topic.asarr.0: Perhaps I could give you this small wooden box of jewels. They are worthless to me, but Lord Sunrock has a weakness for jewels. Actually, I think that I'll SELL you the box. It's a fair price for your cowardice, don't you agree? You could then lie to him and say that you defeated us--yeah right! Do you agree with this plan of action?
npc.topic.asarr.1: It's not a good thing to further endanger your life. You will have to settle your differences with Lord Sunrock.
npc.topic.asarr.10: I think you need one, don't you? Will not be a hard task, I tell you. Are you interested?
npc.topic.asarr.11: They treated us like beggars. They ain't gonna get away with that easily.
npc.topic.asarr.12: You've already robbed one diamond and brought it back to me. You don't hafta prove yourself worthy anymore.
npc.topic.asarr.13: How do ya think we handle those little vermins? We simply let them do the biggest part of our job, distract the villagers' attention. Why would we bother ourselves wtih them? They have tried to bypass our caves, but they surely do not have your skills. Goblin scouts occasionally find their way into our camp, but will never successfully find it unless they come with their entire army.
npc.topic.asarr.14: You did a good job fetching one of Lord Sunrock's precious diamonds. When one of my associate will deem you ready, he or she will tell you to come back to me and then, I'll be able to teach you some pretty neat tricks.
npc.topic.asarr.15: You did a good job fetching one of Lord Sunrock's precious diamonds. When one of my associate will deem you ready, he or she will tell you to come back to me and then, I'll be able to teach you some pretty neat tricks.
npc.topic.asarr.16: Before I trust you, you will have to do a "job" for me. Heh heh heh...
npc.topic.asarr.17: I already gave that useless rock to somebody else.
npc.topic.asarr.18: Yeah, yeah, I've already told you all I know about him.
npc.topic.asarr.19: I'd like you to deliver something to Lord Sunrock for me. You see, I like to taunt him once in a while and tell him what crime we're about to do. It drives him nuts because his troops are too inept to stop us. Would you do this for me?
npc.topic.asarr.2: Be careful with what ya ask, but I will tell you my name. Asarr, leader of all these "brigands".
npc.topic.asarr.20: Don't get lost on your way out.
npc.topic.asarr.5: The Shadow Guild? No, that's not us, it's what we're part of. Its headquarters are not on this island, nor on Raven's Dust. I'm the Guild's representative in the Kingdom of Goldmoon.
npc.topic.asarr.6: Why would I have to work when I can steal the wealth of others as easily as I would slay a goblin with my scimitar? Pfah! If I could get "information" about transactions between Lighthaven and Windhowl, I could wreak havoc and gain a fortune quite easily!
npc.topic.asarr.7: I heard the merchants were hiring adventurers to bring a "report" to Lord Sunrock in Windhowl...
npc.topic.asarr.8: Lord Sunrock owns the town of Windhowl. He is selfish and he does not want to share his wealth. But he will... Ah ha ha ha!
npc.topic.asarr.9: We are proud of what we do. We treat the "villagers" of Lighthaven and Windhowl like they have treated us a long time ago.
npc.topic.assystanter.0: I am Assyst Anter, greetings to you from our great town.
npc.topic.assystanter.1: I am in charge of keeping "count" of our soldiers. I also tend to the needs of our army by ordering weapons, armor and anything else our guards might need to accomplish their work.
npc.topic.assystanter.3: I heard she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.assystanter.4: I must say, it has decreased drastically. Moreover, some pirates have tried to rob our port. *sigh* I fear we will have more enemies to deal with in the near future. Fortunately, we still have some great warriors like "Guntertag" or "George" the IIIrd to repel invasions.
npc.topic.assystanter.5: I doubt even a goblin army would be able to defeat such a powerful man. I tell you, he's very dumb and his brain is probably as thick as his biceps, but what a great warrior he is! He once vanquished thirty goblins all by himself and he was still shouting for more. If only his brother, Murmuntag, would come live here instead of Lighthaven.
npc.topic.assystanter.6: It's the other town on the island, probably the one where you come from, I'll wager.
npc.topic.assystanter.7: George the IIIrd is one intelligent guy. After all, he isn't captain of the guards for nothing, you know. He doesn't fight with the brutality that is Guntertag's pride and joy, but he is so skilled that he can defeat just about anyone in a fair duel.
npc.topic.assystanter.8: May luck be with you in your travels.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.0: Say what you have to say. I do not have time for useless chit-chat with you.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.1: I'm known around here as Baldric Silverknife, the part-time "musician" and notable thief. Heh! Heh!
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.11: Well, that's not all I do, but let's face it, it's fun isn't it? heh. I suppose I could "teach" you how if you ask me really nicely.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.12: Hmmm. Perhaps I have something for you. Meet "Doremas" and ask him if his low-life friend "Grimish" has what I require.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.13: Grimish is a goblin and I hate goblins. That's why I leave a fool like "Doremas" to deal with him.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.14: Doremas is but a fool. However, I find him useful at times. That's probably why I didn't cut his throat open.. for the time being anyways.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.15: You're barely making sense. Have you been drinking at Thorbin's filthy tavern or what? If so, you'll have to sober up before talking to me again.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.17: I'm a thief, not an assassin. The only person in town I would think who has the poison lore knowledge would be Elysana Blackrose. Stay out of troubles and remember... I've never seen you.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.19: Shhh! If the town guards hear you say his name, you will find yourself spending the remaining of your life in the "prison" of Silversky.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.20: I think Lord Bane has some but you'd be foolish to steal one from him nor do I want to be associated with you if you do such a thing.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.22: If you insist, I will tell you what I know but you must keep your voice low lest we want to get caught and executed by the royal guards for treason. "Blackblood" is the leader of the "Nightblades".
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.23: The Nightblades are a "group" of assassins recruited and trained by Blackblood himself. They combine the swift death of a dagger covered with lethal poison and the various offensive spells, they are the best assassins you will find around.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.24: To be able to enter into their organization, one must do the Test. Only those who succeed are accepted. I never did the Test thus I cannot really say what it is exactly. Only "Blackblood" knows. The "Nightblades" have sworn on their life and soul that they will never give any information regarding the Test to anyone.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.25: How should I know? Ask a Nightblade.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.26: "Kalir" and "Jamar" are often wandering in the desert. Quite frankly, I do not have a clue how they do it or for what purpose.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.27: Kalir and Jamir are both fools.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.28: Zhakar is an insane old wizard who lives secluded in his tower.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.3: Hmmm, I can tell you for a price. Are you willing to pay?
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.4: Well, I am quite a talented artist. I excell at the flute and the "drum" mostly. However, I can assure you that my voice is quite excellent as well.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.5: Yes, I enjoy playing the drum. Uhh? You want my drum? For what purpose? You don't know, eh? I betcha that old Thorbin is up to something. It doesn't bother me at all as he cannot truly understand art as well as I do. And also, I don't mind giving one of my drums as I have plenty of them in store. *smile* Now, let's get down to business. If you want the drum, you'll have to do a little "something" for me.
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.6: Oh, geez! You've found a blood dagger and a gleaming shard? I am truly impressed by your well hidden talents. Do you want to give me the blood dagger and the gleaming shard?
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.7: Good luck finding one. I never said it would be easy to get this drum out of me. Heh! Heh!
npc.topic.baldricsilverknife.8: Listen up, buddy! You'll laugh when I tell you the simple task you have to do for me. You simply have to kill 10 of Rondy's pigs.
npc.topic.balork.0: I am Balork, servant of the "darkness".
npc.topic.balork.1: Whatever I spend my time doing, it is none of your concern.
npc.topic.balork.2: Heh, you're going to see a lot of it very soon.
npc.topic.balork.3: You still owe me some blood, worm.
npc.topic.balork.4: Aaah, now these are words to my liking. Perhaps you would like to join the darkness? I could use some help in undermining the authority of the priests who dwell above me. Would you accept such a mission?
npc.topic.balork.5: Shh! This you must whisper only to my ally, Kalastor.
npc.topic.balork.6: You will have to find somebody else to forge you a Gloomblade for I will not.
npc.topic.balork.7: Farewell, worm. If you haven't done so already, meet Kalastor on the surface.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.1: That's better. You learn quite fast. This is good for it could save your sorry life.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.10: Arakas is an island located north from here. The brigand leader "Asarr" controls everything up there.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.11: It has been a while since we have met.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.12: Baldric Silverknife would do well to not interfere with us.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.13: Even the orc leader and its allies won't stand in my way!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.14: He is the only one around here I truly trust.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.15: Who cares about the desert? Surely not me!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.16: The royal crown shall be mine someday.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.17: You're standing on it, you maggot-pie!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.18: I have heard of these fairy-tales told to frighten the farmers. May all the fools on "Raven's" "Dust" consider me as the Harbinger.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.19: If the "Harbinger" ever shows up, he'll have to face ME.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.2: If you must talk to me, do it properly! I am "Lord" "Bane"!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.20: You've met with Jarko, haven't you? He is but a weakling. His little dabbling with necromancy is nothing compared to the raw power of my offensive spells.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.21: This old wizard can cause me some headaches. Although I rarely admit any weaknesses of mine, mainly because I have few, I must say that Zhakar's knowledge in the arcane arts is much more pronounced than mine. He could be a real threat to my plans...
npc.topic.baneblackblood.22: This is the name of our world.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.23: This is where the castle of King Theodore XIII is located.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.24: I rarely send "nightblades" for they sometimes do not return...
npc.topic.baneblackblood.25: And you think I'll reveal them to you? You must be a FOOL!
npc.topic.baneblackblood.26: Have you been cursed by that Balork? Are you feeling ill? Do I care? No. Quit mumbling about your problems or you'll get more.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.27: Ho-Ho! If Artherk, the god of healing and mending, does not approve of my actions, then why doesn't he stop me?
npc.topic.baneblackblood.28: I think you deserve a lesson.

npc.topic.baneblackblood.4: Bane Blackblood is the name. And soon, you and everyone shall bow down before me when you will hear it.
npc.topic.baneblackblood.5: I don't have a clue about what you are talking about.

npc.topic.baneblackblood.8: Aah, finally, you are back, %s! You have brought me the two components I need? Do you agree to give me a pouch of blue cohosh and a manastone?
npc.topic.baneblackblood.9: Lighthaven is a small town in the northern "Arakas".
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.0: My name's Bastien Milandra. I "work" here. I know I look big, but would you believe I'm only twelve?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.1: Um... Well, I don't do much, I just "help" folks around this town. Y'know, I have great magical powers. D'you believe me?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.2: Oh, sure, I could help you! Did I ever tell you my mother was a "Seraph" and she taught me all sorts of neat things. You believe me, right?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.3: Yes, my mom's a Seraph. She has nice wings now. Have you seen her?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.4: Hey, you got one of my mom's keys! But awww, it's broken. Want me to fix it?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.5: I like nice people. I like it when people believe me. I don't lie, y'know?
npc.topic.bastienmilandra.6: AAAAH! You said a bad word!

npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.1: I am a holy "paladin" who watches over the land.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.10: The god of the night, Ogrimar, represents terror and chaos but he is also an unlikely ally in the war versus to Makrsh P'Tangh. In fact, some of his "disciples" are gathering followers to launch an assault against the lich itself.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.11: One of his disciples, "Mordenthal", is a dark knight who resides in northern Stoneheim. He is extremely deceitful and must not be trusted.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.12: He is a dark knight and was once foremost amongst the great generals in Ogrimar's army. Even as we speak, he is recruiting followers of the dark path to further his master's "cause".
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.13: The god Ogrimar seeks the demise of the Dark One. It is also our main concern, as followers of Artherk. %s, I'll make this short for both you and I. You have been granted the title of Champion of Light back in Raven's Dust. It is now time to "fulfill" your destiny and prove that you are indeed worthy of this honor.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.14: The first step toward the fulfillment of your destiny is to become a "Lightbringer" of Artherk.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.15: Lightbringer, it is time for you to learn about the "task" that has to be done.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.16: The task that is set for you is no small one. You will have to "vanquish" the Dark One, Makrsh P'Tangh himself!
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.17: Even though this seems nearly impossible, do not despair. There are many others that have been charged with the same task as you. However, even though Mordenthal and his underlings are also trying to defeat the Dark One, they are *not* to be trusted. They will do everything within their power to thwart your own advance. If one of Mordenthal's pupils were to succeed in stopping the lich, the dark knight would be exalted into Ogrimar's most favored disciple. You will, of course, have to gather much power before you are capable of confronting him. You must first find the location of his "stronghold" and that alone will prove to be a most difficult endeavor. Nevertheless, I'm certain that if you strive hard enough to better yourself, you will prevail.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.18: There is one who would know of its location, but he cannot be found on this plane of existence. He is known as the "oracle".
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.19: The oracle resides in its own realm, a place rumored to be nearly inaccessible. It is a being of immense power, yet not allowed to interfere in the affairs of gods and the normal course of events. To reach his plane, you will need the "Key" "of" "Artherk".
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.2: I follow the path of Light set for me by my god, "Artherk".
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.20: Now that you have fought many perils to obtain this key and proved your worthiness, all that is left is to find the "Chamber" "of" "Providence" and enter the portal that will lead you to your destiny.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.21: You may have seen it while wandering. It is a great "fortress" surrounded by a body of water located in the center of Stoneheim.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.22: I say so because there is no apparent point of entry. However, with the Key of Artherk one may be able to enter the "portal" located inside the "Chamber" "of" "Providence".
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.23: Now that you have fought many perils to obtain this key and proved your worthiness, all that is left is to find the "Chamber" "of" "Providence" and enter the portal that will lead you to your destiny.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.24: The chamber is located on a well hidden island to the east near the Sunken Woods forest. There lies a path below the surface of the water, and one can walk on it as if walking on the water itself. The pathway is marked by two spires. Once you step through the "portal", you will arrive in the Oracle's realm. I cannot tell you anything beyond this point because I have never been there myself.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.25: You already have the Key of Artherk. All that is left is to find the Chamber of Providence and enter the portal.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.26: You already have the Key of Artherk. All that is left is to find the Chamber of Providence and enter the portal.

npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.29: You already have the Key of Artherk, you have no need for the soul.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.3: Since the past few thousand years, there has been one who's evil power has grown steadily. Since a balance has to be kept, what is gained must be lost somewhere. So great his power has become that he poses a serious "threat" to everybody, even to Artherk himself.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.30: Stonecrest is located to the north.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.31: Stoneheim is the name of this island.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.32: He is the god of peace and represents truth and compassion. Alas, his power has "dwindled" over the years.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.33: There is no need for such hostility.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.34: Return from the hole you crawled from, spawn of darkness!
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.35: I have no answer for this.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.4: I would rather not discuss this with you, if you don't mind. Individuals of your ilk disgust me.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.5: If you would assist me, I could use some "Rings" "of" "the" "Lion". King Aedenas Gravesoul, ruler of the Centaurs, should have some, but you might need to give him something in return.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.6: The "Dark" "One" has to be destroyed no matter what, as he will stop at nothing to gain whatever power he can have.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.7: The one I am referring to is none other than "Makrsh" "P'Tangh", the elven lich.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.8: The elven Lich's power has grown steadily over the past few thousand years. His strength is so great that it rivals that of the gods themselves. Fortunately, Artherk is not the sole god to be affected by the "uprise" of Makrsh P'Tangh.
npc.topic.beltiganwhitesword.9: The uprise of the Dark One has also left the foul "Ogrimar", god of the night, partially drained of his powers as well.

npc.topic.brotherharforr.2: I am a priest of "Artherk". I consider myself very lucky to be part of those who devote their lives to helping others in the name of our god. What about you, stranger? Perhaps I could help you by "healing" your wounds or by setting your "sanctuary" place into our beautiful temple, right here in Windhowl.
npc.topic.brotherharforr.3: Pray for Artherk, my friend, for you have been cursed by the foul Balork. Whenever he is defeated, he brands yet another victim, hoping to own his or her soul in the abyss. He then returns from his demonic plane to plague us again with his malevolent presence.
npc.topic.brotherharforr.4: Young, lovely Annabelle, how we miss her! She could heal the sick and comfort the downtrodden. She would hear your plight and help you, no doubt. If she were still alive, that is.
npc.topic.brotherharforr.5: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.

npc.topic.brotherharforr.8: May Artherk protect you in your travels.

npc.topic.brotherkiran.10: Artherk is the god I will worship all my life. His followers have the task of helping anyone they can and aid those in need. npc.topic.brotherkiran.3: I am called Brother Kiran. I have followed the path of "Artherk" for many years now.

npc.topic.brotherniuss.5: Artherk will protect you as much as he will be able to.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.0: I am Brother Thorkas. I am pleased to make your acquaintance.

Blessed be Artherk, he has also given me the Gift of "sanctuary" and the ability to create "holy" "water".
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.10: Artherk is the god of healing and mending. It is He who we praise in this small temple. Unfortunately, we have been the target of thieves recently. Sadly, they have been able to steal numerous of our precious golden "chalices".
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.11: Why do we suffer? That is not ours to know the reason why. Fortunately, I have the power to "heal" your wounds. Once, I tried to heal a poor warrior but alas failed. Yet, this was not in vain for it soothed the pain. Why am I telling you this? Simply to make you understand that failures are not always what they seem. Sometimes, they must be to teach you who you really are.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.12: Making stony pathways smoother by a gentle word or deed is all what you need to follow the path of worthiness.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.13: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.

npc.topic.brotherthorkas.15: Do not speak hastily for your anger darkens what you say.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.16: You are always welcome in our humble temple.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.17: It is always unfortunate to face death, but those who wear a Gem of Destiny can set a "Sanctuary" where they will reappear when they get killed.

npc.topic.brotherthorkas.6: I do not have enough information about the previous events. Perhaps the elves or the dwarves might know something... if they still exist on this plane.
