npc.topic.brotherthorkas.8: A magic ring you say? Let me see... ACK! This ring is EVIL! I will have nothing to do with it! You had best take it back to wherever you found it or whoever told you to come here.
npc.topic.brotherthorkas.9: She is a well-known criminal on Raven's Dust. I do not mingle with such evil people.
npc.topic.captainharockharr.0: I am Harock Harr, the greatest Sailor of all time! Har! I have "stories", I tell you, that you would never believe, but they're as true as I am here! Har!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.1: What kind of question is this? Har! I have "sailed" many seas and fought beasts as big as the entire village. I am a captain.
npc.topic.captainharockharr.10: Hardy har har! To this day, no fight like that had even been fought before. Dozens of sharks, fifty meters long, sometimes more, attacked me! My hands were even tied behind my back, for I had just been thrown out into the sea by pirates. I had to fight each and every one of those sharks with my teeth. Har! Blood was spilled I can tell ya! Har! har! I nearly lost an arm, but with my extraordinary fighting skills, I vanquished those overgrown sharks and swam back ashore with only one leg left and my hands still tied up! Har!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.2: Har! By my grandfather's rotting wooden leg! Balork's curse is just a fairy tale, methinks. I have fought beasts that are much stronger than that weakling. Har!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.3: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.captainharockharr.4: I have sailed across all the seas and oceans, and I even went to the end of the world! Har! But to this day, I have never been able to find a flying ship to go farther.
npc.topic.captainharockharr.5: Hardy Har har! Be forewarned, for that these stories be real, says I! Which one do you wish to hear, eh? The story of the giant "squid" or when I battled a giant "whale"? Or maybe the time I caught a twelve meter long "trout"! Har! Har! Maybe I ought to tell you about when I "drank" the whole ocean to help one of my crew members from drowning! Hardy Har har! Or my personal favorite story: when I dove in water full of twenty meter, har!, make it forty meter long "sharks", to reach an undersea treasure!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.6: The sea was angry on that day, I'm tellin' ya! The waves were high and the wind was blowing so hard that giant whales were flying by. Har! But I had a map to the secret location of a squid that had gold in its belly! Har! It took great courage and leadership to brave such a dreadful day. The squid finally decided to come out of its hideout to attack our great ship. I took my favorite harpoon and without thinking about my own life, I charged at the squid. Har! Oh, but you seem in a hurry... Do ya want to know the rest of the story? Har!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.7: Har! This be the story of my life! Har! I was hunting for a great white whale that had twice before foiled me in combat. I survived, but not before the giant beast had taken one of my legs along with it. Revenge was the only thing I could think of for many years after that. Har! Well... actually, it is quite a long story, but suffice it to say, I vanquished this great, twenty-meter long raging white whale in a fight that shook the whole sea!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.8: Har! You don't believe me? I was fishing one day aboard my great vessel and some giant beast grabbed my hook. For thirty days and nights I tried relentlessly to get it out of the water, leading to the greatest battle of all time between man and beast! Har! Har! And finally, I succeeded in taking this giant thirteen-meter trout out of the sea by making it believe the air was better than the water! Ya know what? The beast actually believed me! Har! Har! I really AM a genius! Har!
npc.topic.captainharockharr.9: Har! This be a great story, my friend. One day, while me and my crew had just vanquished a bunch of pirates, one of my crewmembers was drunk from the festivities of our great victory and tripped on the bridge, falling into the deep, dark sea. Har! har! As a good captain, I had the obligation of saving the lad. Without consideration for my personal safety, I jumped in the sea, and in one big gulp, I drank it all up! Har har! The crewman then boarded my ship, and I spat out the entire ocean. We then sailed safely back home and were in time for dinner. Hardy har har! What a story eh?
npc.topic.captainironleg.0: I am the great Captain Ironleg. In my youth, I have fought pirates and thieves with my unbreakable "cutlass". I tell ya, nothing could have stopped me then.
npc.topic.captainironleg.1: I am too old to sail for adventures nowadays. Instead, I teach the apprentice sailors about the ways of sailing. I am proud to say that I was the teacher of Corsair Leodwald, my best student ever.
npc.topic.captainironleg.10: If I'd be younger, I would make you walk the plank into the sea!
npc.topic.captainironleg.2: Corsair Leowald is a very talented young sailor who shall go far on the sea.
npc.topic.captainironleg.3: You want to see my iron leg? It's a great piece indeed. Oh, I know, it's a bit rusty but it is still strong enough to support most of my weight. I looted it from the corpse of a pirate I slew with my "cutlass".
npc.topic.captainironleg.4: You want to see my iron leg? It's a great piece indeed. Oh, I know, it's a bit rusty but it is still good enough. I looted it from the corpse of a pirate I slew with my "cutlass".
npc.topic.captainironleg.5: Like I said lad, this cutlass saved my life numerous times. Aye, I even fought sharks with it.
npc.topic.captainironleg.6: Harr... I'm not the har-har type ya know laddie!
npc.topic.captainironleg.7: I heard you can drown in a desert too. Ha!
npc.topic.captainironleg.8: The sea is always hungry. She can eat "ships" and their crew all day long.
npc.topic.captainironleg.9: Ah lad! I see you're interested in boats. Sadly, King Theodore does not think it's that important to keep the vessels in good condition.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.0: Hi! What can I do for you?
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.1: Indeed, Celestina Waterbreeze is my name.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.10: The Nightblades are the elite assassins of "Bane" "Blackblood".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.11: Bane Blackblood is a mad man. I have heard rumors that he even has spies lurking from inside the castle of "King" "Theodore".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.12: I do not care about King Theodore because he doesn't care for us either.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.13: The Order of Nature is dedicated to the well-being of nature.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.14: Yrian Earthsong is an elder druid who founded the "Order" "of" "Nature".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.15: I do not think it was a good idea to create the Stone of Life for its powers could be used for evil.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.16: Dunikus Hornwind is also a druid and he lives in northern Arakas with his mentor, "Yrian" "Earthsong". Like my brother, I teach what "knowledge" I can pass on to anyone I meet.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.17: You've found two flasks of crystal water for my dying tree? You have done well, %s. Do you agree to give these to me?
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.18: Well, if you are interested, I can teach you how to cast certain "spells".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.19: I will teach you what I can.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.2: I am Celestina Waterbreeze, sister of "Dunikus" "Hornwind".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.20: The desert is a desolated landscape where rare are those who can survive.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.21: Ravenwood is a dark forest where "Bane" "Blackblood"'s "nightblades" are scattered. You may also encounter dangerous "demon" "trees" who possess incredible magical powers.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.24: Be careful! We cannot assure your protection out of our sanctuary.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.3: I do everything that has to be done. Since we are a small community, we have to stick together and share the chores if we want to survive. Currently, I am trying to save this little "tree". As a druid, I feel that it is my duty to protect nature no matter what.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.4: Oh, yes, now I remember, you mean the key I got after trading with Tobias! I'd completely forgotten about it! Well, is this what you've come to get from me?
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.5: This herb is extremely hard to find. You can only find it in the Cave of Fear, where lies the corpse of King Theopold.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.6: I am afraid I do not know where you could find that.
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.7: Key? I'm not sure what you're talking about...
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.8: The demon trees are the exact opposite of the "Forest" "Guardians".
npc.topic.celestinawaterbreeze.9: The Forest Guardians are working with us to protect nature from being harmed.
npc.topic.celydia.0: I am Celydia, a faithful "servant" of our good king.
npc.topic.celydia.1: Tell me if there is anything I can do for you.
npc.topic.celydia.2: I am at his majesty's service. As one of his servants, I must do my best to provide him with whatever he wishes for.
npc.topic.celydia.3: Oh, wait, now that I think about it, I remember seeing one such key on the king's desk a few years ago. It was very, very ornate, and caught my attention. I remember it well because a few days later, the king was furious at the loss of a precious family heirloom... I never saw the key after that. I think the king mentioned that a thief calling himself  "Reynen" "Aspicdart" had signed his burglary.
npc.topic.celydia.4: I don't know where that rogue is hiding now. You'll have to ask around town, maybe someone's seen him lately.
npc.topic.celydia.5: I really must get on with my duties... unless there is something more you want to ask me.
npc.topic.celydia.6: He is good, but also very demanding. It is a good thing I am not his only aid, because I don't think I could ever keep up.
npc.topic.celydia.7: I'm afraid I can't very well keep an eye on everyone that enters the castle.
npc.topic.celydia.8: Farewell, and don't get lost inside the castle.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.0: I am Chamberlain Thomar. I manage the daily affairs of this castle. Not a thing happens here that I do not know about. How may I help you?
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.1: I work here as chamberlain of the castle. I attend all domestic matters within the castle. One could say I am the eyes and ears of these walls. I am also the one you must ask if you wish an "audience" with our good king.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.10: I hope you are not thinking ill of our great king!
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.11: You must be a "Champion" "of" "Light" else I will not help you.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.12: Champions of Light are individuals who have sworn to uphold the good cause. Only a select few are worthy of this title, and I am one of those who can bestow it upon you. In order to become such a person, you must "swear" "fealty" by taking an "Oath" "of" "Worthiness".
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.13: You've already taken the oath of worthiness, %s.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.14: You do not need my approval, you can already have an audience with our king.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.15: You have already completed the quest I had set for you.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.17: Be well. May Artherk protect you.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.2: The poor princess is most distraught, lately. You see, her mentor, Bishop Rikken Crowbanner, has fallen deathly ill, and she has become very quiet and depressed as a result. Perhaps I could help you?
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.3: You can find that herb somewhere in a deep, deep dungeon, I hear. The trick is finding someone who'll tell you which one, when to go, etc. Sadly, I cannot help you with that.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.4: A very holy man, he is. All priests and priestesses under his tutelage demonstrate the utmost loyalty to him and his ideals. That is a rare thing, nowadays.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.5: An interesting tale you spin. It means little to me, however.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.6: Monsignore Damien is a most evil man, I'm told. Someone once told me he was still alive, hiding in some hold and biding his time until he could exact his revenge. I'm a little unclear as to the details, I'm afraid.
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.8: This is terrible! Bishop Crowbanner is ill again! This MUST stop!
npc.topic.chamberlainthomar.9: There are so few noble people, nowadays...
npc.topic.chieftainthorwagth.1: Werk? Me no werk like liddle hummie, me barsh skulls guud.
npc.topic.chieftainthorwagth.2: Me gonna do guud hummie stew wit yew flesh!
npc.topic.chieftainthorwagth.3: Me nut have one, but da Khan, he knowz.
npc.topic.chieftainthorwagth.4: Thorwagth giv all me skulls to hummie in hummietown. He giv guud reword.
npc.topic.chieftainthorwagth.5: Guud. Me bash skull if hummie stey longger.
npc.topic.chieftainyahgwuhl.1: Me werk is tew barsh meen skraugs frum odder tribe and smash hummie skulls wen dey try tew hert us.
npc.topic.chieftainyahgwuhl.2: Me nut know, ask da Khan. He has dem, he does.
npc.topic.chieftainyahgwuhl.3: Yaghwuhl had sum, but dey gone now. Yaghwuhl take dem tew "hummie".
npc.topic.chieftainyahgwuhl.4: Yaghwuhl go far tru forest an giv da skullz tew da hummie inside gate.
npc.topic.chieftainyahgwuhl.5: No wun ebber sey dat tew Yaghwuhl! Me gonna SMASH yer skull!
npc.topic.chiefwuuthgoran.0: Oy's calld Wuuthgoran, da king of us KAHP LETH!!!
npc.topic.chiefwuuthgoran.1: Wuuthgoran da biggess, da strongess, da smathess  skraugz of dem oll!
npc.topic.chiefwuuthgoran.3: Me nutt gonna miss yew. Hummie week.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.0: I am known as Chryseida Yolangda, the wandering "gypsy".
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.1: I wander around the world in "search" of kindred spirits. I can also "foretell" your future, but only once an hour.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.10: Althea is the name of the world in which we live in.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.11: Raven's Dust is an island located south of "Arakas". I am sure that you've already visited it.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.12: There are six collectors on Stoneheim: Headhunter Wajpoothin, Khan Wulgworth, Grant Hornkeep, King Aedenas Gravesoul, Beltigan Whitesword and Mordenthal. If you ask them nicely, perhaps they'll send you on a quest to help them with their collections.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.13: Arakas is located somewhere to the north of "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.14: Have you ever heard such a thing as a gypsy curse?
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.16: I fear I see... nothing. Perhaps I can try again, if you *really* need a "hint"?
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.17: You need %u more levels and %u more intelligence to learn search.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.18: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.2: This title bears a lot of incomfort to the townspeople but I can assure you that I am no thief nor a charlatan.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.3: Let me look into it... I see nothing!
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.4: Why yes, I have some of those. I might also have a few items of interest to you. Feel free to browse through them.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.5: I might have a few items of interest to you. Feel free to browse through them.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.6: I can't help you find him, but I'm sure you don't need me to tell you where he is. Simply follow your heart and you should be able to find him.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.7: Let's see what you have to sell then.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.8: Well, wandering the country like this, I have developed an uncanny ability to discover what is "hidden", be it objects left by thieves, or animals trying to hide themselves from me. If you wish, I could "teach" you this ability, for a price.
npc.topic.chryseidayolangda.9: Yes, there is one that I know who has a knack for hiding things. We used to play hide and go seek when we were but little children, although he would never tell you that. It has been a long time since I have heard from him though, and I doubt he would remember me. His name was Meltar. If you ever see him, ask him to teach you how to hide.
npc.topic.colosseumclerk.1: Yes that's what I said, Darvis.
npc.topic.colosseumclerk.2: I am the caretaker as well as the chief operator of this "arena". I will gladly answer any questions you may have about the "colosseum". All complaints will promptly be ignored.
npc.topic.colosseumclerk.3: The arena is used by adventurers of all levels to better hone their skills in "battle", as well as the occasional "battle" "token".
npc.topic.colosseumclerk.4: Whenever an opponent is slain, there is a chance it will drop a battle token. The harder your opponent is relatively to you, the more chances you have of receiving a token. These tokens can then be traded in for temporary ability enhancements before each fight.
npc.topic.colosseumclerk.5: The goal of the arena is simple: "fight" monsters, kill monsters, then fight more monsters and so on.
npc.topic.colosseumclerk.6: Each time you enter the arena, a level of difficulty is attributed to you based on your level of experience. Every fight's difficulty is based on this level. Before each fight, you will have the opportunity to either raise, lower or leave the level of difficulty as is. Once you have set the level for the fight, you will be asked how many opponents you wish to fight at the same time. This can be either one, two or three opponents. Once you have chosen, all purchased ability enhancements will be activated and the battle will begin. After each fight, you will be given the opportunity to spend your battle tokens, provided you have accumulated enough, to purchase additional ability enhancements. With that said, I believe you are ready to "fight".
npc.topic.colosseumclerk.7: Whoa! Not so fast! There are certain "procedures" you will have to learn about before I will let you fight.
npc.topic.colosseumclerk.8: Will you be "leaving" the arena or are you ready to "fight"?
npc.topic.colosseumclerkxp.1: Yes that's what I said, Darvis.
npc.topic.colosseumclerkxp.2: I am the caretaker as well as the chief operator of this "arena". I will gladly answer any questions you may have about the "colosseum". All complaints will promptly be ignored.
npc.topic.colosseumclerkxp.3: The arena is used by adventurers of all levels to better hone their skills and gain valuable experience in "battle", as well as the occasional "battle" "token".

npc.topic.colosseumowner.1: What can I do for you?
npc.topic.colosseumowner.2: I am the owner of two magnificent establishments. One is called the famed "colosseum" while the other one is called the "battleground".
npc.topic.colosseumowner.3: In the colosseum, fighters of all rank and caliber come to "test" their abilities against powerful creatures. However, if you don't feel like fighting, it is possible to become a "spectator".
npc.topic.colosseumowner.4: Unlike the "colosseum", the battleground does not allow creatures. It is a dreadful place where there are *NO* rules. No matter what rank you are, if you "fight" in the battleground, you can be slain by *ANY* other gladiators. However, if you don't feel like fighting, it is possible to become a "spectator".
npc.topic.colosseumowner.5: So, you want to become a spectator?
npc.topic.colosseumowner.6: Well, you do look like you can handle yourself. Would you like to enter one of my arenas and try your fighting skills?
npc.topic.corsairmagere.0: I am Leodwald but I ask of my men to call me Corsair Leodwald.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.10: I am not of the har-har generation. Oh, I almost forgot... I hate parrots!
npc.topic.corsairmagere.11: Ah, now *there's* a lovely lass! All curves and spunk, just like I like 'em wenches! I hear she's the reason why that moron Monsignore Damien fell from grace in the church. She told me all about how she framed him, and that was pretty shrewd, let me tell you. If you ever meet that idiot Damien, you just ask him about "Shadeen".
npc.topic.corsairmagere.12: Captain Ironleg taught me everything I know. He does not deserve all the credits however. I have trained myself day and night to become the man I am. I am proud today to say that my swordsman skills are unmatched in all "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.corsairmagere.13: Raven's Dust has many dangerous reefs surrounding it. Our boats often get damaged by them. Some of our crewmen are not very much experienced.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.14: I usually carry a cutlass and a small dagger. You never know what could happen in these troubled times.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.15: You're unworthy to speak to me. Out of my sight at once!
npc.topic.corsairmagere.16: Fine! I have work to do.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.2: Not Leowald you hammerhead! It's Corsair Leodwald!
npc.topic.corsairmagere.3: We do not encounter many pirates these days. Mainly because our fleet is not "suitable" to sail right now.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.4: As I have said, I am Corsair Leodwald and my duty is to lead the royal fleet of our *ugh* "Majesty".
npc.topic.corsairmagere.5: Aye, "King" "Theodore" does not want to invest gold pieces for the restoration of our old vessels.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.6: King Theodore is unworthy of the royal throne but I will serve him no matter the circumstances.
npc.topic.corsairmagere.7: The kingdom of Goldmoon is ruled so-to-speak by "King" "Theodore".
npc.topic.corsairmagere.8: Count on Harock Harr for exagerating everything.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.0: The letter was a necessary precaution. You see, I could not contact you directly because of all the parties involved. You probably have hundreds of questions and we will come around to them in time. For now though, let us start from the "beginning".
npc.topic.crimsonscale.1: You are what we call a New Breed, a child born with the pain of his predecessors. The Nameless Bard was one such child... he too, was "chosen".
npc.topic.crimsonscale.10: After the Battle of Emanations, the eight most powerful dragons that remained banded together to form the council. We exist now to watch and guard places like this one. Some of us have already guided you in your journey. Take the gypsy, for example. She is one of us as well.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.11: When we destroyed the Harvesters of Life, we vowed never to kill another of our kind. Olin Haad is a dragon after all, and as much as it pains my heart to say it, we must "prevent" him from summoning Gluriurl. That's why I implore you to help us.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.12: Without further delay, you must travel to the "Great" "Library" of Althea. You must search within its walls to find the true reason behind Olin Haad's raid on Lighthaven. Once you find it, you must confront him with it. Now, I have "something" to give you that will help you on the rest of your journey.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.13: The Great Library of Althea is somewhere on this island. You should ask around at the temple of Silversky if you do not know of its location. Before you go, I have "something" to give you.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.14: This is a vial of my blood... when you are ready, consume it and you will feel something change inside of you. Also, this Armlet of Flames will come in handy I am certain. This is just my way of helping you face the trials ahead.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.16: I watch over the lesser races. No matter what happens, balance must always be preserved.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.2: In our Dharma, it is said that in the wake of a lost god, his children will awake and will demand to be avenged. When Lothar the Just died, "Justice" "died" along with him.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.3: When Gluriurl duped the elves, they received no justice from the Harbinger. They were simply destroyed. When the dwarves mistook the Harbinger for Gluriurl resurrected, they received no "justice" either.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.4: We have stayed silent since the beginning of time, removed from the influence of the gods. But there was a day when even dragons could not remain idle... a day when the "winds" threatened the very existence of Althea.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.5: The screams of the dying were so many that they woke us from our slumber. This is when we decided to intervene, to take action against the evil that was unraveling the threads of our existence. That day was called the "Battle" "of" "Emanations".
npc.topic.crimsonscale.6: Ironically, the ranks of the enemy were mostly made up of the ancient races that the corrupted one called Makrsh P'Tangh had ammased in his own army. He wanted to bring back the same god who had caused the downfall of his own kind. When we destroyed his Harvesters of Life, he withdrew from the battlefield and escaped with "Olin" "Haad".
npc.topic.crimsonscale.7: Olin Haad was one of us when we attacked the Harvesters of Life. He was doing so well that I decided to give him the responsibility of keeping the Skull of Gluriurl. For some reason I cannot explain, he was "fascinated" with the Skull.
npc.topic.crimsonscale.8: He began to develop powers that are very akin to that of gods. He started to become arrogant, and even hostile when things did not go the way he wished them to. Eventually, we decided not to include him in our council meetings... shortly after that, he "changed" "sides".
npc.topic.crimsonscale.9: Olin Haad is responsible for the death of hundreds of our allies and brethren. We of the "Council" "of" "the" "Eight" need your help to defeat him. Regardless of whether you pray to Ogrimar or Artherk, we need your "help".
npc.topic.custodian.0: This library is exclusively for scholars. It's because of "uneducated" people like you that books don't last forever. I will not tolerate your presence any longer.
npc.topic.custodian.1: Alright, so you think you're smart huh? Let's see if you can pass the "Rite" "of" "Passage" then.
npc.topic.custodian.2: "Dos" "vaneslae" "navidal", "Kadrim" "lok" "ungrim" "dok", "Somalina" "oundi" "inesora", "Tharrgra" "nethdrovar". If you can tell me what it means, then not only will I grant you access to the top floor, but I might actually be nice about it. Oh, and here's a hint. You don't stand a chance at solving this little puzzle if you don't visit the library's basement.
npc.topic.custodian.3: Don't just repeat what I said back at me! I want you to tell me what all this means! These four phrases are the key to passing the Rite of Passage. Tell me what it means or you can forget about ever seeing the upper floor of the library.
npc.topic.custodian.4: Would you like to go up to the fourth floor right now?
npc.topic.custodian.5: I am the custodian of this library.
npc.topic.custodian.6: I make certain the top floor stays clean and in order... and the best way to do that is to keep people like you from going up there!
npc.topic.custodian.7: And not a moment too soon!
npc.topic.dafyd.0: Greetings, I gladly welcome your company in this desolate place.
npc.topic.dafyd.10: I do not like towns all that much, to tell you the truth. I would rather be outside in the wilderness with all the wild beasts than the "simple-minded" people of that city.
npc.topic.dafyd.11: They are so caught up with their petty disputes that they don't even notice the "enemy" is advancing upon them even as we speak.
npc.topic.dafyd.12: Why, the orcs of course! Have you been living in a dungeon all your life? ...Oh dear, please forgive my loss of temper. I tend to become rather hostile when I start to think of the "happenings" of this isle.
npc.topic.dafyd.13: The orcs move ever closer and all the king thinks of doing is sleeping. The people of that town are no better, mind you. All they do is quarrel amongst themselves about whether the king is fit to rule or not. It is a sad thing, I tell you.
npc.topic.dafyd.14: Their numbers are ever increasing, and there is not much anyone can do about it. I imagine they will someday overtake the town, and I pray for a swift death for any who will still be there when it happens.
npc.topic.dafyd.15: I will not tolerate such language from anyone. You should leave now.
npc.topic.dafyd.16: Good luck in your travels, friend.
npc.topic.dafyd.3: I come from a land far from here in search of new and interesting objects to add to my "collection".
npc.topic.dafyd.4: Well, so far I have accumulated a great deal of "weapons" and "armor" of a rather high quality. Unfortunately, I cannot carry everything I own, so I am restrained to bringing only a few weapons.
npc.topic.dafyd.5: As I said before, it is quite impossible for me to carry all of my armor collection without the use of a charriot or wagon of some kind.
npc.topic.dafyd.6: The weapons in my collection are among the very finest you will ever see around these parts.
npc.topic.dafyd.7: What? You wish to buy one of them? Hmm, I don't know about that. I suppose there is no harm in it, I can always find another one. Well, do you want to take a look at what I have?
npc.topic.dafyd.8: Let me take a look at what you have for sale...
npc.topic.dafyd.9: Raven's Dust is the island you are on, friend.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.0: I am Dantalir Songweaver, at your service.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.1: Guilty as charged. I am a bard and a talented one, I might add. I can play almost any musical instruments you can find around.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.10: Grant Hornkeep is an incompetent fool.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.12: I shall see you again later, %s.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.13: You need %u more levels and %u more agility to learn sneak.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.14: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.2: Unfortunately, I've never had the pleasure of having a drum of fate. I heard that there is only one person on Raven's Dust that can craft them.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.3: I got some finely crafted drums from a merchant a long time ago for a very fine price indeed. However, I'm sorry to say that I have absolutely no clue where I've stored them. They should be somewhere around here...
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.4: That is not of your business, pal!
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.6: Once a person is hidden, they can "sneak" behind you and follow you without you ever knowing they were there.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.7: Heh heh, so you want to become a master of the art of silent footsteps, do you? I suppose I could "teach" you since I am in a good mood.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.8: The thieves' hideout is a secret. You must not reveal its location to anyone lest you want us to cut off your tongue.
npc.topic.dantalirsongweaver.9: You see the tall man with the sword over there? That's him.
npc.topic.daranannithae.0: I don't say hello for free nowadays.
npc.topic.daranannithae.1: Yes, that is my name. Lightfoot refers to my fleeing talents.
npc.topic.daranannithae.10: You seem like a reasonable person. I think I can tell a little "secret", just between you and me.
npc.topic.daranannithae.11: You civilized people usually refer to this as "robbing" but I personally prefer long-term borrowing. If they don't notice that you've borrowed something, it probably means they don't need it in the first place. Heh! Heh!
npc.topic.daranannithae.12: Shhh! Keep it down, damnit! You don't want that fool "Hornkeep" to catch m.. us. If you want to "learn" from the master himself, you need only to ask and I'll help you... for a fee, of course.
npc.topic.daranannithae.13: You're not good enough at peeking! If you don't know how to "peek", how can you expect to rob people? Never mind, you're obviously not worth the effort.
npc.topic.daranannithae.14: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.daranannithae.16: That's the name of this island.
npc.topic.daranannithae.17: Stonecrest is the name of the town you're in.
npc.topic.daranannithae.2: The name is Daran Lightfoot, at your service. Hey, you wouldn't know someone who has some "assassin's" "blades", would you? Uhh, guess not. I tell you what... if you ever get your hands on some of these blades, I'd be interested in making a little trade with ya.
npc.topic.daranannithae.20: HEY! You think that's funny, eh? Who are you laughing at! Erm... Well, yeah, I guess it's a little ironic, when you think about it. Well, it's quite a predicament I'm in, as you can see...
npc.topic.daranannithae.21: No, no, don't misunderstand, I'm not her! I only LOOK like her! I'm actually Daran Lightfoot. Um... It'd be a little hard to explain, so let's just pretend this isn't happening, okay?
npc.topic.daranannithae.22: WILL YOU LOOK AT ME?!? It's me, Daran! I know, I look like Annithae, don't remind me! Look, you gotta help me get outta this, 'kay?
npc.topic.daranannithae.23: Look, it's not the right time to talk about the book. Just "help" me, willya!
npc.topic.daranannithae.24: Look, pal, I really need your "help".
npc.topic.daranannithae.25: Yeah, I look like Annithae, let's not dwell on this, 'kay?
npc.topic.daranannithae.3: Mayor Fairweather is the rich bas... man living down the street in a large house he built using the Stonecrest taxes.
npc.topic.daranannithae.4: If you want, I can trade you two of them against a little trinket I have. Interested?
npc.topic.daranannithae.5: I have no idea what door it opens, but perhaps you should ask Chryseida? She's a fortune teller, if anyone can point you in the right direction, she might be it, hm? But I hear her services are very, very expensive, so good luck!
npc.topic.daranannithae.6: The Stonecrest sheriff, Grant Hornkeep, can usually be found patrolling the town's entrance.
npc.topic.daranannithae.7: Guild? What guild are you talking about?
npc.topic.daranannithae.8: You want to learn the location of the Thieves' Guild? I'm afraid I cannot help you with that. You'll have to find it yourself, I guess.
npc.topic.daranannithae.9: You want to learn the location of the Thieves' Guild? I'm afraid I cannot help you with that. You'll have to find it yourself, I guess.

npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.0: Hello! What can I do for you?
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.1: I am known amongst our "order" as Darius Moonglow.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.10: The nightblades sometimes attempt to enter in our sanctuary but the Forest Guardians are able to keep them at bay.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.11: You look like someone who could help me. I need four rare colored gems. I need a red, a green, a yellow and a blue gem. Retrieve them and bring them to me and you shall be rewarded.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.12: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.13: Apples are not as common as in our sister island. That is why we have to sell them at such an expensive price.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.14: Yrian Earthsong is the elder and leader of the druidic "Order" "of" "Nature" located in northern Arakas.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.15: I'm sure you could find a long piece of wood covered with squirrel's oil somewhere that could suit your needs.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.16: It was nice talking to you.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.2: I have many chores to do, we all do if we want to survive as a community. I am currently busy searching for some "gems"...
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.3: The Nature's garb is our ceremonial robes.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.4: The sole purpose of the Order of Nature is to protect the nature around us lest we want it to be destroyed and seal our fate as well.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.5: Our druidic order's name is the "Order" "of" "Nature".
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.6: He is insane and must be stopped.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.7: They are nearly as old as Althea itself and they have great powers.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.8: In case you weren't aware already, this is the name of the world.
npc.topic.dariusmoonglow.9: I don't know much about that. If it's some kind of herb, you should ask Celestina Waterbreeze.
npc.topic.darkfang.0: I am DarkFang. What can I do for you?
npc.topic.darkfang.1: I mind my own business and know the area well.
npc.topic.delnarsteelblade.0: Oh? Have you come to turn in some "skulls"?
npc.topic.delnarsteelblade.1: I collect the skulls of villains from throughout the land. If you ever come upon one, keep it and bring it here. I will reward you well for your efforts.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.0: Be careful, this forest is filled with vile "creatures".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.1: The name's Delvar Irongrip, the strongest warrior on this island, with the possible exception of "Murmuntag". I am a "survivor", I cannot be beaten even in this hostile forest.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.10: The Druids are sworn to protect nature no matter what.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.11: Help? Perhaps I could part with one of my healing "potions".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.12: I've already helped you, remember? I gave you a potion. Now, if you are not able to dwell in the forest by yourself, you should return to "Lighthaven".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.13: The key to survive is to keep yourself healthy. You can bring "potions" or learn techniques to "heal" yourself.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.14: I can treat your minor wounds. I am sorry but I cannot teach you how to mend yourself because I don't have the time. Someday, you'll find somebody who'll be able to.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.15: Artherk? If he is the God his worshippers claim he is, why does he hide in the celestial realm while we need him right here? It is not him who prevents the "goblins" from gaining dominion over the island, it is my sword and I.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.16: If only I could find where he is hiding...
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.17: There are many caverns on this island. Keep an eye for "Jarko"'s caverns because they are filled with undeads and "goblins".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.18: The kingdom of Goldmoon is currently ruled by King Theodore the XIIIth. It encompasses the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.19: Raven's Dust is a small island located southwest of this island. It can only be reached by ship. The castle of King "Theodore" and the town of "Silversky" are also located on that island.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.2: Indeed, hideous creatures such as "goblins" roam in the forest. You might even see "brigands" cowardly hidden in the shadows, waiting for the opportunity to strike a lethal blow in your back and steal your gold.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.20: King Theodore is not worthy of being our king. He doesn't do anything for his kingdom, nor does he seem to care.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.21: I have never gone to Silversky myself, I could not tell you what it's like.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.22: Arakas is the name of this island.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.23: Windhowl is on this island, southwest from here.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.24: I was born and raised in this small town. On the opposite side of the island stands its sister town, "Windhowl".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.25: I could easily break you in half if I wanted to, little one.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.26: It is time to depart, my friend.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.3: I am a mercenary and I have been employed by a few inhabitants of "Lighthaven" to purify this forest of "brigands" and "goblins".
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.4: Some people call it a glum sword, but it's actually a Gloomblade, and it's not very easy to find. I guess you'd have to ask someone who knows more about making swords than I do. I just use them.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.5: Aye, I knew her well, that Annabelle. Lovelier than an Elf -- not that I know what Elves look like, they left this world a long, long time ago. But aye, you'd love to meet her...
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.6: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many like you who walk the land and bear his mark. I tell you, friend, you have to seek Annabelle, blessed her eyes! She'll know what to do.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.7: He is skilled, but he is also an orc. I do not have hatred toward his race despite their dark origins, I simply do not trust him.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.8: I have heard that you have been doing business with them. I must warn you my friend, you are walking a dangerous path.
npc.topic.delvarirongrip.9: I always slay a few after breakfast, it helps my digestion.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.0: I am Derran Ironstrife, warrior dedicated to the protection of our "Majesty".
npc.topic.derranironstrife.1: Yes, I am Derran Ironstrife. I already told you that didn't I? You could have asked me simply by asking me my "name".
npc.topic.derranironstrife.10: It's the island you are currently standing on. We're locating south of Arakas if you did not know already.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.11: How dare you to speak to me like that? I could slice you in two in a swift movement of my arm.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.12: Until we meet again my friend.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.2: King Theopold was King Theodore XIIIth's honorable father.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.4: I am a warrior fighting for the good cause of our King. I also help "train" those who are willing to fight the orc menace. Sometimes, we attack the orcs to prevent their siege weapons from approaching within range of the castle's walls. Sadly, we aren't able to eradicate them once and for all. I heard they often hide in the surrounding "caverns".
npc.topic.derranironstrife.6: I hate those orcs. Their leader, Ghundarg, almost killed me the other day. He cowardly attacked me from behind. Someday, I'll get my revenge...
npc.topic.derranironstrife.7: There are many caverns on the island of Raven's Dust. You should always bring a few torches if you wish to explore them. Oh, and bring a sword, that will prove useful too. Trust me.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.8: I wouldn't dare to go there if I were you.
npc.topic.derranironstrife.9: The Ravenwood forest is not a nice place to wander around. I heard that a woodcutter lives there though.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.0: My name is Dionysus Silverstream. What is yours friend?
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.1: I am here to help you rest your travel-weary bones.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.10: I know she lives in the Nether Isles, but I don't know how to get there. I'm sure someone as resourceful as you wouldn't have a problem finding her, though.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.11: I guess you might want to ask Bastien Milandra. There's a rumor saying he's the son of Glaenshenmilandira herself, although that's a little hard to believe.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.12: You're already taking care of recharging my "Lute" "of" "Peace", right? Don't let me down, I'm counting on you.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.13: The only way to free the trapped souls within them is to shatter their skeletal body, I'm afraid. When you've freed a dozen or more of my kin, I will see to it that you are rewarded. So far, you have liberated %u Centaur(s) from their curse. Please keep up the good work.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.14: With enough of these, you might befriend the "World" "Wild" "Horse". I'm told it's a special, magical horse that can take you around the world! Oh! And be sure to *NOT* tell Malachai Fatebringer that you have them. I'm told it upsets him greatly. You never know what he could do to you just to get them.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.15: This is a rather wonderful horse. If you own enough "Scrolls" "of" "Horse" "Friendship", you may befriend this magical horse and use it to travel all over the world.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.16: A Champion of Light is a person who has decided to follow the path of Light.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.17: To become a Lightbringer, you must be a "Champion" "of" "Light". If you are, then all you have to do is to seek a paladin.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.18: I sense malice deep within your soul. I am afraid that I cannot help you.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.19: I think you can find these corrupted creatures somewhere on Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.2: King Gravesoul is a proud and noble king. His heart is always sad and heavy, though, but most don't notice that. I think he never recovered from the loss of his wife and son.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.20: I think I've seen one of your kind selling these around. I think her name was Chryseida Yolangda.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.21: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.22: You are a dishonor to your race. Flee now lest I summon the guards.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.23: Farewell. May you not stray from the path of Light.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.3: I can't say I like him much, but there are many who believe he should succeed King Gravesoul after his passing. Let us pray this moment doesn't come to pass any time soon.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.4: He and Gladdius protect us from monsters and enemies that might attack us when we sleep.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.5: Don't mind his rough manners, he's a smith, not a socialite. If good weapons and equipment are what you're looking for, then you should talk to him. If it's comfort and counsel, I'd be glad to be of assistance.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.6: There is something very, very wrong and evil with him, but I don't know exactly what it is. Just be careful around him, you never know.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.7: He and Kyathos protect us from monsters and enemies that might attack us when we sleep.
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.8: Should you feel like helping out, you could free the souls of my kin that are trapped in "Skeletal" "Centaurs".
npc.topic.dionysussilverstream.9: Oh, you brought it back already! Thank you so much!
npc.topic.doppelgangerportal1a.0: I created eight of these portals in the hopes that you would find them. You see, your newfound powers granted you by your rebirth did not just come from out of thin air. When you gained those powers, I lost some of mine and it has to "stop"!
npc.topic.doppelgangerportal1a.1: If you step through the portal, it will bring you to a neutral plane where I'm sure we can come to some sort of an agreement. Well, what do you say? Will you meet me on equal terms so that we may find a solution to this problem?
npc.topic.doppelgangerportal1a.2: What? Where are you going? Get back here and finish our business!

npc.topic.doremas.0: I don't see how that concerns you.
npc.topic.doremas.1: Don't tell me you're here for some "training"...
npc.topic.doremas.10: Don't mess around him too much or you'll get thrown in jail. I tell ya, it ain't the kind of place you want to hang around!
npc.topic.doremas.11: You were supposed to rob the bank to create a diversion, numbskull! Do you really wish to abort the plan we so carefully elaborated?
npc.topic.doremas.12: Sure thing, skipper! You are only a
npc.topic.doremas.13: Whatever, just be quick about it!
npc.topic.doremas.15: I'm closing my eyes now, and when I open them you'd better be gone!
npc.topic.doremas.2: I don't know what you're talking about. Only strange person I've seen is you!
npc.topic.doremas.3: You would do best to forget that name...
npc.topic.doremas.4: Zhakar? I swear I never heard that name before! It's not me! I wasn't the one who murde.. erm... Oh! You just want to know if I heard about him? Uh. No, sorry I cannot help you.
npc.topic.doremas.5: He is my... associate but don't you tell this to anybody. If you do jolthead, I'll cut your sticky tongue with this rusted butter knife!
npc.topic.doremas.6: That brain-squashed goblin "scum"! I clearly told him that he was to meet me here! He has the nerve of making me wait here like a dim-witted bastard! AH! Wait until I get my hands on him and I'll show who is the boss around here.
npc.topic.doremas.7: Do I look like I know the safe's combination? I've already told you all this before!! Weren't you listening or what?! Rondy, Geram and Talon Irongaze are the ones you must seek.
npc.topic.doremas.8: If you want to meet him, you'll probably find him crawling on the tavern's floor.
npc.topic.doremas.9: Do not bother me about this pathetic pig-loving farmer.
npc.topic.draconisguardian.0: We half-dragons... were to protect this temple. He somehow knew that... and came prepared with some magic that... that was alien to us. He corrupted my kin and... defeated me. Please, I implore you... I can feel Caledbolg on you... which can only mean that you are... you are the one from the "prophecy".
npc.topic.draconisguardian.1: 'A Traveler who comes from the tears of the past will be sent by the Winds to cleanse the Land of its Wounds. To him the power of Balance will be given...' You are that traveler... the only one that can restore Justice to Althea. You are the one that can stop Olin Haad from bringing corruption to the entire world. You must "stop" him...
npc.topic.draconisguardian.2: Urgh... you must hasten %s for Olin Haad has already made is way inside the "burial" "chamber"... it is only a matter of time before the unthinkable happens...
npc.topic.draconisguardian.3: The portal behind me is the only mean of entering the burial chamber... Please hurry before all is lost... I must rest now...
npc.topic.draconisguardian.5: I am the guardian of Lothar's tomb but alas I failed...
npc.topic.dragon.0: Only other dragons know my ancient name, for I am the greatest dragon of Firesky. You mortals may call me "Darkfang".
npc.topic.dragon.1: How ignorant you can be sometimes, little one. I am a "dragon", I do not have to work as you do. I am my own person.. erm.. dragon! If I am ever hungry, I could always eat you anyway! Fortunately for you, the citizens of this "town" are bringing me enough food to satisfy my appetite.
npc.topic.dragon.10: The measure of a person isn't gold but karma, or worth in your language. The more good deeds you do, the more you attract positive magic. The reverse is also true: a black heart attracts negative magic. Some people will not want to help you if you are too far in one path or another.
npc.topic.dragon.11: Do not EVER speak that word again to me until you are ready.
npc.topic.dragon.12: The world of Althea of course!
npc.topic.dragon.13: Ahh, another mortal come to annoy me with feeble requests. Tell me, what is it you "want"?
npc.topic.dragon.14: Want help? Most people come to me requesting many things. I can only offer a few "gold" pieces or perhaps "heal" your wounds if you wish me to.
npc.topic.dragon.15: What let you think that I have a ruby dragon fang?
npc.topic.dragon.16: I kept some of Scarlet's "ruby" "dragon" "fangs" as souvenirs of this duel.
npc.topic.dragon.17: Ruby dragons are very fond of battle, and that is usually their downfall. Even though they are powerful spell casters, they prefer to dive blindlessly, breathing flames, and ripping foes apart with their talons. I once fought a ruby dragon who was foolish enough to dare challenge me to the death, guess who won?
npc.topic.dragon.18: Scarlet is the "ruby" "dragon" that I fought a long time ago. Let's say that I kept a few "souvenirs" of that fight.
npc.topic.dragon.19: Eat? I do not require food right now.
npc.topic.dragon.2: This is a small human town. It is nothing compared to the Dragon Kingdom, I tell you. This town's name is Lighthaven--how ridiculous! There's even a filthy cemetery with a "crypt" where the dead still walk.
npc.topic.dragon.20: Gold? You want me to lend some to you, small one?
npc.topic.dragon.21: I have healed weaklings such as you for days. It's time to grow. Seek your own kind at the temple to heal your frail body.
npc.topic.dragon.22: Indeed I am, and probably the oldest of all dragons. Most of us dwelt on this "world" long before the human race appeared. Don't get on the bad side of my brothers, for we love the sweet taste of hum... erm... nevermind that.
npc.topic.dragon.24: You are unworthy to speak with I. Now begone, puny mortal, before I eat you!
npc.topic.dragon.3: Artherk is not my god. He is but a human god, which simply shows how much of a weakling he is.
npc.topic.dragon.4: I ate a red monster yesterday whose name was "Diabobolo". I had indigestion for hours and had to rest here. The people of this "town" took advantage of my weakness to surround me with this meaningless fence. Of course, they have not yet figured out that I could simply fly over it. *growl*
npc.topic.dragon.5: It tasted rather bitter, gave me heartburns and left me with a heck of a bad breath!
npc.topic.dragon.6: Thank you for taking care of the tomb raider who was hiding in the Crypt.
npc.topic.dragon.7: You have GOT to be kidding!! You think I'm going to give you one of my sharp, precious teeth? Do you REALLY want to see them from this close? I guess I could chew on you for a while, if that's what you truly desire... No? Didn't think so. Don't bother me with these idiocies.
npc.topic.dragon.8: Arakas is the island you are currently standing on. Did you not know that already?
npc.topic.dragon.9: The Fourth Coming approaches and it will be thee who shalt be judged this time. The question is... Are you ready for it?
npc.topic.drardos.1: You have not heard of me before? I am the most famous "antiques" collector in all of Althea!
npc.topic.drardos.10: Samuel told you that I could tan this skin? Well, he was right. I'll tan this antelope skin for 1400 gold pieces. Is that alright?
npc.topic.drardos.2: I have several shops on the mainland, and I'm just now moving into this new one.
npc.topic.drardos.3: What's that you got there? Hmm, what a strange looking piece this is. May I see it?
npc.topic.drardos.4: Yes, only someone of great skill could've created this ring. There is something else too, the ring seems to be imbued with some strange power and I don't know what it does. Perhaps the priests at the temple will know more.
npc.topic.drardos.5: Well, at the moment we're rather busy unpacking and setting the "shop" up.
npc.topic.drardos.6: Yes, I collect antiques, but I also sell them. You didn't know? Well, I guess I can't be famous everywhere.
npc.topic.drardos.7: My "wife" and I have been too busy unpacking that we haven't had time to look around the city. You're one of the few people who came in today.
npc.topic.drardos.8: Yes, I have many swords in my beautiful collection. I will have to do an inventory of all of them later on.
npc.topic.drardos.9: My beautiful wife Leana works with me night and day to turn this into one of the best shops around!
npc.topic.drunk.1: She wants to *hic* give me a beer, I hope? *snort*
npc.topic.drunk.3: Eeh? *hic* Wanna make a *gurgle* donation? A hundred gold pieces *hic* would be fine... Can you shpare that much?
npc.topic.drunk.4: *Hic* I know some things... Just give me gold and the more you give me... the more I talk... *snort*
npc.topic.drunk.6: Work? *Hic* My job is to empty the tavern's beer mugs! Now get out of my way, I need another *hic* *snort* beer! I alsho know shome "rumors", if you can shpare shome gold pieces...
npc.topic.dunikus.0: The name is Dunikus Hornwind to you, good adventurer.
npc.topic.dunikus.1: Our work is to preserve nature. It may appear simple, but it is not, for we have to fight foul creatures such as "goblins" when they threaten our forest. I have acquired a special talent in brewing "potions", and I can even "teach" you a new "spell" or two.
npc.topic.dunikus.10: Arakas is the name of this island. The "Lighthaven" is located on the south eastern part while "Windhowl" is located on the south western part of the island.
npc.topic.dunikus.11: The Stone of Life is an ordinary stone in which we have poured life energy. The stone can be used as a catalyst for our spells of nature. The burden of guarding it safely lies upon the shoulders of "Yrian" "Earthsong".
npc.topic.dunikus.12: I do not like goblins and undeads, but the Forest Guardians keep them away from the druidic camp.
npc.topic.dunikus.13: The dreaded Jarko sometimes sends "goblin" spies in our camp to steal our "Stone" "of" "Life", but I have no fear since "Yrian" is guarding it.
npc.topic.dunikus.15: I shall begin instructing you right away.
npc.topic.dunikus.16: Farewell my friend, be watchful of "goblins".
npc.topic.dunikus.2: Celestina Waterbreeze is my sister. She is a druid also and resides in Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.dunikus.3: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many like you who walk the land and bear his mark. I tell you, friend, you have to seek Annabelle, blessed be her eyes! She'll know what to do.
npc.topic.dunikus.4: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.dunikus.5: I would be glad to brew a flask of bluish liquid for you but I lack a few  special ingredients that only I know where to find them. Come back later if you want.
npc.topic.dunikus.6: The Order of Nature is a small community of druids dedicated to the protection of nature and was founded by "Yrian" "Earthsong".
npc.topic.dunikus.7: Yrian Earthsong is the Elder of our community. He is our spiritual leader and a man with a great sense of responsibility. If you wish to meet him, his house is located northeast of this camp.
npc.topic.dunikus.8: Lantalir Rainmist is still an apprentice in the "Order" "of" "Nature", but his work is appreciated nevertheless. He learns very fast and has proven to be a great student. Already, he has learned the art of summoning the rain.
npc.topic.dunikus.9: We rarely get in contact with the inhabitants of Lighthaven, for they do not share our concerns for nature. The same goes for the citizens of Windhowl.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.0: You could say that I am a barber with very bad aim.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.1: Stand aside. I do not have time for this.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.10: They still have much to learn in this field of work but they are extremely well-trained.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.11: They have been chosen for their loyalty to Lord "Bane" and their assassination skills. They are everywhere. Some are even under "King" "Theodore"'s service. They are waiting for the right "moment"...
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.12: You shall see in due time...
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.13: One day, he will kneel before me and beg for mercy. But I will not listen to that weakling. No, I will not! I will deliver a clean and swift blow to his neck and present his head on a silver plate to Lord "Bane".
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.14: Ding-a-ling! I don't know everybody you numbskull!
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.16: Bane is probably the most dangerous man you'll ever see. This is why I serve him... because I know that he simply cannot lose.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.17: Delwobble is a mad summoner who dwells under the castle.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.18: I never went in the desert nor do I ever want to.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.19: Have you lost your head? Or better yet, do you want to lose it?
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.2: Yes. Dwarthon Stoneface is the name.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.20: Now, let me do my work.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.3: The name is "Dwarthon" "Stoneface" to you. I am "Bane"'s most favored servant and thus, earned the title of "executioner".
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.4: Why am I an executioner? Hmmm! Let's see... ah yes... I love to kill!
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.5: The tower? Ah yes, that's where that insane "old" "man" lives!
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.6: Zhakar is only a fool but do not underestimate his arcane skills.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.7: You are new around here, aren't you? Yes, even this small island is part of Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.dwarthonstoneface.9: The rogue mages are great scouts and their magical skills are of great use to us.
npc.topic.edden.0: That's the name of this island.
npc.topic.edden.2: Yes, I am a knight of "Silversky".
npc.topic.edden.3: I "guard" the entrance to the castle, along with my friend here, Idas.
npc.topic.edden.4: It is a great town, but I still wish it wasn't so close to the castle.
npc.topic.edden.5: We are to stand here and keep any unwanted intruders from entering the castle.
npc.topic.edden.6: He is a good friend, that is for sure. We always help each other out, he and I.
npc.topic.edden.7: Have you come to see the king? Proceed then.
npc.topic.edden.8: I haven't noticed anything out of the ordinary.
npc.topic.edgar.0: They're giving us a hard time that's for sure.
npc.topic.edgar.1: I'm Head Merchant Edgar Gimplestratten, if you like formal titles, or just Edgar, if you're more the relaxed type.
npc.topic.edgar.10: Trade? WHAT trade? With all the trouble on the island, it's not like we are making loads of money, eh? If you wanna help, go kill some of those "goblins" out there.
npc.topic.edgar.11: There are many adventurers running in the streets, lately, and that'd be a good thing if they were all fine folks. Some just prey upon the weak, though, and we'd prefer not to have them here if we had a choice.
npc.topic.edgar.12: A lovely town, don't you think? "Windhowl" is a bit larger, but I think it's not as lively as Lighthaven. And the people here are nicer, too. Windhowl is just too mercantile.
npc.topic.edgar.13: Oh no you don't! I'm not about to give in to the likes of you! If you want the money, you'll have to knock me out!
npc.topic.edgar.14: It isn't easy, trading in Lighthaven. We have some ruthless thieves' guild in town who operates a "protection" racket on our merchants, and we have brigands who roam the countryside, waylaying traders who travel between Lighthaven and Windhowl. Let me tell you, it's been slim pickings, of late.
npc.topic.edgar.2: I'm the master of the Lighthaven "Merchant" "Guild", the LMG as we call it for short. I used to be an adventurer, but I decided to settle down a few years ago and fight the good fight with money rather than with my sword.
npc.topic.edgar.3: There have been plenty of people asking about her, lately. Who is she?
npc.topic.edgar.4: I wouldn't know. Ask a priest or something.
npc.topic.edgar.6: Yes, even a small place such as "Lighthaven" has its own merchants' guild. It's necessary to keep trading smooth, especially with the "goblins" and "brigands" disrupting everything these days.
npc.topic.edgar.7: Ah, they're everywhere, these days! Like the plague! You get outta town, you run into armed goblins. ARMED! What's this world coming to! It's a disaster for Lighthaven's economy, if you ask me.
npc.topic.edgar.8: It's like I tell everyone, everybody there is just a little too bent on making money. They forget to be nice to their neighbors, to help each other, to actually care, if you get my drift.
npc.topic.edgar.9: <Sigh> As if fighting goblins wasn't enough, we've got to fight our own kind. Not something I'm particularly proud of, as a human. We should be looking out for each other, not killing each other. What good is money if it's blood money?
npc.topic.efnisien.10: The "letter" I received mentioned that you would come visit me to talk about Olin Haad.
npc.topic.efnisien.11: I'm sorry, as much as I would like to chat with you all day, I have other things to do. And since my jaw hurts like hell, I must attend to it. Oh yes, one last thing... if you want to make yourself known to Olin Haad, try giving his guards a beating or two. If you need a reason, do it for me, heh heh. Now, if you'll excuse me...
npc.topic.efnisien.12: It's too late anyway. Olin Haad has found an alternate way to enter and he's inside the temple right now. You can enter through the stairs in the room behind the locked door, but it will serve you no good, as you won't be able to defeat him without a special weapon of some sort.
npc.topic.efnisien.2: Oh, this and that. I would tell you more about myself, but I don't really know you.
npc.topic.efnisien.3: Look at me now... I'm covered in blood! Damn my jaw hurts too... Oh, but where are my manners? My name is Efnisien, and these gentlemen were "assassins" sent here by "Olin" "Haad", 'necromancer extraordinaire'.
npc.topic.efnisien.4: Ahem!, Aye... but nevermind them, it's just an old quarrel... Now, I presume you're here to talk about "Olin" "Haad", right? Let's get to it then.
npc.topic.efnisien.5: That bastard took the town "under" "siege", and for what? I heard it was for a worthless piece of stone!
npc.topic.efnisien.6: Yeah, and under our bum of a king's nose, too! He took the city with as much ease as a hot knife cuts through butter. He said he was looking for "something", but I'm not sure what.
npc.topic.efnisien.7: From what I hear, it's a stone or something of the sort that the king promised him in exchange for his "services".
npc.topic.efnisien.8: Our king Theodore XIII hired this guy to clean some rather powerful creatures that were roaming the land in these parts. Believe it or not, once the deed was done, the king actually "refused" to pay up.
npc.topic.efnisien.9: I don't know why, but seeing as you seem more interested in the matter than I, perhaps you should take it up with Olin Haad directly. You can find him in a cavern across town. After all, I believe he is the reason you came to "visit" me, is it not?
npc.topic.eldantor.0: The name is Eldantor to you.
npc.topic.eldantor.1: I wander around the world to quench my insatiable thirst for knowledge. I am an experienced mage and could probably teach you the art of "meditation" if you wish to learn it. Furthermore, I am also a great "arcane" "scribe" and may be of assistance if you are interested in magical lore.
npc.topic.eldantor.10: You need %u more levels, %u more intelligence and %u more wisdom to learn meditate.
npc.topic.eldantor.11: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.eldantor.13: You must be so proud of yourself.
npc.topic.eldantor.14: Farewell. I shall return to my "meditation".
npc.topic.eldantor.15: Even I do not possess all the answers.
npc.topic.eldantor.2: I can't help you with whatever it is you need, but if it's advice you seek, perhaps you should consult Chryseida Yolangda, the old gypsy. Careful, though. The more advice you seek, the more she charges you for her services. Guess that's just the way the world is, eh?
npc.topic.eldantor.3: Arcane scribes can use a "magic" "scripting" "kit" in order to inscribe powerful symbols of magic into a blank magical tome.
npc.topic.eldantor.5: If you need a Tome of Valor, I heard of a mage who goes by the name of "Liurn" "Clar" would be most suitable for the task.
npc.topic.eldantor.6: I think Liurn Clar resides in WindHowl.
npc.topic.eldantor.7: I doubt you have enough talent in the Art to use it but if you insist on having one, I could probably sell you one for a mere 20,000 gold pieces. So, do you wish to buy a magic scripting kit from me?
npc.topic.eldantor.8: If you need to seek your true destiny, he can definitely help you... if you find him.
npc.topic.eldantor.9: To "meditate" is to heal the soul. The art of meditation is a discipline that takes time to master. If you wish, I could "teach" you how to use it.
npc.topic.eldrig.0: I have no time for chit-chats.
npc.topic.eldrig.2: I am Eldrig. Hey, while you're around, why don't you "train" your skills with me and see how good you are?
npc.topic.eldrig.3: I am being handsomely paid by "Grant" "Hornkeep" to enforce the laws in this town and to ensure protection of our citizens.
npc.topic.eldrig.4: You're asking the wrong person, I'm not the one to give you help or hints on your quests. You should ask the old gypsy, she can foretell your future. Be sure to have a lot of gold with you, though. She's not cheap.
npc.topic.eldrig.6: Grant Hornkeep is the town's sheriff.
npc.topic.eldrig.7: If you know where that thief is hiding, you'd better tell me or I'll assume that you are one of his accomplices!
npc.topic.eldrig.9: I'm sure he'll talk to someone like you. I hear he dwells at the very center of Stoneheim, although I don't know what you'll find there.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.0: Well, since the "brigands" have been attacking travelers in the forest, we haven't had many visitors. These guards roaming all over town aren't helping either, let me tell you. I wish the war with "Windhowl" and the goblins would end so we can have some guards to help with the "brigands" in the forest. At least, sometimes "Murmuntag" takes it upon himself to go scare them away.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.1: Aye, my friend, he isn't very smart, but he could take ten of my best men single-handedly. When he makes his surprise attack on the "brigands" in the forest, they usually calm down for a day or two. I wish I could send him there more often, but we need him to guard the town.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.10: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to "Lord" "Sunrock" in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.11: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.15: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.2: I am the town's chief guard. I have the responsibility to ensure the town stays safe for our citizens.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.3: Aye! I am Elmert Merkis, but please, do call me Elmert.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.4: Windhowl is our sister town on the island. It is currently battling against the goblins in the northwestern mountains, trying to stop them from invading all of the island. But since King "Theodore" rose to power, the goblins have been gaining territory rather quickly. Reinforcements are always coming late, or never coming at all. I'm sure they could use good fighters.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.5: Raven's Dust is the island southwest of here. It is there that the castle of King "Theodore" resides. Most of the guards and soldiers in "Goldmoon"'s army are trained there.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.6: You're not going to believe this, but someone told me that a friend of his heard this as the dying words of a man who barely escaped Balork with his life... That Balork is building swords of darkness such as the Gloomblade to equip his evil armies when they try to take over our town. If you find some, give them to the priests. They can destroy them... I think.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.7: Goldmoon is the kingdom that encompasses the islands of "Raven's" "Dust" and the island you are currently on, Arakas.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.8: That sorry excuse for a king sleeps half of the time, and awakens only to go back to sleep! Meanwhile, "Windhowl"'s guards are decreasing at an alarming rate.
npc.topic.elmertmerkiss.9: I don't know what's been up with them lately, but they are constantly attacking our "merchants" when they attempt to do business with "Windhowl". This is nothing new, but lately they have been banding together and are in larger groups. I wish I could solve this problem, but I don't have time to take care of it.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.0: I am Elysana Blackrose, sorceress of Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.1: I do not have any specific occupation. I am devoted to my studies of the "mystical" "arts" and I spend most of my spare time with my books. If you could help me, I would be grateful if you could fetch some "ingredients". Also, I may have a "green" "gemstone" in which you might be interested if you intend to talk with tree people.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.10: Champions of Light are men and women who have dedicated themselves to the cause of pure good. They must take a special oath and have done far more good deeds than evil deeds.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.13: Not much can be said about him...
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.14: It is said that somewhere beneath the desert lies an underground dungeon where treasures and mysteries can be found.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.15: I... I don't like being involved with people like you, but I can tell you're not going to take no for an answer. I'll do it, but you must promise never to tell anyone about this. Agreed?
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.16: You do not look gifted enough to learn spells worth of being taught.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.17: I don't see for what purpose would you need some kraanian eyes.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.18: I think that a wax apple is a beautiful decoration on a table.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.19: Sapphire gem? That's my birthday's rock.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.2: You were able to gather all three ingredients, %s? That's nice. Now, would you like to trade them to me?
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.20: Do I look like your personal spiritual trainer? If you wish to train yourself in the mystical arts, you should think about reading a few books.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.21: Some inhabitants think that I am a fortune teller. How far they are from the truth! I have, however, the ability to "foresee" a few things sometimes.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.22: King Theodore's kingdom of Goldmoon is falling apart.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.23: I foresee that you shall achieve a greater state of mind and body in %u more experience points.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.24: I should turn you into a fly and change myself into a frog so I can eat you.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.3: The herb you seek does not grow on the surface of the world, but rather in the deepest caves of this island. And no, before you ask, I don't have any to sell.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.4: They are my passion in life. I have been gifted since the day I was born. It would be a pleasure to share my "knowledge" with you.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.5: I have learned many spells over the years, two of which I have designed myself. These two I would be willing to "teach" you.
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.7: Perhaps you might be interested in buying a green gemstone of the Forest Spirit. It will only cost you 20000 gold pieces, do you want to buy one?
npc.topic.elysanablackrose.9: Before I help you, %s, I'd like you to bring me some "ether".
npc.topic.eraka.1: I am a guard of this town, but I was injured in battle.
npc.topic.eraka.10: Lighthaven is our sister town. It's located on the eastern part of the island.
npc.topic.eraka.11: Yes, the name of this island is Arakas.
npc.topic.eraka.12: That's the name of the island somewhere to the south. I don't know any way to reach it. That island is also part of the kingdom of "Goldmoon".
npc.topic.eraka.13: The kingdom of Goldmoon regroups both Raven's Dust and Arakas. It is currently under the rulership of "King" "Theodore" "XIII".
npc.topic.eraka.14: Why hasn't he sent any reinforcements here yet?
npc.topic.eraka.2: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.eraka.4: He is the necromancer who lives somewhere in the northern mountains.
npc.topic.eraka.5: Sunrock is currently the Lord of "Windhowl".
npc.topic.eraka.6: Why should I know anything about them?
npc.topic.eraka.8: The druidic camp is located to the northeast of the island.
npc.topic.eraka.9: Windhowl is the name of this town.
npc.topic.etheanan.0: There are a very few people who know me. My name is Etheanan. What can I do for you?
npc.topic.etheanan.1: Yes? Do I know you? Hmm, somehow I doubt that.
npc.topic.etheanan.11: Hah! you think so too eh?
npc.topic.etheanan.12: Well, I am what you might call an "elementalist".
npc.topic.etheanan.13: Yes, I have devoted my life to the study of all things arcane, but especially to the "elements".
npc.topic.etheanan.14: There are six elements in this plane of existence. Nearly all spells are connected with at least one of these elements. They are fire, water, air, earth, light and dark. There are many "theories" and "beliefs" out there about what happens when you cast a spell, but very few are actually accurate.
npc.topic.etheanan.15: Many people think that "mana" flows all around us, and that they can just bend and shape it to their will. This is at the most only partly true. "Mana" does flow around us, but not how you would think.
npc.topic.etheanan.16: Well for instance, many people, wizards included, believe that casting a spell involves channeling raw mana and altering it through force of will into one of the six elements for easier manipulation and containment. This is in fact a misconception, as the mana is not so much channeled and then altered, as it is drawn from one of the "metaplanes".
npc.topic.etheanan.17: The elemental metaplanes are where the true magic comes from. Whenever a wizard casts a spell, he is in fact tapping into one of the metaplanes. Each metaplane can be tapped for mana of the appropriate element. For example, to cast a firestorm, I would create a link between the elemental metaplane of fire and myself, allowing myself to draw sufficient mana to cast my spell. This is all done instinctively, of course, so no one would ever believe you if you tried to explain it to them.
npc.topic.etheanan.18: These often consist of utility spells and are most subject to having special, if not strange effects. The mana burst spell, for instance, is one such raw spell, and is quite useful in certain circumstances. At first sight, this spell appears to be rather weak, but careful examination will reveal a great potential on magic-resistant creatures. Because of the nature of this spell, the damage it inflicts may not be resisted by a creature's natural magic defenses.
npc.topic.etheanan.19: Ahhh, so you would like to learn some of my spells, is that it? Very well then.
npc.topic.etheanan.2: I am a "wizard", though a very "special" one at that.
npc.topic.etheanan.21: To understand mana is to control it. Each spell requires a special kind of mana, whether it be a simple fire dart spell or a devastating avalanche spell. There are, of course, exceptions to this rule, which we will call "raw" "spells".
npc.topic.etheanan.3: Yes, I create my own "spells" to help with my everyday "chores".
npc.topic.etheanan.4: These include "fishing", "hunting", "cleaning", oh and "cooking", of course. Heh heh heh.
npc.topic.etheanan.5: Ahh, one of the better things in life, if you ask me. Do you like to fish by any chance?
npc.topic.etheanan.6: Hmm, my food stores are getting quite a bit low, if I do say so myself. I'll not survive the next season if I don't get around to start hunting again. I don't really enjoy it, but it is a must for someone who lives around here.
npc.topic.etheanan.7: Bah! That is the one thing I truly dislike. I live so far away from the general populace that I cannot get a decent maid. If it wasn't for my magic, I would have gone back to "civilization" a long time ago.
npc.topic.etheanan.8: I am referring, of course, to the city of "Silversky".
npc.topic.etheanan.9: It is a fine city, but one I try to avoid nonetheless.
npc.topic.evelyn.0: I'm Evelyn. And you are...%s? It's really nice to meet you.
npc.topic.evelyn.2: My, my, aren't we curious today? I simply like to walk in the forest even though there are some vile "creatures" around here.
npc.topic.evelyn.3: Oh, don't worry! It's nothing I can't handle. Appearances can be truly deceiving you know. I have a trick or two up my sleeve if needed be.
npc.topic.evelyn.4: I made it from a "willowisp" that I caught myself. If you need a ring, perhaps I could sell you one. Alas, I'd have to put a hefty price tag on it for all the troubles I have to go through to catch a willowisp. Ah, I know, I'll make a ring if you can bring me back a "pouch" "of" "willow" "bark". I'll also need that you bring back a plain iron ring.
npc.topic.evelyn.5: They're pretty hard to find. They try to lure you into the depth of the woods but when you get to the point where they were standing, they are no where to be seen. Hrm, I don't want to sound mean but I doubt you'll ever find one on your own. You'd best leave this to me.
npc.topic.evelyn.6: Willow bark is an all-around cough medecine. There are no willows up here. I'm fairly sure that the druids have some. Afterall, they do live in "Willow" "Woods".
