npc.topic.evelyn.7: The Willow Woods are located on the southern part of the island.
npc.topic.evelyn.8: Okay, that does it! I'll show you some manners!
npc.topic.fali.1: I sell all those items. Please, feel free to have a "look".
npc.topic.fali.2: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.fali.3: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.fali.4: If you steal something, I swear you will regret it.
npc.topic.fali.5: Hmmm? Rolph or Sigfried might want to see the lord's registration letter.
npc.topic.fali.7: What is it that you wish to sell?
npc.topic.fali.9: Come back if you ever need anything.
npc.topic.filandrius.0: Looks like I got your attention with that one eh? My job is simple enough, I collect and translate ancient magic, be it artifacts or spells. I just may be in "need" for someone as well-trained as yourself.
npc.topic.filandrius.1: I've just finished translating an ancient text containing important information on a tome called "Filnar'thir", the Tome of Arcane Knowledge.
npc.topic.filandrius.10: Oh no, it's no trouble at all. And here you go, for all the trouble you've been through. I'm sure you'll enjoy this as much as I did.
npc.topic.filandrius.11: These are some of the more useful spells contained within the book.
npc.topic.filandrius.12: I am Filandrius, high sorcerer of this library.
npc.topic.filandrius.13: As I said before, I am the high sorcerer.
npc.topic.filandrius.2: That's what I want. Have you ever heard about Anthor the Mad? I suppose not... Anthor was the pride of the human civilization in the dwarven era. He devised many wonders and with the fall of the dwarfs, he helped make the human civilization what it is today. Unfortunately, like every flower, he bloomed under the light and faded in the "darkness".
npc.topic.filandrius.3: He eventually met Makrsh P'Tangh... The lich did something that cost poor Anthor his sanity. Today he roams aimlessly on the island of Stoneheim, searching for something. I read somewhere that he would find peace only in death. That makes today his lucky day as I've developed a particular interest in the book he carries. If you've a bit of spare time, I would greatly appreciate it if you could "get" "it" for me.
npc.topic.filandrius.4: If you were to bring me the tome, I would reward you for your efforts. I can even teach you some of the ancient spells that are found in the book. Before you go, you should know that Anthor will not be a pushover. Bring friends... bring lots of friends.
npc.topic.filandrius.5: Alright then, feel free to look around as you please.
npc.topic.filandrius.6: Well, I read about these soulstones awhile back. It was written that they were used to open a gate to "countless" "riches".
npc.topic.filandrius.7: I sure know how to get your attention, don't I? Anyway, three "soulstones" are needed to open the gate.
npc.topic.filandrius.8: As you have probably guessed, the other two soulstones are guarded by creatures not unlike the one you defeated to get the soulstone that's in your possession. Unfortunately, I don't know where the other two guardians are located... but I can give you their "names".
npc.topic.filandrius.9: The three guardians are called Jormungand, Hel and Fenrir. Once you've found all three soulstones, look for the portal near the centaur village on Stoneheim. Be careful though, as I've read that once the soulstones are used to enter the portal, they are consumed by the portal's energies.
npc.topic.forestwanderer.0: A voice says: ''I'm just a wanderer, don't mind me.''
npc.topic.forestwanderer.1: A voice says: ''I just walk around these woods, helping lost souls find their way home.''
npc.topic.forestwanderer.2: A voice says: ''Do you wish to be sent home?''
npc.topic.forestwanderer.6: A voice says: ''If there were Elves here, I certainly wouldn't tell you.''
npc.topic.garnir.0: Do not waste my time with petty questions! I have "work" to do.
npc.topic.garnir.1: I am an assistant to Lord Arganor. Tiring work it is, I tell you. I have done that for so many years, I just can't wait to finally "leave". Anyway, do you need "help" or not? I don't have all day! *grumble*
npc.topic.garnir.2: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady, but somewhat odd, even though I never met her myself.
npc.topic.garnir.3: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked for eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.garnir.4: I do not have all day to chat, you know! Go bother someone else!
npc.topic.garnir.5: I can help you train your skills to help better yourself, but you'd better be quick about it!
npc.topic.garnir.6: Very good, then let's begin your training.
npc.topic.geena.1: I'm the waitress here.  I help "Halam" in his work.
npc.topic.geena.2: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.geena.3: I'll be with you as soon as I have a minute.
npc.topic.geena.5: He's very nice, and always joyful.  He speaks to all the "travelers".
npc.topic.geena.6: We haven't seen many lately. I'm waiting for the day that a nice adventurer will ask to "marry" me.
npc.topic.geena.7: I'll wait until a rich adventurer comes to marry me.
npc.topic.georgetheiiird.0: Why, surely you must be an outsider to not be familiar with my name. I am known as George the third, son of George the second.
npc.topic.georgetheiiird.1: I am the renowned captain of the guards. I protect the citizens of Goldmoon, which, I would like to point out, has never fallen to an invasion. Not even those damned "goblins" can breach the walls of this city.
npc.topic.georgetheiiird.2: Balork cursed you, you say? I'm sorry to hear that. If "Annabelle" the Blessed One was still here, she might be able to help you. But she's long gone, now. I hear a troll took her away to feast upon her.
npc.topic.georgetheiiird.3: I heard that she has elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.georgetheiiird.4: Tough little brutes they've become lately, but still not even close to being a match for me or my well-trained army. Rest assured, as long as I, George the IIIrd, am captain of the guard, the goblins have no chance of invading our proud town.
npc.topic.geram.1: Umm, let's see now, I think it was Geram.
npc.topic.geram.2: ... oh, are you talking to me? It's been so long since someone spoke that name to me.
npc.topic.geram.3: I don't have any work. Would you happen to be offering me some by any chance?
npc.topic.geram.5: HIM! He's the reason I'm so poor! That devil took everything I had through gambling, my money, my home and even my wife Adriana! What a tragedy!
npc.topic.geram.6: A visitor? Well, you folks all look the same to me you know... you're all rich!
npc.topic.geram.7: Such evolved language, you probably have a coin or two to spare...
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.0: Me Ghundarg Rumblefoot. *snort* Me will to take over "Silversky"!
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.1: Dumb hummie think I would tell you this? HA! Me die before talk.
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.10: He is only a feeble human. *grunt* All human are weaklings. *snort*
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.11: Traitors! ARRRrrgh!!!! They have been brain-washed by the humans. *grunt*
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.12: Soon, Raven's Dust will be ours! *snort*
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.13: *snort* Weakling he is. Me much powerful than him.
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.14: *snort* Humans always welcome when we hunger for flesh. *grunt*
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.2: Small town filled with dumb hummies! We soon crush them!
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.3: Me orc leader. We crush humans. *snort* And we conquer what is rightfully ours! You can help me! You find some "ingredients" me need and me spare your puny life! *grunt*
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.4: *grunt* You have the dandelion leaves and two pairs of tarantula eyes? You give to me?
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.5: *grunt* You have one human's foot? Me take! Will you give it to me?
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.6: *grunt* You have one human's foot? Me take! Will you give it to me?
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.7: We are invincible *grunt*. Silversky cannot resists us. *snort* King Theodore XIII's crown be mine and his head be over the *grunt* fireplace.
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.8: *grunt* Grimish is an annoying slimy goblin spy. *snort* We took care of him.
npc.topic.ghundargrumblefoot.9: *grunt* Methinks it's time for me to teach you a lesson.
npc.topic.giamas.1: That is the name my god has chosen for me.
npc.topic.giamas.2: Ahh yes, I would gladly tell you about my work. Like many others, I am a priest and choose to worship Artherk. I also make it a hobby of mine to "teach" some of what I know to strangers like yourself.
npc.topic.giamas.3: 'Tis a potent herb, when used by someone of pure spirit... I doubt that you could be such a person, but the world is full of surprises.
npc.topic.giamas.4: Here are the spells that I can teach you.
npc.topic.giamas.5: I worship Artherk, and he looks after his people. He is a kind and just god and deserves all the followers he can get.
npc.topic.giamas.6: This is a beautiful town with alot of good people.
npc.topic.giamas.7: I have not seen anyone that fits that description, I'm afraid.
npc.topic.giamas.8: May Artherk guide you, my friend.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.0: I have told you before, my name is Gladdius.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.1: Yes, I am Gladdius! What do you want from me?
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.10: Say one more word and you'll feel the edge of my sword!
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.2: I have no idea what you want, but as long as you keep your nose clean and stay out of our affairs, you're okay with me. I'm busy enough keeping an eye on that "Zion" "Thunderheart" fellow without having to worry about you strangers.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.3: Careful what you do or say around him. He's a tricky fellow, very ambitious and dangerous. We don't have anything on him, but we'll get him yet. Meanwhile, stay away from him or bad things may happen to you. Don't say I didn't warn you!
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.4: He's another guard, like me. Don't get in our way, we have big fish to take care of.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.5: He's a manasmith. If you want special armors, he's the one you should talk to. Not all his armors might fit you, though, but some of his weapons might be more your size.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.6: He's a little weak by Centaur standards, but he's got a good heart and he worships Artherk. He may not look like much, but I wouldn't underestimate him if I were you. Without his influence, we Centaurs would probably be at each other's throats. He's very wise, that's for sure.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.7: He's a manaweaver. There's about one manaweaver for every one hundred Centaurs, so that's pretty rare. I'm told he keeps to himself and does very powerful items at very high cost.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.8: King Aedenas Gravesoul is a strong and honorable king. We're all very loyal to him... except "Zion" "Thunderheart", of course.
npc.topic.gladdiuswindchaser.9: I stand guard here to protect the town.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.0: I am Glaenshenmilandira, a seraph of Artherk.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.1: I am a Seraph of Artherk. I do not usually have to interact with mortals and I do not need to do mundane chores as you do.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.2: The purifiers are holy souls that have for purpose to maintain an acceptable amount of nether monsters around here. Bear them malice, and you'll feel sorry.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.3: The neoflares are powerful nether creatures that roam these isles. Even my "purifiers" are not strong enough to eradicate these vile monsters.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.4: Indeed, you have come to the right person to have the Lute of Peace recharged. Unfortunately, my power alone will not suffice, so I would ask that you bring me as many "Magical" "Lutes" as you can--bring at *least* six. The more you bring, the better the odds that I'll succeed at recharging the Lute of Peace.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.5: Magical Lutes are often the instrument of choice of the Death Jester. I doubt he will part with it without a fight, however.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.7: The Will of Artherk represents the drive and passion one must have to truly change the world and the way people think.
npc.topic.glaenshenmilandira.8: If you'd had wings, I'd clip 'em right now!
npc.topic.granthornkeep.0: Yes, that's the name. I am the town's sheriff.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.1: I am Grant Hornkeep, but you may call me Grant.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.10: I have an extensive collection, second only to that of King Gravesoul, ruler of the Centaurs.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.11: Those belts could come in handy, actually. I could equip our militia with them and better protect Stonecrest, if you know what I mean. If you happen to have three of those, I'll trade them in for a very special "Collector's" "Book".
npc.topic.granthornkeep.12: I am the town's sheriff. Now, if you'll excuse me, I still have some unresolved cases that require my full attention. Unless you want to "help", I'll have to ask you to leave.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.13: If I get my hands on this thief, he will spend the remaining days of his sorry life in a jail cell.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.14: Torgas is the bartender of the local tavern, where all the miscreants usually are.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.15: Nissus Haloseeker is the only priest we have in our small temple. Seek his aid if you need healing or guidance.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.16: If you'll excuse me, there is work to be done.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.2: I could use some "Belt" "of" "Skraug" "Strength", if you know where to find some. Also, I could use some assitance in killing the "nightcreepers" and "pilferers" that hang around Stonecrest. Also, if you could bring me some of the thieves' "Secret" "Documents", I could learn of their plans and thwart them more efficiently.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.3: You will require the Key of Artherk before you can find him. Ask around, I'm sure you'll figure it out.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.4: Well well, what do we have here? Are you saying you are giving me these secret documents?
npc.topic.granthornkeep.5: You may not think it's worth a lot, but the mayor rewards handsomely individuals who have accumulated many such certificates.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.6: Please kill as many as you can. For every nine you kill, I'll give you a reward.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.7: They are a real pain in the neck! Kill eight of them and I'll give you a reward.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.8: You may not think those are very useful, but once you've got enough of them, the Mayor himself will reward you.
npc.topic.granthornkeep.9: You may not think those are very useful, but once you've got enough of them, the Mayor himself will reward you.
npc.topic.greyareedy.0: My name? Humpf what a waste of time. Oh well, if you insist, I am Greyar Eedy.
npc.topic.greyareedy.1: Isn't it obvious? I am the banker of this town. I keep track of all the "deposits" and "withdrawals" everyone makes. Now be quick, it is a very demanding job and I have other matters to attend to.
npc.topic.greyareedy.2: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.greyareedy.3: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.greyareedy.4: The Bank of Windhowl will provide you with a secure way of keeping your gold pieces away from the brigands. You may "deposit", "withdraw" or verify your "balance". I do not even operate the bank during the night because I am far too scared of being robbed by cloaked brigands in the shadows of the night.
npc.topic.greyareedy.5: You have %u gold pieces in your account.
npc.topic.greyareedy.6: Sorry, I am not fooled that easily!
npc.topic.greyareedy.7: Sorry, I am not fooled that easily!
npc.topic.greyareedy.8: If you wish to deposit gold pieces in the Windhowl bank, you'll have to tell me how many you wish to deposit. Just tell me 'deposit <x> gold' where <x> is the amount of gold pieces you wish to deposit. Or perhaps you would like to verify your "balance" or even "withdraw" gold from the "bank".
npc.topic.greyareedy.9: If you want to withdraw gold pieces from your account, you will have to tell me 'withdraw <x> gold' where <x> is the amount of gold pieces you want to withdraw.
npc.topic.greyleaf.0: I am known as Grey Leaf, elder of the Daemon Trees.
npc.topic.greyleaf.1: That does not concern you. But if you wish to make yourself "useful" to me, then perhaps I could find something for you.
npc.topic.greyleaf.10: I have no time to answer the questions of an ignorant person.
npc.topic.greyleaf.11: Daemon Trees! I've seen enough of that fool!
npc.topic.greyleaf.2: I am impressed. You have brought back the "Black" "Snakeroot" and the "Woody" "Nightshade"? Now, will you give me the two ingredients I need?
npc.topic.greyleaf.3: If you want this ring, you will have to prove yourself "useful" to me in one way or another.
npc.topic.greyleaf.4: If you want to make yourself "useful", you can always try to get me some.
npc.topic.greyleaf.5: If you want to make yourself "useful", you can always try to get me some.
npc.topic.greyleaf.6: They are mine... MINE! You'll have to walk on my trunk if you ever want them.
npc.topic.greyleaf.7: They obey my orders and mine alone.
npc.topic.greyleaf.9: Zhakar, that clumsy old fool, is always after my "belladona" "berries" but they are mine.
npc.topic.grimish.10: Dumb orc hit Grimish on head. See? Big bump on head. Then, Grimish wake up here. You here like Grimish? You prisoner too?
npc.topic.grimish.11: Doremas is a thief in Silversky. He used to like Grimish unlike other humans. I was to meet Doremas somewhere but Grimish do not remember anymore.
npc.topic.grimish.12: Grimish play game. Simple. You tell, me tell. Tell me now what better than raw rats yet more ugly than Doremas?
npc.topic.grimish.13: Nothing? You right! You good at riddles. Fine. You earn prize. Doremas want to know word pass. Or was it pass-word? Me know not. What you want to know is the Alliance is renewed.
npc.topic.grimish.15: You have three pairs of vampire bat wings? They are vampires like Count Hemogoblin, ya know. Would you give them to me? Grimish be happy!
npc.topic.grimish.16: Yes. Grimish goblin. You keen eyes! You seen "Count" "Hemogoblin" on "Arakas"? Me would like to.
npc.topic.grimish.18: Grimish know about that. Grimish think it that way. Uh.. nonono! That way! Yes. Grimish sure!
npc.topic.grimish.19: Win all? Grimish never win. Grimish not lucky.
npc.topic.grimish.2: Me no work! Me trapped here. When stomach grumble, me catch "rats" and eat. You want some?
npc.topic.grimish.20: Funny wizard. Grimish able to do magic tricks too. You see lil' rat? *glurp* Now you don't!
npc.topic.grimish.21: Grimish no like you anymore. You too mean.
npc.topic.grimish.3: Rats taste good. Try tail. Very good!
npc.topic.grimish.4: Me not remember... Ah! Me now remember... me Grimish!
npc.topic.grimish.6: Varto? Grimish no care. Me no like.
npc.topic.grimish.7: Home not here! Not here! Not here Grimish say! Home that way! Or that way!
npc.topic.grimish.8: Me want to go out. See big orc leader.
npc.topic.grimish.9: They bigger than you. Better looking too and stronger methinks.
npc.topic.guardman.0: I am sorry to hear that. We do our best to please everybody, but it is not an easy task. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have to get back to work.
npc.topic.guardman.1: I am pleased to see that you're satisfied. Have a nice day.
npc.topic.guardman.2: I don't have time for endless chit-chat, I've got work to do.
npc.topic.guardman.3: I don't know anything about that. Leave me alone, I have a job to do.
npc.topic.guardman.4: I don't know her. Now if you'll excuse me...
npc.topic.guardman.5: I am a guard of Lighthaven's militia. Pardon my rudeness, but I must return to my duties.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.0: Hah! Nomad is what we call a peculiar merchant. He's very "aggressive", and not just in his dealings with fellow guild members, but with clients as well... unless he really wants something, then he's all smiles.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.1: Add to that the fact that he can spot a good "bargain" a mile away, and you can understand why he is very unpopular amongst his fellow merchants.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.10: Yes, I am coming to that. But first, I must be honest with you... I wasn't really rambling about Urik before. I was counting on the fact that you would take this job and teach him a "lesson".
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.11: Oh don't worry, he really did owe me the money. You see, Urik is a friend of Nomad's and I "suspect" they are working together for someone else.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.12: I was about to investigate myself before you came along. The other day, I overheard Urik talking to Nomad about the "Obsidian" "Conclave" or something like that.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.13: I don't know what it is, but from the sound of it, I can tell you right now it doesn't feel right. That's why I decided to "help" you find Nomad.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.14: I set an associate of mine on your tail while you paid your visit to Urik earlier. While you had him distracted, I had my associate steal a set of "keys" from behind Urik's counter.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.15: I believe that one of these keys will open the door to Nomad's "house". Here you go, they're all yours.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.16: His house is located somewhere in the south part of town. If you search inside, you might find some clue as to where he left.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.19: I am the head of the merchant's guild.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.2: Aye, why just recently he came across what he called a "Heartstone". He was very excited about it too. Knowing him, he has already made a fortune with it.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.3: Look, I would like to continue talking with you but I'm a very busy man. I must attend to a "problem" and each minute I spend talking is a minute I don't spend fixing it. If you don't mind...
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.4: Bah! No one is to be trusted these days it seems! Urik the tailor master has neglected to pay his "duties" to the guild coffers and he still receives the benefits.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.5: He says he paid double the standard fees last month knowing that he would have trouble paying this month. The problem is, the amount counted in the coffers says otherwise. People like him are what give merchants a bad name! Don't they know they shouldn't bite the hand that feeds them? Anyway, now for the "mercenaries"...
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.6: Hey! You're a mercenary, aren't you? Would you do this small "task" for me? I will pay you and I can even help you find the Nomad. I'm a merchant after all, I know people.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.7: I already told you who this is about in my ramblings. Urik the tailor master hasn't paid his duties this month. I need you to pay him a visit and recover the money he owes the guild. Look around town and I'm sure you will find him hiding in his shop.
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.8: Give me that money so I can put it somewhere safe. Now, about "Nomad"...
npc.topic.guildleaderethan.9: That's what you get for trying to cross me! Now don't come back until you have 2000 gold!
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.10: Thanks for the business, until we meet again.
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.2: I am the town weaponsmith. I sell my "wares" to whoever is in need of a "weapon". Luckily for me, there is no shortage of need here, what with the feud between the races.
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.3: I see I've caught your attention, eh? Well, perhaps you would like to take a closer look at just what I have to sell?
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.4: Only those with godly keys, such as the Key of Artherk, can ever hope to find him.
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.5: Of course you want to buy, who wouldn't? Will you take a look at my selection?
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.6: Truly, I have the very best weapons you'll find anywhere on this island. Feel free to look around and "buy" what you like!
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.7: I don't see what you could possibly have to offer me, but I'll oblige you anyway.
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.8: If it's advice you seek, go see Yolangda the gypsy. You might find her advice expensive, but if you're desperate, I'm sure she's the one to talk to.
npc.topic.gulfridsteelhammer.9: Leave my shop at once, you're wasting my time.
npc.topic.guntertagdestroy.0: *Grunt* Guntertag is lieutenant of guard! *Snort* Guntertag crush goblins *snort*. Urggh!
npc.topic.guntertagdestroy.1: I am GUNTERTAG DESTROY! *grunt*, Brother of *snort* "Murmuntag" Destroy. *grunt* Uuaaarrrgghhh!
npc.topic.guntertagdestroy.4: Murmuntag is brother of *snort* Guntertag. He lives in *grunt* Lighthaven. Together, Murmuntag and Guntertag could crush *snort* *grunt* anything.
npc.topic.gwen.0: I am Gwen, the best and only armor shopkeeper in town! You won't find a better deal anywhere else, I assure you! Do you wish to "buy" or "sell" anything?
npc.topic.gwen.1: I work as an armorer. I sell imported armor and sometimes even make them myself. Everything here is of the finest quality! Do you want to "buy" or "sell" anything?
npc.topic.gwen.4: Windhowl? That is the name of this town.
npc.topic.gwen.5: It is our sister town on the eastern part of this island. Another armorer named "Rolph" has set up his armor shop there.
npc.topic.gwen.6: He is an armorer who lives in "Lighthaven". He is, of course, less skilled than I am.
npc.topic.gwen.7: What do you wish to buy?
npc.topic.gwen.8: What item do you wish to sell?
npc.topic.gypsy.0: If Olin Haad had brought Gluriurl back to life, the god of Death would have been force to come. The last time the gods were at war, they destroyed much of the known land, except for these three islands. Now that the remains of the god have returned to their "respectful" "guardians", we can begin to hope again.
npc.topic.gypsy.1: The skull and heart of Gluriurl were returned to the Council of the Eight. His torso was returned to the Nameless Bard and the heart of Lothar and Artherk to the humans. Before I let you go on with your adventuring days, I would like to present these gifts to you, as a token of our appreciation. Sadly, I must take my leave of you, but remember child that this is only the beginning of your legacy.
npc.topic.gypsy.10: I have three magical objects which might be of interest to you, but you may only take one. I have an "Amulet" "of" "Regeneration" which increases your health over time, an "Amulet" "of" "Renewal" which increases your mana over time and "Trueshot's" "Quiver" which increases accuracy with the bow. Which will you choose?
npc.topic.gypsy.11: I cannot tell you my name... you will understand why someday.
npc.topic.gypsy.12: I try to ease the lives of those whose paths I cross.
npc.topic.gypsy.2: You seem surprised that I know about that... the answer is simple. I am a "seer".
npc.topic.gypsy.3: I can see images in my dreams that are beyond understanding. For instance, I had a vision yesterday, and you were in it. You were searching for someone named... "Nomad" I believe.
npc.topic.gypsy.4: I can help you find him, but first I must attune myself with your aura. Let's see now... did the one called Olin Haad tell you about the New Breed, yes or no?
npc.topic.gypsy.5: I can understand your confusion. A Darkheart is a very powerful relic that is known in many legends throughout countless ages. These stones are usually associated with curses and maledictions. I first learned about it in one of my "dreams".
npc.topic.gypsy.6: The dream is always the same... a "decaying" "corpse" stands in front of me, talking about this stone, and no matter how hard I try, I cannot understand it. I believe the dream is trying to tell me that the Darkheart is somehow related to a greater "plan".
npc.topic.gypsy.7: I can never see it very well, but from what I remember when I wake from the dream, the corpse reminds me of the god of Death, the Harbinger. But why would the god of Death speak to me? No, I do not believe it is him.
npc.topic.gypsy.8: In the dream, I saw hundreds of Darkheart stones falling from the sky like rain, entering the soil like seeds and blossoming into great heroes of ancient times. At the end of the dream, the decaying corpse says that for each seed that blossoms, a thousand lives will be "sacrificed".
npc.topic.gypsy.9: I am having trouble understanding it all. One thing is certain though, you must bring this stone to the temple of Artherk in Lighthaven. That is one of the few places I know where you can leave the stone for safekeeping. Before you leave however, I have "something" I would like to give you...
npc.topic.haden.0: My name is no concern of yours.
npc.topic.haden.1: So, you know about me, how unfortunate... for YOU!
npc.topic.haden.2: What I do with my time is none of your business.
npc.topic.haden.4: So, you know about my sister. What do you want from me?
npc.topic.haden.5: So, you know about me, how unfortunate... for YOU!
npc.topic.haden.6: You want a fight? Then I'll give you one! En garde!
npc.topic.haden.7: Hah! You want the Blade of Ruin? Then come and get it!
npc.topic.halam.0: My name is Halam Tors! Pleased to meet you!
npc.topic.halam.1: I'm the "innkeeper" of this inn! Would you like a "drink"? This is the best ale around! It's also the only one around! *laugh*
npc.topic.halam.10: Nightswords are pretty nifty items for people who like to dwell into darkness. I seem to remember a fellow who once made some, but for some reason, I can't seem to remember his name or where he lives... Heh heh... Perhaps you'd care to jog my memory with a thousand gold pieces?
npc.topic.halam.11: The inhabitants of Arakas have too many problems with the goblins. They need all the help they can get! It is rumored that Righul's Mountains, located north of Arakas, are infested by those ugly goblins! But that's not the worst! It is also said that an evil necromancer--as if a necromancer could be anything else--is leading this army! If he could be defeated, it would help us more than anything! Except maybe another mug of ale.
npc.topic.halam.12: They say that there are many atrocities lurking in the cave south of here. You should go have a look! It is not that far. Although, I have also heard that they had moved somewhere to the west... Or was it the north? Oh, I don't really know.
npc.topic.halam.13: I heard a mage talking about a dungeon under the temple of Lighthaven! I've been living here for 20 years and I never knew!
npc.topic.halam.14: Not many have seen a dragon, they have all taken shelter and they do not bother people. Have you seen the huge one we trapped? Now that's what I call a real dragon.
npc.topic.halam.15: Mato? It's the biggest forest on Arakas.  If you wish to travel on Arakas, you won't find a way around this forest!
npc.topic.halam.16: It'll cost ya 50 GP if you want me to tell you your worth. That comes with a beer, so it's not a total waste. Heh heh. Will you pay?
npc.topic.halam.17: I could throw you out for using such foul language.
npc.topic.halam.4: Have a seat and I'll send Geena to you as soon as she's free.
npc.topic.halam.5: As an innkeeper, I hear strange "rumors" from everyone.  "Travelers" often come here to buy a mug of ale or two!
npc.topic.halam.6: I heard many rumors! Some are about "goblins", others about "atrocities", but seldom are they about the "temple". I even heard people talking about "dragons"! But I warn ya, it's only rumors, you know!
npc.topic.halam.7: They usually come from all around, but these last few months, I haven't seen many.  Business isn't going too well.
npc.topic.halam.8: Don't know what you're talking about, friend.
npc.topic.halam.9: Oh, that! Yes, it's a pretty impressive magical sword, although I'm told only sinister fellows use it. Something like a boosted version of a Nightsword, I think.
npc.topic.headhunterwajpoothin.1: Me gett odder tribe "scalp" an Weethgwotha pey me reel guud.
npc.topic.headhunterwajpoothin.2: Yu bring me, um... handful of scalps ov odder tribe, und I give yew a "Skraugbashor" "Mace".
npc.topic.headhunterwajpoothin.3: Me like dat mace, me gots myself a guud lots of dem. Me can give yew sum if yew bring me "scalps".
npc.topic.headhunterwajpoothin.4: Me gonna bash sum hummie skull wit dis bigg glubb!
npc.topic.headhunterwajpoothin.5: Hummie go, me can gett back t' werk.
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.1: Don't ask me, ask someone who knows. Hey, why don't you ask that old dame, Chryseida? She's a fortune-teller, I'm sure she'll help... for a price.
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.3: I am the town's armorsmith. If you want to "buy" an armor, come to me first and I will make you a deal you cannot refuse.
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.4: I have some the strongest armors you can find around. They'll never let you down in the middle of a fight. Do you want to have a look at my selection?
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.5: Whatever it is, I'm sure it's very powerful. Make sure you don't go there unprepared, and that means you should be wearing good "armor".
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.6: So, it is your turn to sell some wares, eh?
npc.topic.herewaldironbender.7: Feel free to come back if you need something else.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.0: Yes, ever since the day he came in our poor town, he started to demand things that we could not give to him. For the most part, we could not understand what it was he wanted, except maybe for this "stone"...
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.1: By Artherk! What have I done? Quickly, you must find the merchant! Can you help me get the stone back?
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.10: It is only recently, after a series of gruesome events, that "Theodore" "XIII" discovered that not all of the Harvesters were destroyed in the battle. The survivors passed down their arcane knowledge to others and they eventually created the Cult of Gluriurl.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.11: I do not know why the king would hire a necromancer to dispose of the cult, but I believe the answers are somehow linked to this "Heartstone"...
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.12: Yes that's it! You should start your search in Windhowl, far to the west. There you will find the merchant's guild. You can ask them where to find the "Nomad". Please hurry and get the stone back. Oh, and take this, you seem to need the gold more than I.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.13: That is what he calls himself. If you ask the merchant's guild about him, I am sure they will recognize the name.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.14: Alright then... the Heartstone is the heart of an ancient god named Lothar the Just. He was the god of Justice and the brother of our revered Artherk. It is written that millenia ago, a god named Gluriurl broke the Compact, which prompted a war between the "gods".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.15: Gluriurl, who understood the potential of the ancient race, made contact with an elven king, Makrsh P'Tangh, to whom he promised untold riches and power in exchange for a "service".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.16: The elven king was to erect a monument to our dear Artherk and lure him into its center, where a powerful ritual was taking place. Thousands of Elves died in the ceremony. After the ritual was complete, Artherk's essence was bound into a "physical" "body".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.17: In this state, the god was vulnerable and thus, could be killed. Gluriurl, in the body of Makrsh P'Tangh, attacked Artherk with all his might. Just before the evil god absorbed Artherk's essence into his own, Lothar intervened and defeated Gluriurl, "sacrificing" himself in the process.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.18: Not much else is known about the Celestial War. However, other records indicate that when Lothar sacrificed his own life, it created a force strong enough to "bind" the essence of Gluriurl into his own Heart.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.19: It is believed that in the Heartstone lie the last remnants of the dead god. If the seal was to be broken, Gluriurl would return to life again! Do you remember when I told you about the Battle of Emanations? That was the last battle that occured because of this "seal".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.2: One day, I was cleaning the cellar of the church when I happened upon an old stone that looked somewhat out of place. I eventually sold it to a nice "merchant" for a fair price. Two days later, the "necromancer" came bearing a letter from the king that said he was entitled to the stone.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.20: Recently, the stone has started to throb with energy. I don't know what Olin Haad's "true" "intentions" are, but something must be done to prevent Gluriurl from coming back to life. If he were to live again, the world would suffer greatly from his thirst for vengeance.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.21: That's why I want you to meet with someone, a strange fellow who is known as the Nameless Bard... I am prohibited from telling you more about it. You should talk to Tarnian. He is a good friend and he fights to free Lighthaven from Olin Haad's clutches. Look for him in the outskirts of town, possibly near the cavern.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.22: So... you've heard about my wife. Yes, she died... Alenthia was... she was pregnant when th.. that vile necromancer killed her. He took her and my unborn child from me! What is worse, he didn't only take their bodies, but their "souls" as well.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.23: He bound their essence inside his necklace... He is trying to use this as leverage to force me into revealing the location of the burial grounds of Lothar. My poor Aly! As much as I want to save her, Artherk would never allow me to do such a thing. It would mean the end of everything! We must "stop" the dog at all costs!
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.24: As I said before, I received a letter from the king that explained Olin Haad's deception. The necromancer never stopped the Corrupters of Gluriurl as he was hired to do... he's actually a "part" of them!
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.25: Do you remember when I told you that the Corrupters were a fanatic cult of Gluriurl and that the king thought they were the survivors from the Battle of Emanations? It has been confirmed that Olin Haad was a "Harvester" of Life in this battle.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.26: The sole purpose of a Harvester is to bring the dead god Gluriurl back to life. They believe that once they achieve this, one of them will be chosen to rule over Althea. To dupe them into thinking this way, the dead god's heart gives them the "illusion" of power.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.27: He gives them what they call the Gift of Corruption. It supposedly nourishes the desire to revive dead god, while giving them considerable power. I used to believe that it was impossible for a mere mortal to fight against a for like this until just "recently".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.28: When I sent you to retrieve the Darkstone and the Skull of Gluriurl, I thought that the only way to stop the Harvesters was to gather the components for the ritual and hide them, but I was "wrong".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.29: In one of my books on the Battle of Emanations, I read that the alliance used a mighty blade called Caledbolg to defeat the Harvesters. I also found out that Artherk has blessed us by giving you the only thing that can give us access to where the sword lays... the "Heart" "of" "Artherk".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.3: The merchant... he was a nice man. He came to our church to pay homage to our lord Artherk while he was in town. That is when he saw the stone... He offered me gold coins and a ruby rod of foreign design for it and... "wait"!
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.30: What we had all along in our humble church was not the Heart of Gluriurl, but that of our humble lord, Artherk. To think that I actually sold it to a merchant! Finally, my dear friend "Efnisien" can begin to hope.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.31: Efnisien is the guardian of the entrance to Lothar's temple, but the necromancer doesn't know that. You should go now and find that blade. Caledbolg is kept safe in a shrine in the southeast part of the desert on Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.32: My name is Gunthar, but you may call me father Gunthar.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.33: Yes, that is my name, although you may call me father Gunthar, child.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.34: Yes, I am the high priest of Lighthaven.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.35: I am the High Priest of this town. My duties mostly involve teaching the priests, as well as an occasional sermon or two.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.36: Go with Artherk's blessing, my child.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.4: Now that I think about it... the merchant asked me something that I found odd at the time. He asked me if anyone had asked for the Heartstone before, but I told him no, and that he was the first. But when the "necromancer" came with his letter from the king, he also called it the Heartstone.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.5: May Artherk shield me from the influence of that vile spawn of wickedness. Our king, for reasons known only to him, hired this creature of darkness to stop a group of cultists called the "Corrupters" "of" "Gluriurl". Supposedly, the king promised him the stone if he could manage to get rid of the cultists.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.6: The Corrupters are believed to be a fanatic cult that worships a forgotten god called Gluriurl. The king believes that they are the survivors of an ancient battle that occured a century ago... the "Battle" "of" "Emanations".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.7: From what is written, the Battle of Emanations was the great battle between the Dragons and a powerful group of renegade Seraphs called the "Harvesters" "of" "Life".
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.8: The Harvesters of Life thrived on absolute destruction. They were nearly unstoppable and when they tried to destroy the island of Stoneheim, the "Dragons" intervened.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar.9: The Dragons, who were less in number than their enemies, lost nearly two thirds of their kin. Those Seraphs that were allied to the Dragons perished, and the Harvesters of Life were "completely" annihilated, or so it was thought.
npc.topic.highpriestgunthar2.0: Hurry! You must bring the stone to Olin Haad before it's too late!
npc.topic.humandrunk.0: zZzz.. Heh? Ah... Er... zzzZzZZzz... Zzz...
npc.topic.huntergruttworgwloth.0: Me am Grutt Worgwloth, son ub "Brogg" an brodder of "Trugg".
npc.topic.huntergruttworgwloth.1: Me go in forest an bash badd hummies an evil Moon Tug skraugs. Dey reelly badd. Wen dey see us, dey try tew bash an smash us guud.
npc.topic.huntergruttworgwloth.3: Brogg was me fodder but bad hummies like yu bash him. Me no like yur kind! Hummies har so ugly an stinky.
npc.topic.huntergruttworgwloth.4: Him huntor of hedds of Skraugs of Moon Tug. We is impresst by eem, we ore. If yew gots "scalps" of Moon Tug, yew otta give dem to eem.
npc.topic.huntergruttworgwloth.5: Yuk yuk yuk... Moon Tug scalps make guud soup. "Wajpoothin" mayks guud soup.
npc.topic.huntergruttworgwloth.6: No wun say dat tew Grutt an gett away wit it!
npc.topic.huntergruttworgwloth.7: About time hummie go. Me start tew gett hungry.
npc.topic.huntertruggworgwloth.0: Dey call me Trugg Worgwloth. Me no feer anyone. Trugg strung and can heel wounds guud if harm. Me "teech" if yew want.
npc.topic.huntertruggworgwloth.2: Brogg waz strung warrior. Brogg teech Grutt how tew fight.
npc.topic.huntertruggworgwloth.3: Me try tew sdop Moon Tug from steelin our liddle shiny metal.
npc.topic.huntertruggworgwloth.4: You week! Trugg teech if yew %u more levels and %u more endurance!
npc.topic.huntertruggworgwloth.5: "Learn" skill first! Den me train yew.
npc.topic.huntertruggworgwloth.6: Trugg gonna teech yu a liddle bashin' lesson!
npc.topic.huntertruggworgwloth.7: Guud, Trugg have sum werk tew dew.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.0: What can I do for you, %s?
npc.topic.iagocaballero.1: Yes? If you need me to "heal", you simply have to ask.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.10: I see that you have heard of this evil lady before. Do not ever trust her for she is a very manipulative person gifted with a skill for lies and deceits. The local thieves are known to be her allies.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.11: You could say that Baldric Silverknife is the thieves' leader in "Raven's" "Dust" but "Shadeen" doesn't trust him as he shares a mentality similar to hers.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.12: Ghundarg Rumblefoot is the orc leader. You should do best to not underestimate his shamanic powers.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.13: Bane Blackblood is a shadowy person blinded by his lust for power. He wishes the throne
npc.topic.iagocaballero.14: King Theodore XIIIth is the current ruler of the Kingdom of "Goldmoon".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.15: The Kingdom of Goldmoon regroups the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.18: Silversky is the small town located in the south-eastern part of "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.19: Arakas is the island located north of "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.2: I am Iago Caballero, paladin of the God of "Healing" and Mending, "Artherk".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.20: Raven's Dust is the island's name.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.21: Kalir and Jamir are often wandering in the desert. Quite frankly, I do not have a clue how they do it or why.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.22: Althea is the name of the world in which you are.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.23: I am sorry but I cannot answer this question of yours.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.24: Such foul words coming out of your mouth shows how much politeness you lack.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.25: Farewell, %s. Follow the path of Light and ye shall be protected.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.3: I follow the path set by my God, "Artherk". I spread seeds of righteousness throughout the realm, hoping to purify the sins done by other humans.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.4: Our God, "Artherk", has not yet answered my holy prayers.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.5: Artherk is the God of "Healing" and Mending. It is He who I pray to light my path and protect me of the influence of "evil".
npc.topic.iagocaballero.6: "Shadeen" is one evil woman. If you happen to see her, do not follow her orders for it will be your downfall into the path of sins.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.7: Ah ha! You have heard of us! Yes, I am such a champion, and there are many more that walk this land, and other lands in the west. If you seek to become one of us, I suggest you do only good deeds, then swear fealty to our righteous cause.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.8: So you truly desire this? Then speak to Chamberlain Thomar, he shall help you.
npc.topic.iagocaballero.9: Zhakar, despite his odd manners, is a wizard who follows the Path of Light.
npc.topic.idas.1: I am one of the knights of "Silversky".
npc.topic.idas.10: You have to tell me what is the number you wish to pick for the lottery. For example, if you want to pick number 11, just say {PICK} {11} and you are in business. The number you choose has to be between 1 and 12.
npc.topic.idas.2: Like Edden, my duty is to "guard" the entrance to the castle.
npc.topic.idas.3: Contrary to Edden here, I think the city should be closer to the castle.
npc.topic.idas.4: I must say it gets quite tiresome sometimes. I think I am getting too old for this.
npc.topic.idas.5: Although much younger than me, I still consider him a good friend.
npc.topic.idas.7: Yes, I know this thief very well. Caught him red-handed, once, but he managed to escape me, that fox! He's caused a great deal of trouble in these parts, especially when he meddled with the lonely wives of many honest men. *hmpf* We don't like his kind around here, so I hope you're no friend of his.
npc.topic.idas.8: I have not seen anyone suspicious. Even if I did, he would probably be in the dungeon right now.
npc.topic.idas.9: So %s, you want to give a shot at the lottery game Edden and I play? It's quite simple, really. You tell me the number you wish to "pick" and give me 1000 gold pieces. Then, I'll pick a number out of this bag. If you have the same number, you'll win. Then, I'll put that number back in the bag and I'll do this 4 more times! This means you can win up to five times! Surely you don't want to lose the opportunity to be a rich man or woman.Heh! Heh! Oh, and by the way, the number you choose has to be between 1 and 12.
npc.topic.iraltok.0: I have the unending task of collecting knowledge and transcribing it to books so that others may later "learn" from them.
npc.topic.iraltok.1: Arcane scribes such as myself use "runic" "scripting" "kits" in order to create "blank" "magic" "scrolls" that are later used to inscribe powerful magics.
npc.topic.iraltok.10: Urtanar is a great place. Many say it is the greatest tower of magic.  I was trained there and learned much about the ways of "magic". Even "Uranos" was once an apprentice there. Urtanar is in the middle of a great continent southwest of here. Perhaps one day you will be able to travel there.
npc.topic.iraltok.11: I'm always happy to help an initiate with his spells. There are several "spells" I can teach you.
npc.topic.iraltok.12: Yes, I would be glad to teach you a spell or two.
npc.topic.iraltok.13: Uranos is one of the greatest wizards in the kingdom of "Goldmoon".  He is also the oldest.
npc.topic.iraltok.14: Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping the islands of Arakas, which is the one you are currently on, and Raven's Dust, where the king's castle is.
npc.topic.iraltok.15: Yes, we have hundreds of them in our "library". In fact, we have so many we cannot count them all.
npc.topic.iraltok.16: It is located in the northwest corner of the tower.
npc.topic.iraltok.2: In order to create such a kit, I need a pouch of yellow powder, a vial of spider venom, a flask of goblin blood, a diamond, and a feather. I ask a modest fee of 1,000 gold pieces to make the kit for you. Please gather all I need and mention "make" "runic" "kit" when you're all set.
npc.topic.iraltok.3: I cannot make such scrolls myself, but I heard that some wizards in Windhowl could help you with this.
npc.topic.iraltok.5: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.iraltok.6: I am known as Iraltok, mage of "Urtanar", and the seeker of "knowledge".
npc.topic.iraltok.7: My task is as endless as time itself. I seek all "knowledge" and transcribe it into "books".
npc.topic.iroualknowall.0: I am Iroual Knowall and I know just about everything there is to know about "drinks", my friend!
npc.topic.iroualknowall.1: I am the barman and innkeeper of the Drunken Dragon's Inn. It's a very fine tavern, to say the least. I've been its owner for more than twenty years now! But where are my manners? Would you like a "drink"? We've got the very best ale in the whole town!
npc.topic.iroualknowall.2: Balork cursed you, you say? I'm sorry to hear that. If "Annabelle" the Blessed One was still here, she might be able to help you. But she's long gone, now. I hear a troll took her away to feast upon her.
npc.topic.iroualknowall.3: Oh, I don't know for sure if she's dead or alive, but she left us to find her true love years ago... Some say she lives with a troll, now. Me? I just think it's hogwash and she died.
npc.topic.iroualknowall.4: It's the best I tell ya!
npc.topic.iroualknowall.5: For 100 GP, I'll tell you about your karma. That comes with a good meal, so it's not a total waste. Will you pay?
npc.topic.iroualknowall.6: Here at the Drunken Dragon's Inn, we have the best ale in all of "Goldmoon". The king himself gets his supplies from here!
npc.topic.iroualknowall.7: Are you some kind of traveler? if you want to know about Goldmoon, just ask people about it. I don't have time to answer questions now.
npc.topic.isulgur.0: My name is Isulgur. I "work" for the town's "Lord".
npc.topic.isulgur.1: I work for Kirlor, the "lord" of Lighthaven. Since the "brigands" started attacking the "merchants", we have been very busy here at the "lord"'s office.
npc.topic.isulgur.10: Theodore's father was King Theopold. A great king indeed, he united all the villages of the land of "Goldmoon" to fight against the ever growing hordes of goblins. His leadership led to a legendary victory and brought peace throughout the land. Ever since Theodore gained the throne two years ago, things have been taking a turn for the worse. The goblins have begun making slow progress and the King is doing nothing about it.
npc.topic.isulgur.11: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to "Lord" "Sunrock" in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.isulgur.12: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.isulgur.16: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.isulgur.17: To help a merchant travel across the forest, all you have to do is register at the "Lord"'s office.
npc.topic.isulgur.18: The westernmost town on the island, Windhowl is the greatest in the kingdom. Still, be careful if you go there, "brigands" and strange creatures roam around the outskirts, ambushing wanderers.
npc.topic.isulgur.19: They have been regrouping lately and they are attacking our merchants every time they try to pass through the forest. I wish someone would stop them. They are ruining us!
npc.topic.isulgur.2: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.isulgur.4: Kirlor is the first and only lord this town has ever had. I'd have to say he has done a fine job up until now. The problem is that ever since "Theodore" XIII won the title of king of "Goldmoon", things have been going pretty bad around here, especially for the "merchants".
npc.topic.isulgur.5: Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping all the villages on the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.isulgur.6: Raven's Dust is the island on which the castle of "Theodore" XIII is located.  Travel southward from "Arakas" to find it.
npc.topic.isulgur.7: That is the name of the island you are currently on.
npc.topic.isulgur.8: Yes, Theodore XIII.  If you ask me, he isn't half the king his "father" used to be. He's so lazy, nothing ever gets done right around here. I heard things are getting pretty bad with the "goblin" invasion of "Windhowl", and having a sleepy king is no help, let me tell you!
npc.topic.isulgur.9: Goblin legions are massed in the mountains at the northwest corner of the island. "Windhowl" is the only defense standing between us and them.
npc.topic.jagarkar.0: I am Jagar Kar. I help people to "learn" new skills. My assistant and I have trained each and every one of the town's guards. I was even a personal guard of "Theopold" in my younger days. I have come here to "teach" people how to fight the "goblins".
npc.topic.jagarkar.1: Oh, I don't know if she's dead or alive for sure, but she left us to find her true love years ago... Some say she lives with a troll, now. Me? I just think it's hogwash and she died.
npc.topic.jagarkar.10: I don't seem to have as much time as I used to so I won't be able to train you in the use of your new skills. You can talk to my assistant though, I'm sure he'll be glad to help you.
npc.topic.jagarkar.11: I am here to "teach" people how to become fierce fighters. I must say, humbly, that I am great at it! Better yet, I am amazing, no uh, incredible! Err no that's not it, oh well... Anyway, you get the picture. There simply is no better teacher around here.
npc.topic.jagarkar.12: Go make use of those new skills and kill some damned goblins!
npc.topic.jagarkar.2: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.jagarkar.3: Oy! He's one of the finest warriors around. A tough fellow, that Ortanalas. He can work for hours without getting bored! Sometimes, I even give him the pleasure and honor of doing my laundry, shining my armor and weapons collection, and he still has a bright smile on his face after that. Never heard a word of complaint out of his mouth. I tell ya, good ones like him are hard to find, nowadays.
npc.topic.jagarkar.4: If I wasn't so busy training guardsmen, I would be out there crushing as many as I could! One day I'm going to charge right into "Righul"'s mountain, and show them my way of thinking.
npc.topic.jagarkar.5: Righul's mountain is where the goblins hide.  It's a very dangerous place for a normal fellow.  Swarms of goblins live there. Oy! But it's like a child's playground for me! Goblins are hardly a match for my superior battle skills!
npc.topic.jagarkar.6: Ahh, a great king he was. The greatest, no doubt. He didn't wimp out from a fight like his coward of a son, Theodore. He once went alone against a troll warband and came out victorious. He personally led the assault against the goblins, and he even fought in the front lines. His son must have inherited some goblin blood or something, because he is nothing like his father!
npc.topic.jagarkar.7: I indeed have a few Nightswords, but they're not for sale. I'll trade you for a "Sword" "of" "Fury", if you can find one. Some elite goblin warlords own one, so with some luck, who knows...
npc.topic.jagarkar.8: I'd gladly give you a Nightsword in exchange for a Sword of Fury. Do you have one to trade?
npc.topic.jalus.0: I am Jalus. Pleased to meet you.
npc.topic.jalus.1: Nice "field", isn't it? I take care of it and make sure everything will be all right for the next day!
npc.topic.jalus.2: Everybody has to "eat", right? Well, I've never met someone who didn't have to. That would be pretty handy in the "desert".
npc.topic.jalus.3: There are no deserts on Arakas, so you don't have to worry about that.
npc.topic.jalus.4: Is the day almost over already? My eyes aren't what they used to be. I usually know that night has come when I start feeling "hungry".
npc.topic.jalus.5: I heard there is a giant cow somewhere in this realm. If you ever get lucky enough to catch a glimpse of it, please let me know! How I would love to bite down on a nice, juicy steak right now.
npc.topic.jalus.6: Poor me, I never thought I would go blind some day. Now I know it won't be long. Nevertheless, I know that even blind I could tend to my crops as an "expert" would.
npc.topic.jalus.7: You can only reach the level of expertise that I have after many years of work.
npc.topic.jalus.9: I don't know that woman. Sorry I couldn't help you.
npc.topic.jamar.10: I have not seen anyone like that.
npc.topic.jamar.3: He is still in the desert somewhere, lagging behind as usual.
npc.topic.jamar.4: Well, I feel more alive when I am walking under the desert sun.
npc.topic.jamar.5: If you would like to give me something, just type "give <item name>" and that should do it. For instance, if you would like to give me, say, a letter, you should say "give letter".
npc.topic.jamar.6: Oh, a letter from Kalir?? Thank you! I was getting a little worried about him. This letter says where he is, so I can join him a little later. Thanks for bringing it here. Please take this letter to him so he knows where to meet me...
npc.topic.jamar.7: Hm? No, I don't have such a key. It's Kalir who's got it, sorry...
npc.topic.jamar.8: The desert west of here is not one to be taken lightly.
npc.topic.jamar.9: Kalir and I have been friends for many years now.
npc.topic.jarko.0: The name is the Great Jarko to you and it will be the last you will ever hear if you attempt to thwart my "plans" of conquest. With this "spellbook" in my hand, nothing shall stand in my way, not even "Makrsh" "P'Tangh" and especially not you.
npc.topic.jarko.1: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.jarko.10: It is not of your business to know what I do. But you shall know in time.
npc.topic.jarko.11: The goblins and the undead minions are nothing but my war toys. They can be easily replaced if they are defeated. By my grandfather's rotting leg, if one goblin dies, I can even channel a small portion of my magical energy and animate his lifeless body. Nothing can stop me! Ha ha ha!!
npc.topic.jarko.12: The island of Arakas is part of the kingdom of Goldmoon and it is ruled by King Theodore. They say he is weak, but I say he is intelligent enough not to cross my path by sending his armies against mine. Only the "druids" dare to challenge me.
npc.topic.jarko.13: Lighthaven is able to repel my goblins but still, it has problems with the minor undeads that are raising from their own cemetary.
npc.topic.jarko.14: I can assure you that this town will fall into my hands in no time.
npc.topic.jarko.15: "Araknor" once tried to wrest the spellbook of necromancy from me, but failed miserably. Would you like to have it and all the powers that are kept within these pages?
npc.topic.jarko.16: My sources tell me that the Stone of Life has been stolen from the druids. By the rotten leg of my grandfather, I must have it! I MUST! Find it and bring it back to me in time, and I shall reward you greatly!
npc.topic.jarko.17: If you get killed on your way back, do not worry, I have a job for you. Ha ha ha!
npc.topic.jarko.2: Who is she? Bah! I have no time for such nonsense!
npc.topic.jarko.3: Araknor might practice the same dark art as I do, but he really is no match for my powerful magic. In fact, he can barely fight one of my goblins. Some day, he is bound to make a mistake that will cost him his life, and then I shall enslave him as one of my undead minions.
npc.topic.jarko.4: Mhorgwloth the troll lives in the ruined Castle of Orkanis north of these mountains. He usually does not bother my "goblins" much, unless they attempt to enter his domain.
npc.topic.jarko.5: The Lich Makrsh P'Tangh is said to have been cursed--or blessed--during one of the "comings", I do not quite remember which one nor do I really care. It is said that he was once an Elven prince who now rules as the Prince of Darkness. Pah! I am sure he is no match for my magic!
npc.topic.jarko.6: The Oracle claims it has seen a vision and that the Fourth Coming is finally at hand and humans will be judged for their misdeeds. It does not cause me much concern because I intend to be powerful enough to be *THE* judge.
npc.topic.jarko.7: It was a good move to recruit the Orc Leader. He is able to lead my armies to great victories even though the "goblins" despise him.
npc.topic.jarko.8: The druids are located on the northeastern part of the island. Their magical powers are the only threat to my "plans". I would be highly interested in studying the "source" of their power.
npc.topic.jarko.9: According to the reports I have received from my goblin spy, the druids apparently worship a "stone" "of" "life", which is an ordinary stone in which they have poured life, hence its name.
npc.topic.jeremiah.1: Personally, I think it's a wonderful name.
npc.topic.jeremiah.2: Hah! You want to know what I do for a living? Then I'll tell you! I travel the world over in search of whatever is "worth" searching for! Sounds interesting? It is, let me tell you my friend!
npc.topic.jeremiah.3: Well, part of my work is to bring back the details of my findings and explorations to "Menark". He can then scribe all my notes into books that are available to everyone.
npc.topic.jeremiah.4: He is getting too old to travel, so all he does is write into those books there. I suppose I should be grateful because it leaves all the travelling to me!
npc.topic.jeremiah.5: Hmm, now that you mention it, I have noticed a strange individual searching through the records awhile ago. I didn't really pay him much heed, seeing as he was very polite upon entering and leaving the grounds.
npc.topic.jeremiah.6: The books you see all around you were all written by Menark. I can't imagine reading all of them, let alone writing them. Menark is very courageous, in his own way.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.1: I am Jon Hamhoo, your humble servant.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.10: It is rumored that Blackblood has a daughter.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.11: Zhakar? He is the old mage who lives secluded in his tower.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.12: That's not a smart thing to say to a man holding a butcher's knife.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.13: Fine! I have still have work to do.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.2: I am the royal cook. I am the one who has to cook all the meals for the entire castle. Not to mention about King "Theodore"'s insatiable appetite. My occupation is not an easy one as you see. Especially during the day, I never have a moment to myself.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.3: Yeah, we made this cake for His Majesty's forty-fifth birthday. It was a *huge* cake, and through a really "odd story", it turned out to be put into the cake and was found by someone...
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.4: Well, it went like this... The king's youngest son, Theokrat, found the key in his father's apartments... Sort of took it without permission. Anyway, as he was wandering in the castle's corridors, he chanced upon a group of thieves who had snuck inside the castle to steal expensive tapestries... But you don't care to hear "the rest", do you?
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.5: Ah, well, as you wish... In any case, the thieves saw the young prince and started running after him. Fortunately, His Highness knew the castle well and managed to evade them, but not before losing the key somewhere along the way in the castle's dungeons. It was found some time after by a wandering atrocity that had dug its way into the dungeons. Want to hear "more"?
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.6: I wonder where King Theodore stores all the food he eats. He always sleeps, but somehow always seems to find time to eat my meals.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.7: Raven's Dust is the name of this island.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.8: It doesn't look quite like your usually peaceful forest.
npc.topic.jonhamhoo.9: I never went in the desert nor do I want to.
npc.topic.julian.0: My name is Julian. Are you surprised I knew your name? Why, who has not heard of the one that slew the great Shadeen?
npc.topic.julian.1: I live in a small house not far to the northeast. I am to spy on the townsfolk and report any important events to my "master".
npc.topic.julian.10: Ahh, the Bones of Ogrimar, yes. Did my master send you to look for them?
npc.topic.julian.11: There is a complex maze of caves under the northeast part of Stoneheim. Inside one of these caverns rest the Bones of Ogrimar. The "entrance" to this cave is but one amongst many.
npc.topic.julian.12: There was once a man called Venadar who was believed to be successful in finding the Bones of Ogrimar. This man, a giant among men, was a good friend of the one called Khimtesar. One day while walking outside the house of his friend after a meal, Venadar fell into an unseen hole that opened up to a huge cavern in the ground. Being very tall, he was able to climb back out of the hole and trace his steps back to the well behind Khimtesar's house. Some say he inscribed this information on the well itself. Afterwards, he returned to the hole in the ground and explored it for days, after which he found the bones. Very few know of this and even fewer know what happened to Venadar afterwards. Remember this story when you look for the entrance, and you will succeed.
npc.topic.julian.13: I'll have nothing to do with someone as ill-mannered as you.
npc.topic.julian.14: Very well, until we meet again.
npc.topic.julian.2: A must-have item for any black wizard.
npc.topic.julian.3: I know of these robes! They provide near-invulnerability against fire and darkness, but make the wearer very vulnerable against water and light. If you ever have some that you would part with, please let me know.
npc.topic.julian.4: I cannot reveal his name to you... but I can tell you where to find him. He lives within a natural fortress of mountains to the north. Seek him out, and perhaps he will deem you worthy of the knowledge of his name.
npc.topic.julian.5: Ahh, it appears that you have been successful in gathering all the things I have asked for, splendid! If you still want me to make some nephil spider venom, I will need all these things and 20000 gold for my troubles of course. Do you still wish for me to do this?
npc.topic.julian.6: You can find some spider venom on the giant black widows and necrospiders far to the east of this town.
npc.topic.julian.7: The arachnofiends sometimes carry these. You can find them far to the east of here.
npc.topic.julian.8: I believe there is a shaman in one of the skraug villages that sells these, but I cannot say precisely which.
npc.topic.julian.9: You have found the Blood of Ogrimar? Splendid! Well, just remember that I helped you get it, heh heh.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.0: My name is Jurnistakr Kira. Greetings to you.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.1: I bear the title of Archbishop of "Artherk".
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.2: But Balork's dead... Isn't he? No?!? Heavens!
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.3: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady, but somewhat odd, even though I've never seen her myself.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.4: Artherk is without a doubt the greatest of all the gods. I follow his ways faithfully and will certainly continue to do so until my life's end. Because of the importance of my work and the "responsibilities" I carry, I do not have much time to answer your questions. I will therefore ask that you be brief.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.5: The duty of an archbishop is to help troops in combat. I must accompany the soldiers and follow closely behind during battle against the evil "goblin" army. The wounded are brought to me and I do my best to get them back into the fray or to make sure they can survive the trip back home.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.6: Not many towns are as lucky as we are to have an army capable of resisting the continuous onslaught of goblins.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.7: I am but one of many who have chosen to use their healing spells for the greater good of civilization. If you wish to help further the ambitions of the church, a small "donation" of 200 gold will be rewarded with the healing of your wounds.
npc.topic.jurnistakrkira.8: I see, you are interested in helping us with our cause? Well if you have enough money to pay, I will heal your wounds without further delay. Do you still wish to be healed?
npc.topic.kahplethguard1.0: The skraung guard glares at you and you quickly wish you were somewhere else.
npc.topic.kahplethguard2.0: The skraug guard glares at you and you quickly wish you were somewhere else.
npc.topic.kalastor.0: My name is Kalastor, but don't tell anybody. If you don't keep it a "secret", you'll soon find yourself without a purse.
npc.topic.kalastor.1: Yes, that's my name. You're pretty sharp, aren't you?
npc.topic.kalastor.10: Ah, well then, it appears you wish to take part in the darker side of the world. That's great news, really. Welcome to the world of fame and fortune! There's a lot of stuff going on in this town, but we don't "trust" you yet, so you'll have to do "earn" it by doing "missions" for us.
npc.topic.kalastor.11: What do I look like to you, an employment center? I don't give work to people who aren't members of the Shadow Guild. Go away.
npc.topic.kalastor.12: Edgar? Edgar Gimplestratten? A pain in the back, if y'ask me. He owes me a lot of money. I work my @$$ off for him and what do I get? Rejection! Scorn! I tell you, this world is all upside down!
npc.topic.kalastor.13: Just tell him my "name" and that you're there to collect the protection fee he owes me. Then come back and tell me all about it.
npc.topic.kalastor.14: I have nothing to teach you.
npc.topic.kalastor.15: What, you would think we're gullible enough to trust you just like that? No, we will test your resolve before we tell you more about who's who, and what's going on.
npc.topic.kalastor.16: You don't know much about geography, do you? It's the other island that makes the Kingdom of Goldmoon, ruled by our <cough> beloved <cough> King "Theodore" "XIII".
npc.topic.kalastor.17: Aaah, what a <cough> GREAT <choke> King we have, wouldn't you say? But I can't complain. If he didn't spend his time sleeping, boozing and womanizing, I'd be out of a job. *grin*
npc.topic.kalastor.18: You want to know more about the Shadow Guild? Perhaps you do, and perhaps you don't... At the very least, I can tell you it's a guild of thieves... and more.
npc.topic.kalastor.19: Well, yes, actually I just stole your purse! Do you want it back?
npc.topic.kalastor.2: I am an apprentice "thief". I could show you how to rob someone later if you like. All you have to do is close your eyes and open your purse while you ask for training.
npc.topic.kalastor.20: Don't tell him I told you his name.
npc.topic.kalastor.21: I do not have the skills necessary to teach you anything.
npc.topic.kalastor.23: We're just friends, okay? So don't give me these looks! Sheez... Some people are just busybodies...
npc.topic.kalastor.24: Uh huh. Awesome use of the language. Care to try again?
npc.topic.kalastor.25: Next time, bring more gold! Just kidding. *smile*
npc.topic.kalastor.3: I don't know where she is.
npc.topic.kalastor.4: So you killed him? Good for you, too bad for the rest of us. S'okay, though, he'll come back to life in a little while. His corporeal form regenerates over time, so it's not like you did any permanent damage.
npc.topic.kalastor.5: There's indeed a great evil that walks the land, but personally, I'd prefer to stay away from it, like... *cough* like honest folks do.
npc.topic.kalastor.6: Ugly, fast and very powerful. If you're gonna go fight them, make sure you're loaded up with healing potions.
npc.topic.kalastor.7: Yes, my master calls himself "Shadow" Stalker. He never told me his real name.
npc.topic.kalastor.8: They live west from here, between here and Windhowl. They won't know who you are, so they may attack you. Don't mess with them, they're mean and tough.
npc.topic.kalastor.9: Yes, my master has taught me the ways of "robbing" and the like. I'm also quite adept at dodging, and I could probably "train" you in that field, seeing as it is very useful for a thief. Heh heh.
npc.topic.kalir.0: *huff* Forgive my... exhaustion. *puff* I am Kalir.
npc.topic.kalir.1: No, I'm sorry, I don't have such a key. I think you should ask my friend "Jamar".
npc.topic.kalir.10: Jamar would be a good friend... *gasp* if he didn't always leave me behind.
npc.topic.kalir.11: I doubt there are many people that wander into the desert *gasp* just for the pleasure of it.
npc.topic.kalir.2: If you would like to give me something, just type "give" "<item name>" and that should do it. For instance, if you would like to give me, say, a letter, you should say "give" "letter".
npc.topic.kalir.3: What?!? Jamar wrote back! Fantastic! *gasp* Now I know where we can meet again! Thank you for all the help! Hrmm. I think you wanted something from me before I've sent you on this errand... now... *gasp* What was it? Something about a key...? *pant*
npc.topic.kalir.6: Well, "Jamar" has abandonned me *pant* as usual, so I am trying to catch up to him. *gasp*
npc.topic.kalir.7: He has... probably already made it *huff* into the "town".
npc.topic.kalir.8: Why, yes *pant* the town of Silversky... *huff* *puff* you must have seen it already.
npc.topic.kalir.9: The sun is very hot and bright here... *pant* *pant* It is dangerous just to sit around if you are not adequately dressed. *puff*
npc.topic.karahn.0: I am known throughout these parts as Karahn.
npc.topic.karahn.2: I travel the countryside selling my "wares".
npc.topic.karahn.3: Why, I deal in "weapons" of high quality! Would you like to take a look at them?
npc.topic.karahn.4: You want to see what I have to sell, is that it?
npc.topic.karahn.5: I have some of the best weapons you can find on this island. There's only one other who can boast that he has better wares, and that's "Seban" "Forgelot".
npc.topic.karahn.6: As much as it pains me to say, he probably has the best weapons you'll find anywhere on this island. Mind you, I'm not saying they are going to be cheap!
npc.topic.karahn.7: Hmm, I suppose I could take a peek to see if there's something I want.
npc.topic.karahn.8: Come back if you need anything else.
npc.topic.karl.0: My name is Karl and I am rather "busy" now.
npc.topic.karl.1: I am the assistant trainer. I help Sir "Arganor" with his work. It is a tiring job, but I manage. If you're here to "train" your attack skills, you've come to the right place.
npc.topic.karl.3: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.karl.5: What a great man! His swordsmanship is unmatched in the realm. He has already won many tournaments across the "land".
npc.topic.karl.6: The world is a large place indeed, my friend. I haven't traveled much of it myself, but I hope to change that someday.
npc.topic.karl.7: He is the other assistant. A good lad with a big heart, his only flaw is his bad temper. I have known him for years now, and although we both like to work here, we are getting very tired of it.
npc.topic.kavarian.0: My name is Kavarian the Unseen.
npc.topic.kavarian.1: Yes, I am Kavarian the Unseen. My knowledge of the "arts" has allowed me to become invisible to the naked eye.
npc.topic.kavarian.10: The major combat sense spell greatly augments the recipient's fighting abilities. You are required to have knowledge of the minor combat sense spell to learn it.
npc.topic.kavarian.11: The invisibility spell renders the caster completely invisible to the naked eye. The caster will still be visible to someone with the detect invisible spell cast upon them, however. To learn this spell, you must have knowledge of the detect invisible spell.
npc.topic.kavarian.2: I have been studying the art of spellcraft for a very long time now. Ever since I was but a small boy, my path in life has always been that of the "wizard".
npc.topic.kavarian.3: The path of the wizard is a hard one to follow, but in the end all the hard work pays off.
npc.topic.kavarian.4: Well, my long "research" has taught me the ability to alter my physical appearance in such a way that I blend into my surroundings, rendering me nearly invisible. Only those with a certain enchantment can see me.
npc.topic.kavarian.5: I have long ago stopped working to pursue my own goals. As it happens, the "research" I have done has allowed me to make a great deal of profit. Consequently, there is little I cannot provide for myself in the way of material things.
npc.topic.kavarian.6: I have been conducting research in several fields of the mystic arts. Seeing as I am discovered, I see no harm in "teaching" you a few of my best spells.
npc.topic.kavarian.7: Hmm, this is a strange variety of spells, you will probably think, but they are all very potent spells nonetheless.
npc.topic.kavarian.8: The dispel spell will remove all negative spells that are anchored on the target, and will have a chance of remove some of the other spells also.
npc.topic.kavarian.9: The flare spell can inflict tremendous amounts of fire damage on a living target and may even set it on fire for a short period of time. You are required to have the rain of fire spell before you can learn it.
npc.topic.kederic.0: I am known as Kederic Riverbane, "harvester" of the rains.
npc.topic.kederic.2: I harvest the powers and forces that flow in waters all around us.
npc.topic.kederic.3: I am here to protect the forest and all who inhabit it. I can also "teach" you a spell or two.
npc.topic.kederic.4: You're interested? In that case, this is what I can teach you.
npc.topic.kederic.5: So you seek the maleak plant? I believe there might be some in the nearby woods.
