npc.topic.khanwulgworth.0: My name is Khan Wulgworth. You may call me 'Your Honor' since I graduated in Law from the Corinthian Academy of Jurists.
npc.topic.khanwulgworth.1: I trained to be a judge, but seeing all the corruption of human society convinced me to return to my folks and improve their lives.
npc.topic.khanwulgworth.2: If you will help me, I might have a task for you. Have you ever heard of "Skraugbashor" "Maces"? If so,please kindly bring me as many as you can.
npc.topic.khanwulgworth.3: Yes, I have heard something to that effect. It seems there is a human in the town of Stonecrest that trades valuables and other paraphernalia in exchange for a certain type of skull. I believe his name was Delnar... yes that was it.
npc.topic.khanwulgworth.4: This is quite an excellent item, even though it's Kahp Leth manufacture. This said, should you bring me five such maces, I will gladly reward you with a "belt" "of" "skraug" "strength".
npc.topic.khanwulgworth.5: I'll reward you with a "Belt" "of" "Skraug" "Strength" if you bring me five "Skraugbashor" "Maces".
npc.topic.khanwulgworth.7: Fare well, and be sure to stay away from my people.
npc.topic.khimtesar.0: Well then why are you here? I have much to do, you know.
npc.topic.khimtesar.1: I am known as Khimtesar, but you can call me old Kim.
npc.topic.khimtesar.10: The Windhowl gateway spell opens a doorway that allows the caster to instantly travel to a pre-established location in the viscinity of the town of Windhowl. To learn this spell, you must have knowledge of the word of recall spell. Do you still wish to learn it?
npc.topic.khimtesar.11: The Silversky gateway spell opens a doorway that allows the caster to instantly travel to a pre-established location in the viscinity of the town of Silversky. To learn this spell, you must have knowledge of the word of recall spell. Do you still wish to learn it?
npc.topic.khimtesar.12: The Stonecrest gateway spell opens a doorway that allows the caster to instantly travel to a pre-established location inside the town of Stonecrest. To learn this spell, you must have knowledge of the word of recall spell. Do you still wish to learn it?
npc.topic.khimtesar.13: The Druid's Point gateway spell opens a doorway that allows the caster to instantly travel to a pre-established location in the viscinity of Druid's Point, on Arakas. To learn this spell, you must have knowledge of the word of recall spell. Do you still wish to learn it?
npc.topic.khimtesar.14: The Wizard's Vale gateway spell opens a doorway that allows the caster to instantly travel to a pre-established location in the viscinity of Wizard's Vale, on Raven's Dust. To learn this spell, you must have knowledge of the word of recall spell. Do you still wish to learn it?
npc.topic.khimtesar.2: That's right! You're a bright one aren't you?
npc.topic.khimtesar.3: I have not heard that name in a long time...
npc.topic.khimtesar.4: I am a scholar of the arcane art. I spend most of the time I have reading large tomes of magic.
npc.topic.khimtesar.5: I will not tolerate this kind of abusive language. I am taking half of your gold as punishment!
npc.topic.khimtesar.6: At last, I can return to my studies.
npc.topic.khimtesar.7: Ahh, so you come here seeking my help as a scholar of the magic arts, is that it? Very well then, I will teach you what my research has taught me. If you did not already know, there are currently seven destinations for the gateway spells. These are "Lighthaven" "gateway", "Windhowl" "gateway", "Druid's" "Point" "gateway", "Silversky" "gateway", "Wizard's" "Vale" "gateway", "Stonecrest" "gateway" and "Sunken" "Woods" "gateway". As a small note, the "Sunken" "Woods" "gateway" spell will bring you near this place. Now then, which spell would you like to learn?
npc.topic.khimtesar.8: The Sunken Woods gateway spell opens a doorway that allows the caster to instantly travel to a pre-established location inside the Sunken Woods forest, which happens to be right behind my house. To learn this spell, you must have knowledge of the word of recall spell. Do you wish to learn the Sunken Woods gateway spell?
npc.topic.khimtesar.9: The Lighthaven gateway spell opens a doorway that allows the caster to instantly travel to a pre-established location in the viscinity of the town of Lighthaven. To learn this spell, you must have knowledge of the word of recall spell. Do you still wish to learn it?
npc.topic.kiadus.3: Would you like to take a look at what I have to offer?
npc.topic.kiadus.4: I'm sorry, friend, but you'll have to come back later when the sun is up.
npc.topic.kiadus.5: I haven't seen anyone out of the ordinary.
npc.topic.kiadus.6: Hmm, it would seem I have forgotten what her name is again. If you would give me another 2000 gold, I'm sure I would remember it again. So how about it?
npc.topic.kiadus.7: Sword? I'm sorry but I don't sell swords.
npc.topic.kiadus.8: Feel free to stop by anytime!
npc.topic.kilhiam.0: The High Priest? He had to leave to take care of some important matters. You should talk to Brother Kiran if you need more details.
npc.topic.kilhiam.1: People are nice around here. If you need to know someone's "name", just ask them. It's the same for their "work" too. Most of them will tell you without any complaints.
npc.topic.kilhiam.10: The Sanctuary is where your body and soul are restored by the Gem of Destiny if you have been killed. Do you wish to set the Temple of Lighthaven as your sanctuary?
npc.topic.kilhiam.2: Balork's brand is a terrible curse he bestows upon those foolish enough to dare challenge him.
npc.topic.kilhiam.3: Annabelle has a peculiar healing touch.
npc.topic.kilhiam.4: I'm a priestess of "Artherk". Sometimes I "teach" new spells to those I deem worthy of such responsibility. I'm not the only one doing this. There are many practitioners around the world which will teach you about almost any skill you can possibly think of. All you must do is choose a path, or several paths to take and try to find the people willing to aid you in those fields. Artherk has also blessed me with the Gift of "sanctuary".
npc.topic.kilhiam.5: Artherk is a wonderful god. If you have any questions, I will do my best to answer them. On the other hand, if you feel that the conversation is over and you have no need of anything else, you can always say "goodbye" and be on your way.
npc.topic.kilhiam.6: Priests are people who specialize in the art of healing and treating wounds and the like. This is achieved by the use of certain spells which deal with the elements of earth and water. Once you have learned these spells, you can always call upon their power to aid you. Unlike skills, spells need not be practiced and achieve full effectiveness as soon as you learn them. Because of this, the price to pay tends to be significantly higher than with skills. As you gain experience in battle, you will be able to increase your abilities as well as learn new skills and spells. If you wish, I can teach you one of the most basic spells available. It is the "light" spell, which will help you see in the darkness. Do you wish to learn it now?
npc.topic.kilhiam.7: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.kilhiam.8: Windhowl is located on the western side of the island.
npc.topic.kilhiam.9: It is always unfortunate to face death, but those who wear a Gem of Destiny can set a "Sanctuary" where they will reappear when they get killed.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.0: I am Aedenas Gravesoul, revered King of the centaurs.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.1: I am king of the Centaurs. I have sworn to protect my people from the Kahp Leth skraugs.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.10: It seems the Windchasers have always been guardians of our town. They are a strong and proud lineage, and I couldn't imagine our clan without them to protect us.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.11: Seek out Thor Glarefire, our most competent blacksmith.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.12: I think that he lives somewhere in Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.13: You are not ready to undertake the quest that will lead you to the Will of Artherk.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.14: You will need the ethereal key to use the ethereal portal. As for the location of the portal, I'm afraid that you're on your own as the portal is never located in the same place.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.15: I have already told you all there is to know about these.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.16: You no longer need the staff of submission. Therefore, I shall take it back.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.17: If you want to defeat the red-eyed centaurs, you will need the "staff" "of" "submission" first.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.18: If you want to defeat the red-eyed centaurs, you will need the "staff" "of" "submission" first.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.19: The staff of submission is a magical weapon that can knock unconscious the red-eyed centaurs without harming them more than necessary. If you can defeat twelve red-eyed centaurs using the staff of submission and bring me back the mind-control talismans, I shall help you further in your quest. Do you agree to help me?
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.2: Those books come in series of five. Thus if you bring me a complete series, I will reward you with a "Ring" "of" "the" "Lion".
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.20: Zion Thunderheart is my cousin and he is next in line for the centaur throne. He hungers for power and even went as far as spreading foul rumors about me in hope of gaining support.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.21: The red-eyed centaurs are under the hypnotic influence of the mind-control talismans that have been distributed by my treacherous cousin, Zion Thunderheart.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.22: If you seek the Fangs of True Resolve, the White Crow can help you in your quest.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.23: You are a dishonor to your race.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.3: If you have time, I would look favorably upon your bringing me "Collector's" "Books" to add to my collection.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.4: It is quite a precious item. Not only is it almost priceless, but it will give you great courage. Unless you wish to give it to Sir Beltigan, I hear he is in the business of purchasing those rings. I'm sure it would help your karma.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.5: He probably doesn't realize I know what he's been up to, but that's how it should be. I know he plots behind my back and I can make sure he doesn't get out of control. Keeps your friends close, I say, and your enemies even closer.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.6: Strong and reliable Kyathos. He's one of our best warriors and an excellent guard. When he patrols our town, I know everyone's safe.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.7: His manneris a little gruff, but he's one of the best smiths you can hope to find in the world. Be sure to drop by his shop, some day, and buy a few trinkets off him.
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.8: Without Dionysus, ruling the Centaurs would be a far more daunting task than it currently is. His gentle words of wisdom, his vision and his compassion would make him an excellent king to succeed me when I depart, but I know he is dedicated to Artherk and would not want the position. That's why he would be perfect. *sigh* I wonder sometimes if there will be someone to follow in my footsteps when I'm gone...
npc.topic.kingaedenasgravesoul.9: I suspect he works in secret with Zion Thunderheart, but I have no proof.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.0: *yawn* I am not quite in the mood for some chit-chat.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.1: I am "King" "Theodore" the XIIIth, ruler of the Kingdom of "Goldmoon" and proud father of "Princess" "Delilah".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.10: Princess Delilah is my proud daughter. Although, I fear that she may have become too attached to her mentor, "Bishop" "Rikken" "Crowbanner". She cannot bear when he falls into sickness and spends her days in prayer for his recovery.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.13: Please, do not speak of Ghundarg Rumblefoot in my presence. I let "Mordrick" "Warstone" to deal with them, that is what he is paid for.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.14: *yawn* Yes, I have some of those. But, I don't see why one such as you would need one.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.15: How should know who could tan an animal's skin? I am the king, not the Oracle. But.. wait.. perhaps Samuel knows someone. Ask him on my behalf.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.16: Mordrick Warstone is the best knight in the realm. Perhaps you might want to step forward as a recruit into our army? If so, simply ask him.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.17: When my father passed away, a "tournament" took place and I, Theodore the XIIIth, was the sole survivor. Thus, I inherited of my father's title and became the "King" of Goldmoon.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.18: Isn't a small town located somewhere in "Arakas"?
npc.topic.kingtheodore.19: Windhowl? I don't have a clue about what you're referring to.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.2: One should think that a King has nothing to do but it is quite the opposite. All day long, I have to isolate myself in my private quarters and think how I could improve the life of all the people in my "kingdom".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.20: Arakas is an island located north of Raven's Dust. It is also part of the kingdom of "Goldmoon".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.21: No one would want to go there and especially not me.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.22: Raven's Dust is the name of this island.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.23: Yes, this is my title. Or you may call me your "Highness".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.24: I am royally offended by such gross words! GUARDS! Bring this denizen to jail NOW!!!
npc.topic.kingtheodore.25: Our conversation has come to an end, I think it is time for a little nap.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.3: Indeed, I am King Theodore the XIIIth.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.4: Such impoliteness! If you must talk to me, do it using my rightful title!
npc.topic.kingtheodore.5: They are dead and gone. Ghosts do not exist.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.6: When father passed away, it was written that my twelve "brothers" and I had to fight to death. I shall spare you how bravely I fought my own brothers... but the bottom line is that I've won. Thus, I have been crowned "King" of "Goldmoon".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.7: King Theopold was my father and a good king. I must say that I am much like him and everybody in the kingdom is happy.
npc.topic.kingtheodore.8: This is such as great castle. It was built by my late father, "King" "Theopold".
npc.topic.kingtheodore.9: Yet another rebel who is jealous of my throne. He does not cause much of a threat to me.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.0: My name is Kirlor Dhul, Lord of Lighthaven. I "work" to help my citizens live a better life!
npc.topic.kirlordhul.1: My occupation is to collect taxes, serve our great "King" and protect the villagers of our humble town, although, we have had some "problems" with that lately.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.10: I heard it was a very bloody fight.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.11: Brigands have been banding together to attack our merchant carriers. Since I don't have many guards, I can't spare any of them to protect the merchants. I must keep them to "protect" the town against a sudden goblin invasion. Lord Sunrock is offering rewards for anyone who will help a merchant to deliver his report across the forest to our sister town, "Windhowl". Would you like to register?
npc.topic.kirlordhul.12: The path to Windhowl is home to many brigands and strange creatures, so be careful not to get ambushed.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.13: Many of them cannot afford to get plundered by roving bandits and will be grateful for the assistance. See "Rolph" or "Sigfried" if you want to help them with the report.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.16: Just ask any merchant about it and he will give you more details.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.17: Those guards are the best at their job. There isn't a monster who gets within bow-shot that doesn't get chased back to the mountains.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.18: Feel free to come back anytime.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.2: I heard that she has Elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.kirlordhul.4: Yes, our great King Theodore the "XIII"th.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.5: His story is a rather short one, and not too inspiring. When "Theopold" died, his 12 other sons all had to compete in a deadly "tournament".  The survivor would then inherit the kingdom. Surprisingly, Theodore was the only one to survive this lethal match. Rumor has it that the reason he survived was because he was sleeping when the tournament actually took place, although I have not been able to confirm this.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.6: Ahh! A great king indeed. He united all the villages of "Goldmoon" to fight against the ever-growing hordes of goblins. His leadership led to a legendary victory and kept peace throughout the land. Now that his son is on the throne, the situation is deteriorating at an alarming rate. Our forces are wearing thin and the last time I asked him what his plans were for the region, he told me that he would sleep on it!
npc.topic.kirlordhul.7: Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping all the villages on the island of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.kirlordhul.8: That is the island on which the castle of Theodore is located. Head south of "Arakas" if you wish to find it.
npc.topic.kirlordhul.9: That is the name of the island you are currently on.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.0: I go by the name of Kyathos Shatterskull.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.1: I am a guard and my duty is to ensure that no skraugs will ever invade our land again.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.2: I can't help you, stranger, but I'll tell you this: during your stay here in our town, you either walk a straight line, or you deal with me.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.3: You shouldn't associate with the likes of Thunderheart or Fatebringer. They're not people who work for the greater good.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.4: He's another guard, like me. Don't get in our way, we're busy people.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.5: See my weapons? See my armor? He made them. It cost me quite a bit, but I'm one of the best Centaur warriors you can find, thanks to his superior equipment.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.6: We all like Dionysus. Whenever there's a dispute that's too petty for the King to handle, Dionysus steps in and makes sure we're all treated fairly. We're indebted to him.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.7: Gladdius's not too worried about him, but I have reason to believe Malachai Fatebringer isn't always on our side, if you know what I mean. I suspect he's dabbling in dark powers, but no one believes me.
npc.topic.kyathosshatterskull.8: He was once married and had a heir, but they became sick and died many years ago. Our poor king never really recovered and hasn't remarried. It was very tragic, really.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.0: I am a master smith. If you need some weapons or armors, "forged" or "improved", I'm your man. If not, might as well be on your way. *Mutter*
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.1: Will these questions ever end? You can call me Silversmith. Lance is my first name. *sigh*
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.10: I'm afraid that forging a sword of majesty isn't my area of expertise. You should ask "Thor" "Glarefire" of Stoneheim instead. If I can help you for anything else, feel free to ask and I'll see what I can do.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.11: I have already made the three Hammers of Finality that you needed.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.12: Thor Glarefire is a centaur blacksmith who taught me everything I know.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.13: Raven's Dust? Been there, done that... A quaint little island, although not much is ever happening there. *hrmph* A few monsters, evil sorcerers and thugs... Perhaps I can interest you in some of my wares...
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.14: Arakas, you say? *Cough* You... you're still looking for that island? Well, if you don't know where it is by now, then we really have no business together.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.15: The Sleeping King, we call him, but not in front of the guards. He's not really a bad king, he just doesn't do what a king should do. Think that's seditious? Blasted right it is! *Arumph* Problem with that? Didn't think so.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.16: Oh, wonderful, you've just discovered new words!
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.2: I can build special weapons or armors for you, if you provide me with the basic materials and components, and have the gold pieces to afford my services. I can create a "Blessed" "Chainmail", a "Gloomblade", or a "Demonblade".
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.4: The Gloomblade is a weapon of darkness, one that I am loathe to make. But I have sworn to uphold the balance of this world, so I make good swords and evil swords. It's up to people to make appropriate use of them. I require a Scroll of Enchantment, a Nightsword, a Ring of Darkness and, of course, my usual fee of 10,000 gold pieces. When you have all this, ask me to "make" "gloomblade".
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.6: Aah, a good choice... Building such an armor requires a Scroll of Enchantment, a Chainmail, and 5,500 gold pieces for my service. When you've got all these, come back and ask me to "make" "blessed" "chainmail".
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.7: Lance Silversmith gives you a demonblade.
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.8: The Demonblade is decidedly an evil weapon, but in order to do the greatest evil, it will serve both good or evil masters. I, however, only give it to evil individuals. I ask that you bring me a Scroll of Enchantment, a Chaos Sword, a Demon Skull, a Necklace of the Black Heart, and 8,000 gold pieces. Once you have gathered all this, ask me to "make" "demonblade".
npc.topic.lancesilversmith.9: I have already made the three hammers of finality that you needed.
npc.topic.lantalir.0: Lantalir Rainmist is the name. I have the peculiar ability, for one so young as I am, to summon the rain with a single thought.
npc.topic.lantalir.1: I was an orphan, but Yrian raised me into the man I am now. He then recruited me into the "Order" "of" "Nature". Even though I am still an apprentice, I have grown in powers quite rapidly.My current work is to protect the forest from the "goblin"'s vicious attacks and various other "errands".
npc.topic.lantalir.10: Decades ago, the city was abandoned for reasons unknown and the main mountain entrance was sealed. The only way to reach it is to go through the "labyrinth".
npc.topic.lantalir.11: Lighthaven is a town located on the south eastern part of this island. Its sister town is named "Windhowl" and is located on the south western part.
npc.topic.lantalir.12: The inhabitants of Windhowl do not share our concerns for nature, they are much too busy doing business with Lighthaven and fighting brigands.
npc.topic.lantalir.13: The goblins are controlled by "Jarko" the necromancer and they are not bright enough to understand that if they do not stop the desecration of the forest at once, we will all perish. The "Forest" "Guardians" are doing a good job of eliminating them on sight, however.
npc.topic.lantalir.14: The Forest Guardians are trees that are able to walk. Do not attack them, they are our friends and they are very powerful.
npc.topic.lantalir.15: I am still an apprentice, but once I am a true disciple, I shall rightly earn the title of Druid.
npc.topic.lantalir.16: He is our leader and I consider him as my father. He is also the bearer of the "Stone" "of" "Life".
npc.topic.lantalir.17: The Stone of Life can drastically increase the strength of our elemental magic. "Yrian" "Earthsong" once allowed me to use its power to summon a rainstorm, but he made me stop it promptly, for it is not a good thing to tamper with the weather.
npc.topic.lantalir.18: Dunikus? Did you know that he can control winds? Really, I've seen him hovering a few feets above the ground. The air swirled about him like a small tornado.
npc.topic.lantalir.19: Jarko? Sorry, but I do not really want to talk about him.
npc.topic.lantalir.2: To meditate is to heal the soul. The art of meditation is a discipline that takes time to master. If you wish, I could "teach" you how to use it.
npc.topic.lantalir.20: The Order of Nature was created to preserve nature. We rarely rely on violence, for we do not wish harm to nobody. Sadly, it seems the only viable solution against foul creatures such as "goblins". The leader and founder of our order is "Yrian" "Earthsong".
npc.topic.lantalir.21: The key is to protect nature, remember that my friend.
npc.topic.lantalir.3: Very good, let us begin then.
npc.topic.lantalir.4: Very good, then let us begin your training.
npc.topic.lantalir.6: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady, but somewhat odd, even though I've never seen her myself.
npc.topic.lantalir.7: The book of Feylor? I am studying it right now, even though a few pages are missing or have crumbled to dust. It is very peculiar, it seems as if each time I read those pages, they disappear in front of my eyes. I can not explain this and yet... Oh well! *sigh*
npc.topic.lantalir.8: "Yrian" "Earthsong" always gives me many tasks to complete.
npc.topic.lantalir.9: I do not even know where the entrance is located exactly. However, I do know that it is required to go through it if one wants to reach the "Ruined" "City".
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.0: I am Laonian Rikarr. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.2: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many like you who walk the land and bear his mark. I tell you, friend, you have to seek Annabelle, blessed be her eyes! She'll know what to do.
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.3: I wonder where she lives nowadays.
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.4: Artherk is the god I worship, and the path he has set forth for me is undoubtedly a great one. I hope your destiny will be as good as mine, stranger. If you are in need of healing, you should ask Jurnis.
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.5: I am rather busy at the moment, but I am sure Jurnis would have time for you.
npc.topic.laonianrikarr.6: Come back when you are in need of help.
npc.topic.laren.0: My friends call me Laren. You look friendly enough so you can call me Laren too.
npc.topic.laren.2: I work in the "fields", but right now I'm taking it easy, if you know what I mean.
npc.topic.laren.3: It's damn tiring work I tell you, enough so that I'm really glad to come have a "drink" here at the end of the day.
npc.topic.laren.4: I don't know much about him, but I once overheard a conversation about him in a local inn. Seems like there was a romance between him and Adriana, but it turned bad. She doesn't talk about him, but maybe her assistant would know something. Why don't you try asking him?
npc.topic.laren.5: Heh, you here to have a drink too? That's good I suppose, I can use the company.
npc.topic.laren.6: You're not asking the right person for that kind of information, friend. I just sit here and drink.
npc.topic.laren.7: Maybe I'll see you later then.
npc.topic.leana.0: I am Leana, proud wife of the acclaimed "Drardos".
npc.topic.leana.2: I'm not really that proud to tell you the truth, but my husband only wants me to talk this way when we see potential customers.
npc.topic.leana.3: My husband is very proud of his business, a little too proud perhaps. We are not quite ready to open up shop yet, but once we are, you will be able to buy most of the antiques on display here.
npc.topic.leana.4: As soon as we are finished setting up the shop, we can start selling antiques.
npc.topic.leana.5: My husband believes he will have the best antiques store in the land. That should not be too difficult since there aren't any others around.
npc.topic.leana.6: I have been much too occupied to notice anyone out of the ordinary.
npc.topic.librarian1.0: The elves were the race Artherk cherished the most. He loved them like a father loves his children. The god of Corruption knew that to get to the god of Light, he would have to reach through the elves. He also knew that Artherk had fallen for an elven maiden and used this knowledge to design a ritual in which he could temporarily trap Artherk's essence inside a "physical" "body".
npc.topic.librarian1.1: The god of Corruption knew that even in a physical form, Artherk would prove stronger than any other mortal foe, but he would be no match against another god. He instilled the gift of sight on Oberon and forced him to foresee the coming of the Harbinger. Oberon, fearful for the fate of his people, made a deal with the god of Chaos, "Ogrimar", as instructed by Gluriurl.
npc.topic.librarian1.2: The gods of Chaos and Corruption conspired to rid the celestial realm of Artherk's presence. After receiving the gifts promised him by Ogrimar, Oberon, possessed by Gluriurl, attacked the god of Light in his physical form at the peak of the ritual. A great battle ensued during which Artherk was nearly defeated. Just as Gluriurl was about to strike the finishing blow, "Lothar" "the" "Just" appeared in the form of a great dragon of crimson scales and he slew Gluriurl, who had been weakened by the fight.
npc.topic.librarian1.3: The god of Justice sacrificed himself by imprisoning the essence of Gluriurl inside his own heart, releasing Oberon form its hold in the process. When the Harbinger came to punish the elves, Ogrimar "abandonned" them to their fate.
npc.topic.librarian1.4: Oberon was marked as a traitor to his race and the one responsible for the downfall of his people. He received the curse of unlife and became Makrsh P'Tangh, which means the Traitorous One in the ancient elven tongue. The elves were taken by Death save for a few of the wisest, who were imprisoned by the Harbinger into what is called the "Elvenweave", a beautiful and intricate tapestry created by Artherk himself.
npc.topic.librarian1.5: The tapestry depicts the majestic elven city that was buried by the human town of Lighthaven. Many believe that the ruins of Anwynn, the elven city, still lay beneath the human town. Some legends even say that deep inside one of its temples lies the "heart" of Lothar the Just.
npc.topic.librarian1.6: That's right. It is also said that should the heart be found and desecrated, Gluriurl could be brought back to life again.
npc.topic.librarian1.8: I gather information on the Celestial War and any other subject that is closely related to it.
npc.topic.librarian2.0: Despite the warnings, the elves continued to ignore the gods. When Death returned one thousand years later, the elves refused to repent and were nearly all destroyed. The Harbinger then went to see the dwarves and announced that they were now the chosen race. He also informed them of their new responsibilities and duties towards the gods, and the "consequences" of his next visit, should they fail in the task set before them.
npc.topic.librarian2.1: One thousand years later, the Harbinger returned to see the dwarves in what was now his third coming to the world of mortals. Very much impressed with the society the dwarves had evolved into, the Harbinger came to see them in his true form. The dwarves, confused by such a horrible apparition, attacked him thinking he was a demon from the deepest pits of hell. Death did not take this affront lightly and transformed the entire dwarven race into mindless atrocities, condemned to eternally roam the land as hideous creatures, shunned by all. He then left the dwawrves to their misery and sought out the "humans".
npc.topic.librarian2.2: The Harbinger told our ancestors that they were the chosen race. He told them about the proud elves and the bold dwarves and warned them about his next coming. Their task was to preserve the balance between good and evil, and remain steadfast in faith.
npc.topic.librarian2.4: I am doing research on the Harbinger and the influence he has had on our society.
npc.topic.librarian3.0: A Darkseed is a darkstone in its early stage of development planted on this plane of existence by the gods in order to give them a mortal body. The only Darkseed that is not known to have evolved into a darkstone is that of Ogrimar. If the ancient texts are to be believed, then one could quite possibly find Ogrimar somewhere on Althea.
npc.topic.librarian3.1: Even though Gluriurl didn't have time to absorb Artherk's essence, in the end the god of Light was still slain. It is now known that his essence has survived and returned to his own plane and answers our everyday prayers, but his heart remains in this land.
npc.topic.librarian3.2: As the darkest of all hearts, the heart of Gluriurl is the only one known to have retained some magical energies. This phenomenon gives uncertain proof that Gluriurl is not truly dead, but rather in some kind of slumber, awaiting to be brought back to life.
npc.topic.librarian3.3: Very little is known about the heart of Lothar. Legends say that it contains the bound essence of the dead god of "Corruption" but no one knows for certain.
npc.topic.librarian3.4: Yes, and it is also believed that should the heart be broken, Gluriurl would return to this land and exact revenge on all life.
npc.topic.librarian3.6: My main field of research is artifacts and relics of the past.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.0: You can call me the Lighthaven Samaritan.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.1: I just stay here all day and answer "questions" about this place. That's what I do.Perhaps I might send you on an "errand" if that is what you wish.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.10: The "page" command allows you to privately send a message to someone who is not nearby or with whom you want to have a private conversation in public, sort of like whispering. You simply type /<name> <text>, where <name> is the name of the person you want to talk to and <text> is the message you want this person to receive. If you do not want to receive pages, you can press <ESC> and toggle your page option to off.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.11: The "shout" command allows you to send public messages for everyone to read. You simply type :<text>, where <text> is the message you want to send to everyone. If you do not want to be disturbed by shouts, you can press <ESC> and toggle your shout option to off.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.12: If you're all right with the "basics" I've already explained, how about we now discuss some more serious topics, such as "spells", "skills", and "quests"? Or would you rather hear more about the "environment", the "world" and the "cities"?
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.13: The main thing you have to remember is that night and day follow each other in succession. When it's night, it's usually darker outside than during daytime. Sometimes, you need a "torch" to see around. That's especially true when you go inside "caves" and "dungeons".
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.14: You can buy those at any merchant's store. They're pretty inexpensive, they don't weigh much, and you can bet you'll find them useful when you go into "caves" and "dungeons". You can sometimes find them in treasure chests.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.15: Caves and dungeons are dark, dangerous places. Dungeons, because they were man-built, occasionally have torches on the walls, so they tend to be lighter than caves. Caves, which exist because of some fluke of nature, are much darker. It would be foolish to enter them without a light source.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.16: This is the world of Althea, but I'm sure you already know that. You are in the Kingdom of Goldmoon, on the island of Arakas, one of the two islands of the kingdom. This is the city of "Lighthaven"; the other city southwest of here is "Windhowl".
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.17: This is the town of Lighthaven. We live fairly quiet lives, but there has been a great deal of trouble lately, what with the goblins and undeads and orcs and demons and brigands and all these adventurers roaming about. Just ask other people here about these... You'll see. Anyway, if you want my advice, don't leave town unless you're trained and armed to the teeth, or you have someone to protect you.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.18: Windhowl is a larger town lying southwest from here. It takes a bit to get there, but the people are friendly enough. Lord Sunrock rules the town with an iron fist. If you go there, make sure to visit the Windhowl "Samaritan" and ask him a few questions.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.19: There's one like me in almost every city. Our job is to make life easier for you. Of course, if you want more information, you could always read the manual...
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.2: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady, but somewhat odd even though I've never seen her myself.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.20: Cities are fairly safe. On the island of Arakas--where we are right now--you have only two cities: "Lighthaven" and "Windhowl". There are many more cities in the world beyond, but we don't have much to do with them.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.21: Magic is present in the world of Althea. Its nature is complex and I won't get into it, but suffice it to say that it is manipulated with "mana", the equivalent of an individual's magical strength and endurance. Spells can only be "learned" from certain "teachers", but only if the student is gifted enough and has already learned the "pre-requisites".
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.22: Skills represent learned abilities which allow you to accomplish certain feats during the course of your adventures. They must be learned from a "teacher". Often, teachers will not train a student who does not have certain natural abilities ("stats") or has not reached a certain "level" of expertise.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.23: During the course of your adventures, several inhabitants of the world will ask you for assistance in return for certain rewards, whether it be gold, items or information. We refer to this as quests. Make sure you jot down a few notes when you embark on a quest, lest you never finish it and miss some important clue. Quests can either be "minor" or "major", depending on whether they have something to do with the over-arcing storyline or not.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.24: The 4th Coming is a complex tale, one which you will discover as you go along. Some of the missions you will undertake may have to do with the grand scheme behind the scenes; we call those major quests. Some other quests are just side tracks which you don't have to follow; we call those minor quests. They are not always necessary to further the plot, so you can ignore them if you prefer.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.25: Everyone has mana, but not everyone has enough of it or knows how to use it to weave magic. Those who do must spend a great deal of mana. Usually, the more mana is spent, the more powerful the spell. Mana is spent with every spell, but rest and potions can help regenerate it, just like physical damage ("hit" "points").
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.26: You don't know everything you need to know when you start adventuring. You'll quickly realize there are "skills" and "spells" that you need to learn, and you can only get that training from specific teachers living all over this island--and beyond.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.27: Sometimes, in order to "learn" something, some tutors will expect you to have already learned something more basic, what we call a pre-requisite. They won't always tell you what it is, though, so you may need to ask around and find someone who can tell you what you're missing. "Teachers" are like that, I guess. Help yourself and they'll help you.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.28: Yeah, you need those if you're to learn anything. Sure, you may think that because you can wield a sword you could train someone in using it too, but it's not that simple. You need to know what you're doing, so you need someone who's willing to "train" you. Most teachers will ask you for some money, however, so don't visit a potential tutor empty handed.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.29: We rate everyone according to a restricted number of values, named stats, which represent that person's strengths and weaknesses. Most starting stats range roughly between 10 and 20, but these values tend to go up with levels. You can see your stats by pressing <ctrl-s>.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.3: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many who walk the land and bear his mark.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.30: As you gain experience, your skills and stats go up. Your level will also go up. A level indicates how far along you've come and how generally powerful your character is.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.31: There are dozens of weapons in the game, some more powerful than others. The price is usually a good indication of their combat effectiveness, but not always, so don't rely on that. Try them out and you'll soon figure out which one allows you to do more damage in combat. Say, perhaps you'd like me to tell you a bit about "combat"?
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.32: Kind of like weapons, there are a good number of armors available; some are good, some are bad, and some are both good and bad for you. Check your stats carefully and you should quickly find out which ones protect you better. Say, perhaps you'd like me to tell you a bit about "combat"?
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.33: It's all pretty simple, really. You use a "weapon" to attack and wear "armor" to defend yourself. If the attacker's power is higher than your defenses (also called AC, for armor class), you may end up taking damage ("hit" "points", or HPs). If you lose all your HPs, you die. This isn't the tragic end, however, since you own a Gem of Destiny. That will take you back to the temple, where you can get healed and resume your journeys.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.34: Hit points measure how tough you are and how much punishment you can take before dying. The higher your level, the more hit points you tend to have. Endurance also plays a factor in the number of hit points you have. Hit points recover over time, but you can also use "healing" methods.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.35: Other than time, two things can heal you: spells and potions. Potions can be bought in shops or found in chests. Spells can be learned from a "teacher". You can also ask some priests to heal you. Some do it for free, some do it for money.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.36: You start with some items in your backpack (press ctrl-i to have your backpack pop up). Use them wisely. Replacing them may cost you money, so don't throw them away unless your backpack is full and you absolutely need the space. Most items are useful, but not all of them, so don't expect every mug of beer to be of great value.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.37: So.. you wish to do an errand for me? Very well then... let's see... Go into the temple's basement and slay at least 15 rats. Then, come back to me and I shall give you a reward.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.38: That's hardly appropriate language! This will not win you friends here.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.39: Thank you for spending some time with an old man. Come again.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.4: Not every NPC uses keywords, but most folks have something specific to say about certain topics. Make note of them and bring it up in the conversation. They might have more to say than it first appears.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.5: There you go. You're a quick study.
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.6: I can tell you about several things, but I need to know whether you want "basic" information or "advanced" information. So which one is it?
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.7: It's not always easy to start adventuring, I know. I was once a young person, just like you, and I wish I had had someone to show me the ropes back then. Anyway, back to business... When talking to people, you can always ask them their "name" and about their "work". Most will gladly tell you more. Try it, you'll see. Then ask me again to tell you about "functions".
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.8: There are some magic buttons that can help you memorize some of the basic functions. F1 gives you a summary of online help. F2 makes you drink a healing potion so you don't have to rummage through your backpack in the middle of combat. The rest are documented in your reference tome. Would you like me to tell you more about "weapons", "armors" and various "items"? Or would you like me to talk about "communication" and "advanced" features?
npc.topic.lighthavensamaritan.9: Ah, someone who likes to talk... That's great, because you'll find plenty of people to talk to in this world. There are communication tools such as "paging" and "shouting" that can help you contact other individuals elsewhere who can answer some of your questions.
npc.topic.liurnclar.0: I go by the name of Liurn Clar. Perhaps you have heard of me?
npc.topic.liurnclar.1: I am a Warwizard. Usually, I "teach" "spells", but lately I have been rather preoccupied with completing my great "portal".
npc.topic.liurnclar.10: I wonder where she lives nowadays.
npc.topic.liurnclar.11: Ah, well, yes, you didn't really expect me to do this just for free, right? Now, let's get down to business. You must first sign a few discharges and non-disclosure "forms". Then, there's the issue of "payment".
npc.topic.liurnclar.12: Well, seeing as you've already been to Raven's Dust, I can't very well pretend that I can't send you... I charge %u gold pieces for that trip, however. Will you pay the sum?
npc.topic.liurnclar.13: Theorn is known as the old hermit, a good friend of mine.
npc.topic.liurnclar.14: Learned a new word today, haven't you? How do you like feeling those mental gears at work? Ooh, I can almost hear the cogs turning in your head, here. Funny, that.
npc.topic.liurnclar.15: Well, certainly, I could send you there, but there are certain "conditions" that must be met, certain "quid" "pro" "quos" to discuss...
npc.topic.liurnclar.16: You have already gone through all the formalities. I am ready to "send" you on your way.
npc.topic.liurnclar.17: You have already signed all the require forms and have paid your payment. We are ready to "send" you on your way to "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.liurnclar.18: If you want me to "teleport" you somewhere, just say so.
npc.topic.liurnclar.19: The portal is perhaps the most ambitious project anyone has ever undertaken. It is designed to reduce the time it takes to travel between two towns. I have encountered several problems, though, and I can't seem to figure out what's going wrong. Because of this, I'm afraid I will not have enough time to teach you any spells. At least, I have almost mastered the art of translocating a living target to another place. Perhaps even as far as "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.liurnclar.20: The art of magic must be learned carefully. It takes a lot of intelligence, patience and most of all, money to pay for your teachers!
npc.topic.liurnclar.22: Here are the spells I can teach you.
npc.topic.liurnclar.3: The chaos portal is another project of mine. I am trying to build a portal that will bring me into a parallel world. No one has ever been there but I swear I'll succeed eventually. Alas, for each of my failed attempts, a "chaos" "key" is consumed and that is the reason why I need every key I can get. I won't let failure discourage me.
npc.topic.liurnclar.4: You can find a chaos key on a creature called "Chaos" "Spawn".
npc.topic.liurnclar.5: They are located somewhere on "Stoneheim". I am not sure exactly where they are located but you should begin your search near the fortress in the middle of the island.
npc.topic.liurnclar.6: I can "send" you to Raven's Dust but unfortunately, I have not completed the Stoneheim portal.
npc.topic.liurnclar.7: Do not ask of me such services if you are not a Lightbringer.
npc.topic.liurnclar.8: There is a scholar I'v encountered once who was specialized in arcane scribing and probably has a magic scripting kit or two lying around. I hope this helps you. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'll go back to my portals.
npc.topic.liurnclar.9: I'm afraid I cannot help you as I'm all out of blank magical tomes.
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.0: I am... the LORD OF THE SHOPS!
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.1: I sell "unique" "items" you can't find anywhere else in the world.
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.10: We have Mithril Shields, Gothic Shields and Adamantite Shields. If you wish to buy any of these items, just say "buy" "shields".
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.11: We have Adamantite Platemail Armors, Adamantite Plate Protectors, Adamantite Platemail Gauntlets, Adamantite Platemail Helmets, Adamantite Platemail Leggings and Adamantite Platemail Boots. If you wish to buy any of these items, just say "buy" "armors".
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.12: I have a "wide" "selection" of very special items. Other vendors won't even buy them from you. Once you have them, they remain yours.
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.13: Unfortunately for you, there is nothing I need that you have.
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.14: Suit yourself! I have to be elsewhere anyway.
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.2: I have a "wide" "selection" of very special items. Other vendors won't even buy them from you. Once you have them, they remain yours.
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.3: You can choose between "bows", "melee" "weapons", "shields" and "armors". Once you've decided to buy from a selection, just say "buy" and your selection. For instance, if you want to buy melee weapons, just say "buy" "melee" "weapons".
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.4: We have just the bow for you!
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.5: We have just the weapon for you!
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.6: We have just the shield for you!
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.7: We have just the armor for you!
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.8: We have Cedar Longbows, Cedar Reflex Bows, Cedar Recurve Bows, Cedar Compound Bows, Cedar Composite Bows, Lancewood Reflex Bows, Lancewood Recurve Bows, Lancewood Compound Bows, Lancewood Composite Bows, Black Locust Recurve Bows, Black Locust Compound Bows, and Black Locust Composite Bows. If you wish to buy any of these items, just say "buy" "bow".
npc.topic.lordoftheshops.9: We have Mithril Morning Stars, Ancient Morning Stars, High Metal Broad Axes, Mithril Battle Axes, Mithril Broad Axes, Ancient Broad Axes, Mithril Long Swords, Mithril Broadswords, Mithril Scimitars, Mithril Bastard Swords, Mithril Two-Handed Swords, Adamantite Broadswords, Adamantite Scimitars, Adamantite Bastard Swords, Adamantite Two-Handed Swords, Ancient Scimitars, Ancient Bastard Swords, Ancient Two-Handed Swords, Adamantite Blades, and Ancient Blades. If you wish to buy any of these items, just say "buy" "melee" "weapons".
npc.topic.lordsunrock.0: Whether or not you are guilty of treason, you will have to get my "merchandise" back at once!
npc.topic.lordsunrock.10: If you're strong enough to survive hours in the cave north of Windhowl, then you would be able to take a look at what is happening at the mountain.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.11: I tend to lose my diamonds around, I guess I'm plain careless, these days. If you happen to find one, please return it to me at once! Hmmm... By the way, did you find one of my diamonds, by any chance?
npc.topic.lordsunrock.12: Lighthaven is our sister town on the eastern part of this island.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.13: The armorer of "Lighthaven" is supposed to send me a "report" soon.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.14: Sigfried is a great weaponsmith who lives in "Lighthaven". I wonder if he has sent a messenger for his "report" yet...
npc.topic.lordsunrock.15: I have previously given you a reward for bringing me the report I needed. I therefore do not think you need any more gold pieces. I see in your eyes the thirst for adventures, which is probably why you accepted to do this errand once more. I thank you very much.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.16: I'll return to my work now.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.17: Hm? What, a letter from Asarr? He wishes to surrender, perhaps? Let me see this. Mm. M-hm. Uh huh... Eh? What?!? Who does he *think* he is! That devil shall pay for these words! What insolence!You! Come here! Tell that ruffian he's not going to call me a blue-nosed babboon without suffering the consequences. Tell him he will feel the heat of my "wrath" and pay for his insufferable disrespect!
npc.topic.lordsunrock.18: Tell him. Tell him my anger will pursue him 'till the end of time!
npc.topic.lordsunrock.2: Windhowl is more like a city than a town. It has grown much in size lately.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.3: I am Lord Sunrock. I rule over the city of Windhowl.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.4: I try to maintain order in the town. I have to make sure the "guards" are doing their job well, and see the economy does not fall apart. That is what is giving me the most trouble. There aren't any "merchants" coming from Lighthaven except those under the protection of young adventurers like yourself. "Jarko" the necromancer causes me many headaches, for his goblins are everywhere in the forest.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.5: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.lordsunrock.7: They're doing their work well enough, but there aren't enough of them to make a strike at "Righul's" "Mountain".
npc.topic.lordsunrock.8: Tell you what, you bring me Jarko's "spellbook" as a proof that you defeated him and I'll reward you. Sounds nice, eh?!
npc.topic.lordsunrock.9: I thank you for bringing back Jarko's spellbook as a proof of your courageous act. I shall burn this atrocity at once, for it is probably cursed. For your good deed, I give you this small amount of gold and this magnificient golden ring!
npc.topic.lordtravis.0: I am Travis, Lieutenant of the guard and renowned knight of Windhowl!
npc.topic.lordtravis.1: I am lieutenant of Windhowl's guard. I have the task, no, the obligation of keeping the town peaceful for all of its citizens. And might I say that it has become an "overwhelming" task lately.
npc.topic.lordtravis.2: I do not know much about that woman.
npc.topic.lordtravis.4: Goblins must get reinforcements from somewhere or help from some outsider, because they are better equipped than ever and come in ever-increasing numbers. Luckily, they are still no match for the skill of our guards.
npc.topic.lothan.0: My name is Lothan, pleased to meet you.
npc.topic.lothan.1: I am a mage who studies the element of "water". I have been assigned the task of watching over "Araknor". I have yet another concern, however. The orc shaman named "Araf" "Kul" is dangerously growing in power. I highly doubt he will ever be a match for my magic. However, I wonder what special component he uses for his spell casting.
npc.topic.lothan.10: Our sister town on this isle, Windhowl is located on the western part of the island. Because of its proximity to the goblin hideout, it is always assaulted by the "goblin" army. Fortunately, the guardsmen have done a good job repelling them. Let's hope they will hold on until reinforcements arrive.
npc.topic.lothan.11: The tower's library is a place where knowledge from all over the world is stored. You can find information on just about any subject in there.
npc.topic.lothan.12: Brigands are attacking all the "merchants" crossing the forest to the west. If you wish to help, go see Lord Kirlor's office.
npc.topic.lothan.13: The tower of magic contains a great "library", where thousands of books containing all sorts of information can be found.
npc.topic.lothan.14: Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping the islands of Raven's Dust and Arakas, which is the one you are currently on. As for Raven's Dust, it is the island southwest of here, where the castle of King "Theodore" XIII is located.
npc.topic.lothan.15: Raven's Dust is a small island located southwest of this island.
npc.topic.lothan.16: I must say, he is the worst king the kingdom has ever had! He always sleeps and never gets anything done, even now as the "goblin" hordes are gaining ground. These are indeed dark times we live in...
npc.topic.lothan.17: I don't know precisely what is happening with them, only that we are slowly losing the battle. Some say they even witnessed certain goblins carrying magical weapons! I fail to see how that is possible, goblins being rather stupid and wanting nothing to do with magic.
npc.topic.lothan.18: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to Lord Sunrock in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.lothan.19: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.lothan.2: I don't know where she is. Sorry I couldn't help you.
npc.topic.lothan.23: Windhowl is a town located to the southwestern part of the island.
npc.topic.lothan.24: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.lothan.25: I have studied long and hard to master the use of these "spells"... Perhaps one day, when you are strong enough, I will "teach" you some of them.
npc.topic.lothan.26: Let's see if you are ready for what I can teach you.
npc.topic.lothan.3: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many like you who walk the land and bear his mark. I tell you, friend, you have to seek Annabelle, blessed be her eyes! She'll know what to do.
npc.topic.lothan.4: You took this pouch of yellow powder from the corpse of Araf'Kul? I will exchange it for...
npc.topic.lothan.6: Human bone? I could simply ask "Araknor" for one, he has a collection of them, you know.
npc.topic.lothan.7: The leaf of a pink tree? What would I do with that? Pfah! I'll tell you...NOTHING! Well, perhaps a druid could find a use for it of course.
npc.topic.lothan.8: He is a shaman orc and surprisingly skilled in the art of magic for one of his race.
npc.topic.lothan.9: He is someone who just can't be trusted. He is a follower of the ways of necromancy, and therefore is a very dark and disturbed individual. He is currently a resident of the "tower" and benefits from the massive "library" stored here. This is the only reason why he would accept to pay the ridiculous sums of money we charge him to stay here. If it was up to me, I would kick him out of the "kingdom" myself, but our town is in dire need of resources due to the "brigands" roaming around town.
npc.topic.lyria.0: They call me Lyria. You don't look as suspicious as they say.
npc.topic.lyria.1: Oh, I am just doing things. Not very "interesting". But you seem to be a great "adventurer".
npc.topic.lyria.3: I am a master at picking locks. I could "teach" it to you, if it will help you in your journey.
npc.topic.lyria.6: I heard that she has Elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.lyria.8: If you are a good robber, you should ask "Asarr" for a job. But you have to be very good, because if you get caught, he will not do a thing for you.
npc.topic.lyria.9: Asarr is our leader and a greater master thief too.
npc.topic.malaar.0: I am Malaar, a bishop of Artherk's "church".
npc.topic.malaar.1: I am a bishop of "Artherk". It is my life's work to follow the path of light.
npc.topic.malaar.10: You still don't know what Arakas is?
npc.topic.malaar.2: Ach! So that fiend Balork has cursed you too? I know a traveller to whom it happened, a long time ago... When I saw him again, he said something about a certain "Annabelle" curing him.
npc.topic.malaar.3: Young, lovely Annabelle, how we miss her! She could heal the sick and comfort the downtrodden. She would hear your plight and help you, no doubt. If she were still alive, that is.
npc.topic.malaar.4: We would gladly accept a donation from you, if you would be so kind as to make one. Would you perhaps have 10,000 gold pieces to offer to Artherk?
npc.topic.malaar.5: Artherk is the god of mending and help. He is the only god worshiped in the kingdom of "Goldmoon", I believe. Most of his many followers have the unending task of helping people and praying for those lost in darkness.
npc.topic.malaar.6: Ahhh, what a great kingdom it is. Our fair King "Theodore" rules wisely and the people are kind of heart. None follow any god other than the great "Artherk", and rightfully so, since he is the only god worshipped by our church. There is also a long forgotten "temple" on Goldmoon, but I do not know if it was dedicated to "Artherk".
npc.topic.malaar.7: Ahhh! What a wonderful king! He sends us "donations" every month and, in return, we tell everyone how great a king he is.
npc.topic.malaar.8: There are many churches of Artherk throughout the land. Most of the other churches follow a dark path, however. Beware of those that hide their work from the eyes of the people.
npc.topic.malaar.9: That ancient temple? Oh, well, I do not know much about it. It lies in the forest in the center of Arakas. I think it is near the center but I don't have any time to spend on finding such a mysterious place.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.1: I am a manaweaver by profession. I can create powerful magical items if you have the gold.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.10: Dumb as a doorknob! He can fight pretty good, but his ridiculous equipment is what makes him good, not his skill. Some day, I'll show him who's the better warrior!
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.11: A rank amateur! He thinks his manasmithing is better than my manaweaving, but that's because I've never challenged his little creations with my own. I've made swords and armors that could slay him in one blow!
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.12: A delusional idiot! I want nothing to do with the likes of him. Religion is for those who do not have the strength to stand proud and tall on their own. I don't need a god to tell me I'm worth something, I already know that!
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.13: Brawns with no brains! He thinks he's all that, he thinks he's noble and selfless, but I know better. He and his ilk only want to be seen as great heroes and protectors, when all they do is walk around with a sword and pretend they're something else. It makes me sick!
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.14: Leave at once, you're wasting my time.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.2: I have no help to give, nor quest to suggest, but should you happen to have "Scrolls" "of" "Horse" "Friendship" on you, be sure to drop by and let me know.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.3: Those items should NEVER leave Centaur hands. I'm glad to see you have none on yourself, or I might be very, very displeased.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.4: That's a poisoned blade. It goes through armor like a hot knife through butter. I'm told mostly thieves use it.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.5: A great warrior's sword. I'm sure you could wage a great war wielding it.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.6: The Robe of Hell is useful to mages who wish to seek immunity against fire and darkness. Perhaps you should try it on and see how it looks on you.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.7: Aaah, it would be a shame if a human archer started using that bow against my people. I'm certain it would make our king look very bad, wouldn't you agree?
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.8: A weakling! He believes in his own sanctimonious, righteous act, but I am not fooled by it. He is guilty of something, and even though he hides it well, I'm confident Zion Thunderheart will eventually expose him.
npc.topic.malachaifatebringer.9: He should be the king! None of this weak-hearted compassion and nonsensical trading with humans. Let Zion rule and take us on the path to reclaim *our* Stoneheim!
npc.topic.markam.0: The name is Markam Korwald to you, stranger.
npc.topic.markam.1: My duties are numerous in this town. You might say that I am "Lord" "Kirlor"'s assistant.
npc.topic.markam.10: All you have to do is "register" at the Lord's office, and find a merchant.
npc.topic.markam.11: The western town on the island, Windhowl is the biggest town in the kingdom of "Goldmoon". But be careful if you go there because "brigands" and strange creatures have been ambushing careless wanderers lately.
npc.topic.markam.12: Brigands have been banding together in large groups to attack our "merchant" carriers. If one could "help" them by bringing a simple report to Lord Sunrock in "Windhowl", it would allow both towns to send guarded merchant caravans at a secret planned time and do business without fearing the interference of the brigands. If you are an adventurer, then by all means, talk to Lord Kirlor in his office and "register" yourself!
npc.topic.markam.13: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to "Lord" "Sunrock" in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.markam.14: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.markam.18: Windhowl is a town located to the western part of the island.
npc.topic.markam.19: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.markam.2: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady, but somewhat odd, even though I've never met her.
npc.topic.markam.4: Lord Kirlor has been looking for adventurers lately to help in the protection of the local "merchants".
npc.topic.markam.5: It is the kingdom regrouping all the villages on the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.markam.6: That is the island you can see just southwest of here.
npc.topic.markam.7: Arakas is the island you are currently standing on.
npc.topic.markam.8: The merchants are constantly being robbed by "brigands" while trying to cross the forest to "Windhowl". They are having a hard time. Their shops are losing money and all.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.0: I am Marnec Sunim, the greatest "farmer" around!
npc.topic.marnecsunim.1: My ancestors have been farmers for generations now. I have "secrets" which help me grow food that has made me famous. I am not very rich yet, but I'm sure it's just a matter of time.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.12: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.13: It is the largest town on this island, and is located west of the forest.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.14: Our army is so small that it can't even take out the "brigands"' hideout. Fortunatly, "Murmuntag" sometimes goes in the forest and cleans up the road for a day or two.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.15: He's quite a big fellow, I tell you. Not very intelligent, but strong as an ox, maybe even stronger.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.16: I'll return to work now, goodbye.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.2: I'm sorry, but my farmer's secrets are only passed down from father to son.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.3: I am the town's greatest farmer! And I tell you, it isn't going as well as it used to. Those damned "brigands" are really starting to annoy me. It's a shame our town's "army" is too small to give them a good beating. One of these days I tell ya, I'm going to pay them a small visit. It's just that I'm too busy to do it now with my farm and all, you know...
npc.topic.marnecsunim.6: They are attacking everyone who tries to cross the forest. Trading with "Windhowl" has been nearly impossible lately because of them. Perhaps you could help the "merchants" doing some business with Windhowl if you are a true adventurer.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.7: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to Lord Sunrock in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.marnecsunim.8: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.marsaccred.0: I am Marsac Cred. Pleased to make your acquaintance.
npc.topic.marsaccred.1: I am an "elemental" mage, and I help "R'yleth" here in this tower of magic.
npc.topic.marsaccred.10: You can't make that on your own, you have to check with someone who's specialized in making such kits. I know of a certain Iraltok who could perhaps help you with that.
npc.topic.marsaccred.11: Elemental magic is the base of all things pure. A mage can gather the mana that flows around him and channel it into one of four elements and release the energies in the form of a spell. I control the forces of "water".
npc.topic.marsaccred.12: Althought most of the time, water is peaceful in nature, it can sometimes be devastating. I can show you how to harness the forces of water and "teach" you how to cast water spells, so that you may use these forces to your advantage.
npc.topic.marsaccred.13: I will teach you what I can.
npc.topic.marsaccred.14: The guildmaster's work consists of controlling the research of new spells and the teaching of magic to apprentices. The guildmaster is also often asked to help the city in various matters, mostly political.
npc.topic.marsaccred.3: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.marsaccred.4: So, Uranos needs a special component, eh? Well, he can thank his lucky star that I know exactly what he's looking for. You will have to find some decaying bat "wings" and bring them to him before they crumble to dust. He'll probably need more than one though, so get as many as you can.
npc.topic.marsaccred.5: They're just ordinary bat wings... Well, that's not entirely true. Actually, the kind of wing he is looking for only comes from the undead bats that roam in the dungeon under Lighthaven.
npc.topic.marsaccred.6: R'yleth is the current mage "Guildmaster" here in Windhowl. His great power is only matched by his enormous ego. *snicker* But other than that, he truly is a master of magic. He has travelled much and has learned from the greatest magicians that live.
npc.topic.marsaccred.7: These are powerful scrolls indeed. They can help you make a magical item, or to improve an item that is already magical. Would you like me to make one for you?
npc.topic.marsaccred.8: This type of scroll is required to create "scroll" "of" "enchantment". You should definitely try to acquire a few. All true mages have them and trade them.
npc.topic.marsaccred.9: Orcs sometimes collect those, so you know where to look. Go figure. *shrug*
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.1: I am the mayor of Stonecrest. I see to the well-being of the citizens of this town. In this, I have to say that I am fortunate to have one such as "Grant" "Hornkeep" to uphold the law.
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.2: He is the town's sheriff. It is his duty to enforce the law and stop thieves and skraugs from wreaking havoc around here.
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.3: I used to be a dragonslayer in my young days. That's before I retired and took this job as Stonecrest's mayor. It's a cushy job compared to fighting dragons, but the politics can really get to you, sometimes. There are days when I miss the 'old life'...
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.4: If you have half a dozen or more of those, I will reward you handsomely.
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.5: If you have half a dozen or more of those, I will reward you handsomely.
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.6: I see you carry many Certificates of Recognition with you. Would you like to trade them in for a reward?
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.7: I'm told it's a very potent item. I don't really know what it does, though.
npc.topic.mayorfairweather.8: I will not tolerate such language from anyone.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.1: I am Meltar Winterstorm. You do not have to tell me who you are, I already know your name, %s.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.10: If you want to secure our friendship, there is no better way than by gathering gems and precious stones and bringing them back to me or my colleagues. You will be rewarded differently for each type of gem depending on value, of course.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.11: You want to know what your standing amongst the thieves is?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.12: It's about time. Our little chat was somewhat boring.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.14: So, you want to learn how to hide now?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.15: If you need training, I suggest you look elsewhere.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.2: Eh, you think I would tell you?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.3: I don't care about anything that happens on that island.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.4: You think you're so tough, eh? We'll just see about that!
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.5: I have already given you the Crown of Corruption. What more do you want from me?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.6: Yes that's right, I called you an insignificant. You probably think you're some sort of avatar or something of the like, but in reality you are nothing more than a mere puppet.
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.7: Bah, I have already given you the crown, what more would you have me do?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.8: Bah, I have already given you the crown, what more would you have me do?
npc.topic.meltarwinterstorm.9: There are several ways to increase your standing with the thieves. Since we yearn for treasure of all sorts, one way of improving your image would be to bring us valuable "gems" and "precious" "stones".
npc.topic.menark.10: You've found a skeleton bone and some mummy's bandages? Do you want to give them to me so that I can study the undead's mysterious nature?
npc.topic.menark.11: Why yes, I suppose you could call them books too.
npc.topic.menark.12: You already have all the answers, you do not need me to give you hints.
npc.topic.menark.13: I am the one true master of all riddles! If you need help with some, just ask me for "riddle" "hints" and I'll see what I can do. I must warn you, however, my help comes with a price. I haven't spent the last few decades learning riddles to just *give* away the answers!
npc.topic.menark.2: I am what you might call a chronicler. "Jeremiah" and I have been charged with the never-ending task of gathering knowledge from all over the world and keeping "records" of his "journeys" here.
npc.topic.menark.3: Who told you about the Chronicles of Doom? Shadeen... I see! I assume she sent you here to try to get it from me, right? Are you actually threatening me, boy?
npc.topic.menark.4: I have had many visitors lately, but the one that was just here struck me as being rather "odd".
npc.topic.menark.5: So, you need an Hourglass of Essence, eh?
npc.topic.menark.6: I'm affraid I must get back to my writing so I can't really help you with that. Why don't you just ask around? You might get more information with the other townsfolk.
npc.topic.menark.7: He's a charming fellow to tell you the truth, but don't tell him I said that!
npc.topic.menark.8: We keep records of all knowledge so that others might one day look through these pages and learn about the many different parts of the world.
npc.topic.menark.9: Jeremiah has very poor handwriting and so gets to do most of the travelling. Even though I am accustomed to living indoors, I still long to go outside. Still, I dare not travel where mummies and skeletons are living. I have heard that they feast upon the warm blood of humans. If you could bring me some mummy's bandages and a skeleton bone, perhaps I could "study" these beings.
npc.topic.metanas.0: Metanas is the name, not that it concerns you.
npc.topic.metanas.1: If you keep saying my name like that, you'll find that it's considerably harder to pronounce without any teeth in your mouth!
npc.topic.metanas.2: Well, what does it look like I'm doing? I'm keeping an eye on the "patrons", that's what I'm doing!
npc.topic.metanas.3: See those two by the table over there? They know what it feels like to have my boot stamped all across their faces. Just give me one good reason and I'll do the same to you!
npc.topic.metanas.4: Of course I've seen a strange visitor! This is a tavern you idiot!
npc.topic.metanas.5: Get out if you're done, otherwise stop bothering me and sit down!
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.0: Mhorgwloth not have shiny rock. Mhorgwloth gave rock.
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.11: Mhorgwloth not know her. Only know "pretty" "lady".
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.12: Huh huh huh... Awhlop! Pretty lady! Huh huh...
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.2: Whorc? Mhorwgloth don't know. Mhorgwloth dumb. Only thing Mhorgwloth do is "grow"!
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.3: GRRR! Evil king chop Mhorgwloth arm! But arm grow back! Mhorgwloth "special".
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.4: You want special too? Mhorgwloth "teach" you.
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.7: Mhorgwloth too strong for small humans. Mhorgwloth killed king.
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.8: Balork's Brand? Me not understand! Awhlop!
npc.topic.mhorgwloth.9: Isshhhh! Awhlop! Town.. human town. Me don't like human!
npc.topic.miraknira.0: I am Mirak Nira, nice of you to ask.  I am "working" now, so please be "brief", unless you seek "information" about the town, of course.
npc.topic.miraknira.1: I am an assistant for his lordship.  I guess you could say that I work for the "town".
npc.topic.miraknira.10: Lord Sunrock asks a lot from us, and we are always kept very busy. As a result, we don't have much time to talk with people. *sigh* How I wish that one day I will have enough money to go far away from here. The world is so vast, and to be confined inside a small place such as Windhowl is very frustrating.
npc.topic.miraknira.2: Annabelle? I heard she is a lovely lady but somewhat odd, even though I have never seen her myself.
npc.topic.miraknira.4: I do not want to hear about that dreaded necromancer.
npc.topic.miraknira.7: I will only trust one who helps Windhowl. If you kill a hundred goblins, then surely you are trustworthy. And even if you are not, you will have at least rid us of some of these annoying monsters. Either way, you will deserve a reward.
npc.topic.miraknira.8: Our town has many treasures, and my task is to keep track of all of them. Food supplies, water supplies and the town's finances must also all be accounted for.
npc.topic.miraknira.9: I am truly sorry, but all information concerning town supplies are confidential at the moment, as well as the financial state of the town.
npc.topic.miramlaky.0: My name is Miram Laky, son of "Rothar" Laky.
npc.topic.miramlaky.1: My father was a great man. I don't know what he did, but I'm sure he did something great, like fighting off dragons or something. I heard he was an adventurer, you know. Unfortunately, he's been gone for about fifteen years now and I haven't seen him since.
npc.topic.miramlaky.2: Isn't it obvious by looking around? I take care of the fields. I harvest many kinds of vegetables. We've only two farmers in this town to feed the whole population. It isn't much I tell ya! Sometimes we even need to get some food from "Lighthaven".
npc.topic.miramlaky.3: Oh, I don't know if she's dead or alive for sure, but she left us to find her true love years ago... Some say she lives with a troll, now. Me? I just think it's hogwash and she died.
npc.topic.miramlaky.4: Curse that Balork and his Brand! There are many like you who walk the land and bear his mark. I tell you, friend, you have to seek Annabelle, blessed be her eyes! She'll know what to do.
npc.topic.miramlaky.5: It's the village east of here, but then again, you look like you come from there anyway. I wonder how you got passed the brigands... They have been harrassing anyone that tries to cross over to this town, lately. This "island" is doomed to chaos if nothing more is done about the evil lurking around.
npc.topic.miramlaky.6: Don't you know anything? You're on the island of Arakas!
