npc.topic.miramlaky.7: I heard they're using magic swords now! I don't know about you, but I don't trust anything about that magic stuff. It always gave me the creeps.
npc.topic.miramlaky.8: I hope next year will be better.
npc.topic.mirandul.0: Mirandul, the fastest "thief" who ever lived.
npc.topic.mirandul.1: I make sure that nobody steals the treasures we get.
npc.topic.mirandul.2: I heard a rumor that she is much older than what she appears to be.
npc.topic.mirandul.4: Not long ago, I had flying boots. They were very useful, but I had to give them away to save my life. I think they were forever lost in the ocean.
npc.topic.mirandul.5: You will never be as fast as I was.
npc.topic.mirandul.6: I am not a thief anymore, but a brigand. I know I do not look very fast now, but you would be surprised of my feats four years ago.
npc.topic.mirymwenfeatherfoot.0: Yes, Mirymwen Featherfoot is the name.
npc.topic.mirymwenfeatherfoot.2: I am a thief and I'm particularly skilled with a dagger. I'm also quite adept at dodging, and I could probably "train" you in that field, seeing as it is very useful for a thief.
npc.topic.mirymwenfeatherfoot.4: Dantalir Songweaver is a bard. Though, I must say that his thieving skills are much better than his vocal cords.
npc.topic.mirymwenfeatherfoot.5: Rablek is the man with the gleaming sword who is standing over there.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.1: I am Mithanna Snowraven, white sorceress of Stonecrest.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.10: Why, yes, that is also how some centaurs call me.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.11: I see... Well, it *is* possible to make a Scroll of Appearance Restoration, but I'll need a few "ingredients":
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.12: I see... Well, it *is* possible to make a Scroll of Appearance Restoration, but I'll need a few "ingredients":
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.13: This is rather hard to find. This is the liquid that spiders use to weave their webs, but it tends to solidify when it's exposed to air, so it's very rare that you can get some off their dead bodies.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.14: I hear Resha Marsack has some in a locked chest at her home. Maybe that's the secret of her incredible good looks...
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.15: They're hard to find, and literally no one here does them. You might have more luck if you tried the Kingdom of Goldmoon.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.17: Fangs of True Resolve are made by Stonecrest's cleric, Nissus Haloseeker. Request his help and he will undoubtedly assist you.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.18: The jade ring of sorcery can enhance the strength of its wearer's spells.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.19: I am sure that a seasoned adventurer such as yourself will have no problem in finding tarantula eyes.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.2: Fear not, I am not a sorceress of evil. I study the art of spellcraft and can perhaps "help" you if you need assistance.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.20: That is not something you should be concerned about. It has to do with legendary beings of ages past.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.21: I can help you by "teaching" you a spell or two
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.22: These are the few spells that I can teach you. Use them wisely.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.23: The ice storm spell will freeze everything within the area of effect, inflicting great amounts of damage to all living creatures affected. You are required to have the glacier spell before you can learn it.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.24: The blizzard spell will freeze everything within the area of effect, inflicting tremendous amounts of damage to all living creatures affected. You are required to have the ice storm spell before you can learn it.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.25: You should leave right away before I do something we'd both regret.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.3: I see that you are now a Lightbringer, %s. Let's hope that you're ready for what lies ahead.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.4: You know of him? That's good. Yes, he's for real, he's very powerful and he's the next step toward your great destiny... to kill Makrsh P'Tangh.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.5: You already have this piece of the key. It would do you no good to have an additional one.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.6: I do not recall the name of the mage who is skilled in writing this tome. The only thing I can tell you is that he is usually busy working on one of his portals.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.7: The sword of majesty must absolutely be forged by a very skilled blacksmith. I think only a skillful centaur blacksmith can accomplish such a task, with the possible exception of "Lance" "Silversmith".
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.8: I think he lives somewhere on the island of Arakas.
npc.topic.mithannasnowraven.9: I think Omar Hald, the town's jeweller, might be up for this task.
npc.topic.mithrand.0: My name is Mithrand. I "work" for the town's "Lord".
npc.topic.mithrand.1: I work for Kirlor, the "Lord" of Lighthaven.
npc.topic.mithrand.10: I am not a foolish banker.
npc.topic.mithrand.11: You must tell me how many gold pieces you wish to deposit. For instance, if you would like to deposit 10 gold pieces, you would simply tell me {DEPOSIT} {10} {GOLD}. Of course, you may also view your "balance" or "withdraw" gold from your account at any time you want except during the night since we are closed.
npc.topic.mithrand.12: You must tell me how many gold pieces you wish to withdraw. For instance, if you would like to withdraw 10 gold pieces, you would simply tell me {WITHDRAW} {10} {GOLD}. Of course, you may also view your "balance" or "deposit" gold to your account at any time you want except during the night since we are closed.
npc.topic.mithrand.13: Bah! I'm getting tired of your ignorance... Go bother someone else!
npc.topic.mithrand.14: Humpf! It is the name of the island you are currently on.
npc.topic.mithrand.15: These days, it is near impossible for the merchants of our fair city to do business with our sister town, "Windhowl". If you would like to help one of our merchants, you must talk to "Lord" "Kirlor" and "register" yourself. He will then give you a letter that you must give to either "Sigfried" or "Rolph". They'll give you a report that must be delivered to "Lord" "Sunrock" in Windhowl as fast as possible.
npc.topic.mithrand.16: You must say this to "Lord" "Kirlor", not me!
npc.topic.mithrand.2: I have heard of that woman, but I never saw her myself.
npc.topic.mithrand.20: Lighthaven is the name of our fair city.
npc.topic.mithrand.21: The westernmost town of the island, Windhowl is falling prey to many wandering brigands and other assortments of strange creatures.
npc.topic.mithrand.3: Devilish monster? Cursed from beyond? Marked from eternity? Yeah, right!
npc.topic.mithrand.4: His name is Kirlor Dhul. He is the first and only Lord this town ever had. Probably the last one too if that blasted "King" doesn't do anything soon.
npc.topic.mithrand.5: Yes, Theodore XIII. He is the King of "Goldmoon", and it almost looks like he doesn't care what happens to the kingdom.
npc.topic.mithrand.6: Don't you know anything? Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping all the towns on the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.mithrand.7: You have %u gold pieces in your bank account.
npc.topic.mithrand.8: I am not a foolish banker!
npc.topic.mithrand.9: Yes, I am the banker of Lighthaven's bank.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.0: Your devotion is admirable and it will not go unnoticed. However, I have other important matters to attend to right now, and I do not have time to perform the necessary rites of initiation.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.1: As you are probably aware, the Elvenbane has served its purpose and is now useless. It is possible for me to break the enchantment but doing so will also destroy the blade. So, do you desire to be freed from its enchantment?
npc.topic.monsignordamien.10: Zhakar resides in a crumbling tower located in the Wizard's Vale.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.11: Stonecrest is the main town on the Stoneheim island.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.12: Julian? I've never had the pleasure of meeting someone whose name was Julian.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.13: I am no master of riddles, I am afraid. Mayhaps you could ask Menark? I happen to know he won last year's Tournament of Mystic Riddles, so he's sure to be your man.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.14: I do not believe in speaking of people behind their backs, even if such people would not hesitate to do so to thwart my goals.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.15: I do not understand what you want, child.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.16: You have already paid the price. Now, I can give you the "means" to accomplish the task that lies ahead.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.17: You have already paid the price. Now, I can give you the "means" to accomplish the task that lies ahead.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.18: You have already paid the price. Now, I can give you the "means" to accomplish the task that lies ahead.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.19: Now that you have the means to do it, I guess it's all up to you then.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.2: I am called Damien, Damien the Damned.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.20: Yes, that is the sword you will need to kill Shadeen.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.21: Unfortunately, I am not aware of his whereabouts. As you are a resourceful person, I have no doubt that you will succeed in finding him, even with my lack of information.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.22: You have already paid the price. Now, I can give you the "means" to accomplish the task that lies ahead.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.3: I preach to the winds, a single voice in a desert of madness. I plead for reason, and sure enough, no one listens.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.4: Yes indeed, I was condemned for my unorthodox beliefs, but only because the fools above me in the church of Artherk could not see the greater design of the world. But some day, I will show them all.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.5: Uh? I'm afraid I don't understand what you're talking about.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.6: Stoneheim is just another island. If that will be all, I have more important things to do than teaching you geography.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.7: I'm afraid I cannot help you with this.
npc.topic.monsignordamien.9: A terrible god is he. Please, do not speak his name in my presence.
npc.topic.moonrock.0: The High Priest? I'm afraid he had to leave. Brother Kiran can tell you more about it if you talk to him.
npc.topic.moonrock.1: I go by the name of Moonrock. I "work" in this temple to serve the great god of mending, "Artherk". A long time ago, I used to wander the world to help those in need, but now, I am content to just stay here and pray.
npc.topic.moonrock.10: Only a "Lightbringer" can bear the overwhelming wisdom infused by Artherk in a pearl of wisdom.
npc.topic.moonrock.11: I had one such key, a long time ago, yes. It wasn't for myself, but was necessary to save the life of a friend who had been taken hostage by Bane Blackblood, on Raven's Dust. I guess he still has it, although some people have already asked me about it.
npc.topic.moonrock.12: Balork dwells in a "dungeon" under the temple of Artherk.
npc.topic.moonrock.13: I do not really like filthy dungeons.
npc.topic.moonrock.14: I am the Bishop of this church. I can "heal" your wounds using powerful "magic".
npc.topic.moonrock.15: Annabelle has a powerful healing touch.
npc.topic.moonrock.16: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.moonrock.17: Artherk is the greatest deity of them all. He is the god of mending and truth. It is an honor for me to be able to serve him.
npc.topic.moonrock.18: I am one with the elements of light and earth. With the knowledge that I possess, I am able to heal one's wounds. If you have time, I can share that knowledge and "teach" you a few spells.
npc.topic.moonrock.19: Very well. This is what I can teach you.
npc.topic.moonrock.2: This is the name of a coastal town located on "Stoneheim".
npc.topic.moonrock.3: Stoneheim is a distant island where the town of "Stonecrest" is located.
npc.topic.moonrock.4: Unfortunately, most of the original copies have been stolen by pilferers on Stoneheim. There are 5 pages that you must retrieve to have a complete set of the Psalms of Artherk.
npc.topic.moonrock.5: A Champion of Light is a person who has decided to follow the path of Light.
npc.topic.moonrock.6: To become a Lightbringer, you must be a "Champion" "of" "Light". If you are, then all you have to do is to seek a paladin such as Sir Beltigan of "Stoneheim".
npc.topic.moonrock.7: I am sorry but there is nothing I have to say about that to you.
npc.topic.moonrock.8: I am sorry but there is nothing I have to say about that to you.
npc.topic.moonrock.9: I think she resides in Stonecrest now. If you ever see her, tell her I said hello.
npc.topic.moontugguard1.0: The skraug sentry growls ominously when you wave your hand... you quickly stop and look away.
npc.topic.moontugguard2.0: The skraug sentry growls ominously when you wave your hand... you quickly stop and look away.
npc.topic.mordenthal.0: Whence I came, they called me Sir Mordenthal.
npc.topic.mordenthal.1: A "dark" "knight" I am, and mayhaps something more.
npc.topic.mordenthal.10: The one I am referring to is none other than "Makrsh" "P'tangh".
npc.topic.mordenthal.11: Most wretched of men is he, the Dark One will stop at nothing to gain whatever power he can have. His strength is so great that it rivals that of the "gods"!
npc.topic.mordenthal.12: So profound is their need that the gods are hard-pressed to take action. My god is searching for "followers" to help him vanquish this threat.
npc.topic.mordenthal.13: You are already one of my lord's followers. You should seek to "uphold" him in all you do.
npc.topic.mordenthal.14: You are already one of my lord's followers.
npc.topic.mordenthal.15: I will not lie to you by telling you that your task is none other than "vanquishing" the Dark One himself.
npc.topic.mordenthal.16: Oh never fear, there are many others that have been charged with the same task as you. You will of course have to gather much power before you are capable of confronting him. You must first find the location of his "stronghold" and that alone will prove to be a most difficult endeavor. Nevertheless, I'm certain that if you strive hard enough to better yourself, you will prevail.
npc.topic.mordenthal.17: There is one who would know of its location, but he cannot be found on this plane of existence. He is known as the "oracle".
npc.topic.mordenthal.18: The oracle resides in his own realm, a place rumored to be nearly inaccessible. To reach him, you will need the "Key" "of" "Ogrimar".
npc.topic.mordenthal.19: You have the key now, it is up to you to use it.
npc.topic.mordenthal.2: I was once foremost amongst the great generals in "Ogrimar"'s army.
npc.topic.mordenthal.20: You may have seen it while wandering. It is a great "fortress" surrounded by a body of water.
npc.topic.mordenthal.21: I say so because there is no apparent point of entry. However, with the Key of Ogrimar one may be able to enter the "portal" located inside the "Chamber" "of" "Providence".
npc.topic.mordenthal.22: Now that you have the key, all that is left is to find the Chamber of Providence and enter the portal.
npc.topic.mordenthal.23: The chamber is located on a well hidden island to the east near the Sunken Woods forest. There lies a path below the surface of the water, and one can walk on it as if walking on the water itself. The pathway is marked by two spires. Once you step through the portal, you will arrive in the Oracle's realm. I cannot tell you anything beyond this point because I have never been there myself.
npc.topic.mordenthal.24: You already have the Key of Ogrimar. You need not trouble yourself with these questions any longer.
npc.topic.mordenthal.25: As you well know, the three parts required to fashion the key are the Skull of Ogrimar, the Blood of Ogrimar and the Bones of Ogrimar.
npc.topic.mordenthal.26: You already have this piece of the key.
npc.topic.mordenthal.27: You already have this piece of the key.
npc.topic.mordenthal.28: You have already met with him I believe... his name is Julian. I sent him to investigate the town of Stonecrest. Were you to look for him, that is where you would probably find him.
npc.topic.mordenthal.29: Yes, I see you've met with my assistant. That boy is full of promise I tell you. He has served me well these past few years.
npc.topic.mordenthal.3: Since the past few thousand years, there has been one whose power has grown steadily. Since a balance must be kept, what is gained must be lost somewhere else. Fortunately, there is "another" whose power has also been decreasing.
npc.topic.mordenthal.30: You already have this piece of the key.
npc.topic.mordenthal.32: Ahh yes, I thought you might return soon. I sense that my "help" you could use.
npc.topic.mordenthal.33: Yes, I would be willing to help you. Mayhaps the addition of the soul steal "spell" to your repertoire will make your journeys a little less harsh.
npc.topic.mordenthal.34: I am certain this spell will help you.
npc.topic.mordenthal.35: The soul steal spell damages your opponent by draining his life force with the power of darkness.
npc.topic.mordenthal.37: Drardos is an antiques collector who resides with his wife in Silversky on Raven's Dust.
npc.topic.mordenthal.38: So you know about the ring now, do you? Very well, I guess there is no use denying it now. Yes, the ring is mine... what of it?
npc.topic.mordenthal.39: He is the god of Night, and represents terror and chaos. His power has "dwindled" over the years, however.
npc.topic.mordenthal.4: I would rather not discuss this with you, if you don't mind. Individuals of your ilk disgust me.
npc.topic.mordenthal.5: If you would assist me, I could use some "Rings" "of" "the" "Lion". King Aedenas Gravesoul, ruler of the Centaurs, should have some, but you might need to give him something in return.
npc.topic.mordenthal.6: Artherk, the god of Peace, curse his name, has also been affected by the uprise of the "Dark" "One".
npc.topic.mordenthal.7: I have a dire need for such blades. Would you part with yours in exchange for a "Dark" "Gem"?
npc.topic.mordenthal.8: Such artifacts are very rare, very hard to find, and they are useless if you do not carry with you a high number of "Dark" "Gems".
npc.topic.mordenthal.9: While it does little in and of itself, this item is a vital source of power for the "Dark" "Gemblade" artifact.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.0: I am known as Mordrick Warstone, Knight of Might and protector of King "Theodore" XIIIth.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.1: I am the Knight of Might. This title has been bestowed upon me by the King himself. I have pledged on my honor that I will defend King "Theodore" XIIIth no matter what. I also have the task of choosing new young "recruits" to fill our ranks.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.10: I need to know how good you can be in the heat of a battle. Therefore, you will have to slay at least 15 demon trees that plague the forest of Ravenwood. That shouldn't be too difficult for you.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.11: The Lich Makrsh P'Tangh is both strong in body and in magic. Weapons alone will not overcome it that easily. Only a good mix of steel and magic will be able to destroy him for good.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.13: What would be the need of going there? There's no water and nothing interesting there. Furthermore, I heard stories of deadly scorpions roaming in that area.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.14: I could break all your bones just for saying that to me but I'll let it pass... for now.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.15: Be on your way and stop bothering me. I have work to do.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.2: I despise him because he does not care about his people. Not as much as a true king should. He does little other than sleep all day while people are starving or attacked by vile creatures. Good men such as "Derran" "Ironstrife" have to take the burden upon themselves of making difficult decisions.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.3: You are trying to fool me with some fake swords, %s?There can be only one Sword of Might!
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.4: There's an underground complex called the Caverns of Illusion. That is where sword often returns, for some mysterious reason.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.5: Derran Ironstrife is a great warrior and one of "King" "Theodore"'s pillars. Without him, I am sure that the kingdom would already be overtaken by savages.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.6: The orcs are a constant danger. They must be obliterated once and for all or they will always attempt to cause use mischiefs.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.7: Do I look like a trainer to you? Go see Derran if you want some training.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.8: Do I look like a teacher? Stop bothering me and see Derran if you want to be taught new abilities.
npc.topic.mordrickwarstone.9: We are always recruiting well-trained soldiers into our ranks of elite warriors. I'll readily admit that the pay is rather slim but our soldiers are always well fed.  Do you wish to enroll yourself and pledge loyalty, even through death, to our Majesty?
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.0: I am known as Morindin Arrowmist, the "hunter".
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.1: Cut the chit-chat, what do you want from me?
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.10: I am a hunter and an adventurer. I hunt small animals during the night and sell the skins at the town at a fair price.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.11: Mordrick Warstone has sent you? Fine then. Do you have a document you'd want me to translate?
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.12: GreyLeaf is of much greater power than the usual demon trees you see in Ravenwood.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.13: That's the name of this forest. There's not many animals here though. Perhaps I should think of moving into a more healthy forest such as one that can be found on "Arakas".
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.14: Arakas is the island located north of this one.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.15: I see that I'm not in good company right now.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.2: As a hunter, I have learned how to "survive" and sustain myself with the resources that are hidden within the forest. I am always in search for good quality "antelope" "skins" which I resell at the town after I have tailored them into fine leather jackets. I am also a master tracker. I could follow the tracks of anybody throughout the woods. Let's just say that I have earned quite a few pennies as a bounty hunter. Nowadays I prefer to hunt small animals however for I am not as young as I once was. Still, I can defend myself against any "orcs" or daemon trees that stand in my way.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.3: To survive, you have to be able to mend your wounds. I could "teach" you how to use the first aid technique that would help you accomplish that.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.4: You have two antelope skins you'd be willing to trade to me?
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.7: Very good, then let's begin your training.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.8: Even the best "hunter" in the world would find it hard to survive in such as harsh environment.
npc.topic.morindinarrowmist.9: Sometimes, I encounter orcs in the forest. Although I do not seek any hostilities, they attack me on sight and I have to defend myself. I've come to understand their crude language over the years. If you have a document that needs to be "translated", perhaps I could help you.
npc.topic.murmuntag.0: Me Murmuntag! Me good orc! Me friend with human like "Elmert" *grunt* Me strong! Me crush enemies! "Urgh!"
npc.topic.murmuntag.1: "Murmuntag" guard town. "Elmert" say kill, Murmuntag kill! *snort*
npc.topic.murmuntag.2: Elmert guard master. *grunt* Elmert pay Murmuntag to protect town. *snort*.
npc.topic.murmuntag.3: This battle cry. Uuuuurrrrrggghhh... Scare "monsters" baaadly. Only great "warriors" have battle cry.
npc.topic.murmuntag.4: *snort* Me could kill Balork easily! Me do "urgh" and him flee.
npc.topic.murmuntag.6: Near city. They come many from cave. But me always scare them.
npc.topic.murmuntag.7: You great warrior? Not great like Murmuntag! Can help you become great, Murmuntag "train" you hard!
npc.topic.mushn.0: I'm Mushn. Greetings to you too.
npc.topic.mushn.1: I own a farm, and I can tell you, it's a job that "occupies" me every minute of the day.
npc.topic.mushn.2: I've never heard of that woman.
npc.topic.mushn.3: Balork's curse? As long as it does not tamper with my crops...
npc.topic.mushn.4: Yes, there are so many things to do on a farm like this. Feed the animals, cultivate the wheat and plant new grains. I sure could use some help around here, but unfortunately, I'm not making much money, and those darn "goblins" are making the trading business very difficult.
npc.topic.mushn.5: Darn little red demons. Several days ago, one got through here, and I had to kill it myself with my shovel. I wish somebody would go to the northern mountains and wipe them out!
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.0: I am Nafuhr BloodHammer. Peculiar name isn't it? It comes from my dwarven "heritage".
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.1: I am the village's blacksmith. Although I know how to forge weapons, I leave this in the expert hands of "Rhodar" "Heatforge". My speciality is crafting strong and durable armors.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.10: Even though Murmuntag, Vuntertag and Guntertag are on the right side, they are still orcs and cannot be trusted. They will fight on your side (or against you) for a pouch of coins and a bread crust.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.11: She was a brave woman. I wish I'd known her better.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.12: Orcs *cannot* be trusted. Incidentally, Raven's Dust is plagued by an orc campment located somewhere in the north. They have battle siege weapons that could do severe damages to our castle but fortunately for us, they are so heavy that even the orcish brutes cannot bring them within range.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.13: You will not be disappointed with my very durable pieces of armor.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.14: What is it that you wish to sell?
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.15: I have customers to tend to so if anyone strange walked in front of my store, I probably missed it.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.2: You look somewhat surprised that dwarven blood runs freely through my veins. I had a "great" "grandfather" who was a dwarf while his wife was human.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.3: This is the smith you must seek if you are looking to buy a good weapon.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.4: The name was Moridhar Rumblehill. He was an awesome warrior who could not be bested in one-on-one combat. In fact, he even fought the powerful dragons of Firesky. Alas, he never learn to retreat and eventually ended up crushed by a "dragon".
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.5: I wonder what happened exactly to that race.
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.6: Yes, that's the name of my "great" "grandfather".
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.7: The dragon tooth was a tiger's tooth in reality? I knew it. It's so small, even a baby wyrm has bigger teeth!
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.8: The dragon tooth was a tiger's tooth in reality? I knew it. It's so small, even a baby wyrm has bigger teeth!
npc.topic.nafuhrbloodhammer.9: The dragons are fearsome creatures. They have razon-sharp talons, "teeth" that can bite through the strongest armors and some are even rumored to breathe fire! Fortunately, most of the evil dragons have mysteriously disappeared from Althea.
npc.topic.namelessbard.0: Into the "abysssss" I have looked and it said they were the next.
npc.topic.namelessbard.1: Look to the land and you will find the "remnantsssss" of my people.
npc.topic.namelessbard.2: In a tree you will find wisdom, in a fountain, knowledge. Where wisdom and knowledge converge, the answers you seek will emerge.
npc.topic.namelessbard.3: I too was of the chosen... They came and offered us the forbidden... We refused and still we prayed to them... We dedicated our little life to their heaven... And they came and offered us the forsaken... Still we refused and we repented... Death came and cursed us of our lament... He slew all of us and in our amend... We swear that one day we will be avenged.
npc.topic.nisalmmalorik.0: I am Nisalm Malorik. Please, do call me Niss, it's what all my friends call me.
npc.topic.nisalmmalorik.1: I am an assistant here, at Lord Sunrock's office. I am in charge of the citizens' demands. I also keep track of everything that's happening in town. Unfortunately, that is "confidential" information, as per Lord Sunrock's orders.
npc.topic.nisalmmalorik.2: I heard that she has elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.nisalmmalorik.4: Do not forget that our town is waging a fierce war against the goblins. Many unscrupulous fools would sell information about our town for a goodly price. So we have to keep some information under a seal of secrecy.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.0: He speaks to good and evil folks, but before you speak to him, you will need to find him, and that means you must undertake a very difficult quest... to become a Lightbringer.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.1: You have reached a point in your life where no guidance of my part could actually help you. Nevertheless, our church offers several "services" that might help you, all of which are available for a small donation.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.10: Theoran lives in a small house outside of Stonecrest. I must warn you however that if you or a friend of yours go there with bad intentions, Theoran might not react well at all.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.11: Alas, I am not entirely certain where these can be found. However, I think "Annithae" "Teardrop" has a nice collection of pearls. I think that you should ask her if she has some that she could give to you.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.12: Annithae lives right here in Stonecrest. I'm sure you won't have any troubles finding her.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.16: You no longer need fangs of true resolve.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.17: Our church offers several "services", all of which are available for a small donation.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.18: I can "heal" your wounds, set your "sanctuary" in our temple or "teach" you a few useful spells
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.19: These are the wonderful spells I can teach you.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.2: I strongly doubt that you wish to cross Sir Beltigan. He is a paladin and surely does not appreciate your ilk.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.20: The bless spell temporarily bestows upon the target the blessing of the gods, augmenting its capacity to fight and cast spells in general.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.21: The mass healing spell will cure the wounds of all the characters in the caster's group within the target area. You must have the healing spell in order to learn it.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.22: The healing mist spell will cure the wounds of all the characters in the caster's group within the target area. You must have the mass healing spell in order to learn it.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.23: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.24: It is always unfortunate to face death, but those who wear a Gem of Destiny can set a "Sanctuary" where they will reappear when they get killed.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.25: The Sanctuary is where your body and soul are restored by the Gem of Destiny if you have been killed. Do you wish to set the Temple of Stonecrest as your sanctuary?
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.26: I am truly sorry to hear that.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.28: Alas, I do not have all the answers.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.5: You already have the Key of Artherk. All that is left is to find the Chamber of Providence and enter the portal.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.6: You should walk to the land of the centaurs and ask the cleric, "Dionysus" "Silverstream" for his assistance. He is the only priest who possesses both enough skill and faith to create a staff of hope. He's also one of the few centaurs who won't hold you in disdain.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.7: You should walk to the land of the centaurs and ask the cleric, "Dionysus" "Silverstream" for his assistance. He is the only priest who possesses both enough skill and faith to create a staff of hope. He's also one of the few centaurs who won't hold you in disdain.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.8: Dionysus Silverstream is the only cleric in the town of the centaurs. Once you're there, head for the temple and you'll find him.
npc.topic.nissushaloseeker.9: You'll find that a ring of pure faith can come in handy. If you need some, you must seek out "Theoran" "Ironfaith", a war cleric who lives alone in a small house outside of Stonecrest.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.0: I have no time for meaningless chit-chat.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.10: You must tell me how much gold pieces you wish to deposit. For instance, if you would like to deposit 10 gold pieces, you would simply tell me {DEPOSIT} {10} {GOLD}. Of course, you may also view your "balance" or "withdraw" gold from your account at any time you want except during the night since we are closed.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.11: You must tell me how much gold pieces you wish to withdraw. For instance, if you would like to withdraw 10 gold pieces, you would simply tell me {WITHDRAW} {10} {GOLD}. Of course, you may also view your "balance" or "deposit" gold to your account at any time you want except during the night since we are closed.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.12: You're asking the wrong fellow. I have no help to give, not even to sell. Go see the old gypsy if you need your future told, I hear she's quite accurate... if you have the bank account to back it up.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.13: It was nice talking to you.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.2: Norimar Steelwind is the name. If you have some hard-earned gold pieces that you want to "deposit" in the secured vault, I am the one to whom you must speak.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.3: I am the banker of this town. I must keep track of all the "deposits" and "withdrawals". I also ensure that thieves such as "Daran" "Lightfoot" do not get access to the vault.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.4: If you store your hard-earned gold in here, you will have nothing to fear of this thief.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.5: She is an odd lady. I wouldn't trust her but I must say that she is rich and gold pieces usually win my trust quite easily.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.6: The services I offer you are quite simple. You can "deposit" or "withdraw" gold pieces or view your account's "balance".
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.7: You have %u gold pieces in your bank account.
npc.topic.norimarsteelwind.8: I am not a foolish banker.
npc.topic.oldhermit.10: Raven's Dust is the island located to the south.
npc.topic.oldhermit.11: The kingdom of Goldmoon regroups the island of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust".
npc.topic.oldhermit.12: Lighthaven and Windhowl are the two towns located on this island.
npc.topic.oldhermit.13: Arakas? If you do not know where it is, lemme tell you this my friend.. you're LOST! *cackle*
npc.topic.oldhermit.14: Silversky is a small town located on "Raven's" "Dust" near "Theodore"'s castle.
npc.topic.oldhermit.15: King Theodore? I hear he cannot do anything other than sleep.
npc.topic.oldhermit.16: Seeing as you bear no such curse upon you, this is hardly a concern of yours, is it?
npc.topic.oldhermit.17: Easier said that done, I'm afraid she lives on "Raven's" "Dust", not on this... But one as resourceful as you are should not be deterred by hundreds of leagues of water... Perhaps you could "swim" there...
npc.topic.oldhermit.18: Just kidding, my friend. Must you take everything so seriously? Er... Don't answer that. You probably should. Take everything seriously, I mean. You youngsters are so flighty... Anyway, swimming's not really an option. Perhaps a "boat"?
npc.topic.oldhermit.19: Nah, let's strike that out, boats aren't a very good idea at this time of year. Plus, there's the pirates... How about "flying" there?
npc.topic.oldhermit.2: Yes... That would be me. Please be on your way and trouble me no more.
npc.topic.oldhermit.20: No, wait, that's not good either... The giant rocs are all but extinct, and Dwarvinci's flying machine is nothing more than a pipedream. Even that feeble-minded thief who thinks he had flying boots is way off the track. I guess it would take a miracle to take you to "Raven's" "Dust"... Too bad.
npc.topic.oldhermit.21: Asking for a miracle, hmm? Well, I do not know about that, but have you considered "wizardry"? Perhaps that would work.
npc.topic.oldhermit.22: I fail to see why you would need the trust of an old man.
npc.topic.oldhermit.23: *laugh* Excellent! That's the spirit! Heh heh.. I like someone with a sense of adventure. If you're not afraid of dying, you could try teleportation. Speak to Liurn Clar, a wizard in "Windhowl". He needs test subjects. *grin* Now go, I'm tired and your company bores me.
npc.topic.oldhermit.24: Being worthy is great achievement, one that may one day save humankind. Would you not agree? But no matter, youngsters such as you have no care for an old man's "drivel".
npc.topic.oldhermit.25: So you would have me speak of this nonetheless? Don't you have something better to do with your time. Methinks you should find another way to "prove" your "worth".
npc.topic.oldhermit.26: Is that her new name? It stinks! *cough* Oh, don't tell her that. Eh Eh!
npc.topic.oldhermit.27: Don't get lost on your way back home.
npc.topic.oldhermit.3: Hmpf... They shun me, then seek me out... *sigh* Very well, what would you need from me?
npc.topic.oldhermit.4: Read my lips, young pup: N*O*W*A*Y. I'm done with teaching. Seek a tutor elsewhere.
npc.topic.oldhermit.5: I know not of any way to prove to me that you are a good person, but I trust my "daughter" and her alone. If she says you are trustworthy, then I will "trust" you. If not, then begone and stay gone.
npc.topic.oldhermit.6: She lives in "Windhowl". Now go and leave me be.
npc.topic.oldhermit.7: You know of her? Few people are aware that she has Elven ancestors... A very long-lived, comely lass, she was.
npc.topic.oldhermit.8: Ah, wish that I could have lived in the old days, that I could have seen them, walked with them. What a grand time I would have had. But they be long gone, now, cursed by the gods and all but extinct.
npc.topic.oldhermit.9: Hmmm... So you know my real name. That is not bad for one so young as you are. But you'll have to do better than that if you want to impress me.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.0: That is what I was told to do, but I was duped. Don't worry, I will not do the "same" to you. It is just what we call the big picture.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.1: Are you not the one sent by the king? The New Breed of Altheans, the ones who carry in their blood the rage of those who have fallen? But I am getting ahead of myself. I would like to see what you are made of. What do you say? Will you fight to get the answers you seek?
npc.topic.olinhaad1.10: Why did I tell you all this? The answer is quite simple actually. I did it for revenge. Knowledge is power, my friend... remember that. Now, I want you to do something for me. Tell that damned high priest in the Temple of Lighthaven, Gunthar, to give me what I was promised or I will not leave until all the people of this town become part of my staff of undead! Now, if you will excuse me, I have things to do.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.11: The fool thought the Heartstone to be a mere piece of rock, while it is much more than that... Huh? What is that you carry? A "Darkstone"? This is not what I am looking for. This stone has no value to me whatsoever.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.12: Oh, I understand now. The priest sent you here to hurt me with that, did he? Hah! Go tell your priest that I will take his miserable life if he still insists on denying me the "Heartstone".
npc.topic.olinhaad1.13: You do not know what the Heartstone is? You should ask your high priest, as he knows more about it that anyone else. But beware, even though he is a priest of Artherk, he schemes and "lies" more than Ogrimar himself.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.14: Enough of this... guards! Dispose of him and send his remains to the priest! Maybe that will change his mind.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.15: I will crush you like an ant!
npc.topic.olinhaad1.16: In my veins flows the power of my lord Gluriurl. He has chosen me to be the "Herald" of my master Makrsh P'Tangh.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.17: Centuries ago, my master created a group comprised of the most powerful archmages of Althea. This group, which you know as the Obsidian Conclave, was to find a way to "destroy" everything that was dear to the gods.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.18: They wreaked havoc everywhere they went. One day, when the Obsidian Conclave was conquering the island of Stoneheim, we dragons intervened and it was at that moment that I first found a dark stone. I later learned that it was the Heart of a god named Gluriurl. At the time I did not know what it was, but it was not long before I started to hear the "soothing" "voice".
npc.topic.olinhaad1.19: My lord Gluriurl was talking to me. He said that I had been chosen to serve the Obsidian Conclave under Makrsh P'Tangh, and that in my master I would find the strength to conquer those who have forsaken us. He also told me that in time, once I have gathered all his "remains", I would be the one to wake him from his slumber.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.2: The Council of the Eight. No one knows exactly who they are, but it can't be good seeing as they intervene only in matters concerning the "Harbinger".
npc.topic.olinhaad1.20: I now have his skull, his ribcage and his heart! Do not be surprised, the Darkstone you have in your possession is the Heart of Artherk, not Gluriurl. All I need to do is find a way inside the temple of Lothar to get my lord's essence. Now, begone and for the last time, tell your high priest Gunthar that I will not hesitate to slay everyone in this town if he doesn't tell me where the entrance to the temple is located!
npc.topic.olinhaad1.21: I am known as Olin Haad.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.23: I don't see how this is any business of yours.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.24: Leaving so soon? Such a pity.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.3: The Harbinger of Death. The god that is mentioned in the "prophecy" of the Fourth Coming.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.4: It is said that Death will one day plant into the world the "Seeds" of Decay. Once fully grown, these seeds will harvest Life and shape the land in preparation for "His" arrival.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.6: Each of these seeds will contain the rage of the dead races that were destroyed in the name of pride. The Council of the Eight believes that "you" are such a seed.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.7: You are what we call the "New" "Breed". In your veins flows the blood of the elves, the orks and the dwarves of the past.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.8: Interesting story, don't you think? Now then, I believe that I have "answered" all your questions.
npc.topic.olinhaad1.9: I can never have enough undead at my service.
npc.topic.omarhald.0: I am Omar Hald, the renowned jeweler.
npc.topic.omarhald.1: I am the town's jeweler. I am particularly skilled when it comes to polishing "raw" "crystals". You might also be interested to "buy" some of my wares.
npc.topic.omarhald.2: You can find raw crystals in the caves on the eastern side of Stoneheim. The skraugs are particularly fond of them. I have developed an expertise that allows me to polish these raw crystals into a fine gem of courage. However, I require 9 raw crystals and 50,000 gold for my services to create a single gem.
npc.topic.omarhald.3: Do you want to take a look at my selection of expertly crafted jewelry?
npc.topic.omarhald.4: So, it is your turn to sell some wares, eh?
npc.topic.omarhald.5: I've had enough of you. Leave my house at once!
npc.topic.oracle.0: If one is pure in spirit and in soul, his true colors will be reflected by his physical self. To achieve such a level of purity, you must be "reborn".
npc.topic.oracle.1: For some reason that I cannot quite explain, I cannot continue with your rebirth. In the mean time, perhaps you should "prepare" yourself for the last battle with Makrsh P'Tangh.
npc.topic.oracle.10: He must be dealt with, and soon, if this world is to continue its existence. There are few today with the "potential" to one day be able to confront one powerful such as he. I believe you may be one with such "potential".
npc.topic.oracle.11: The entire world will be consumed by Makrsh P'Tangh's need for destruction. He cares not what happens to any of his lieutenants and followers. His desire is not to rule the world, but to destroy it as revenge for his own suffering.
npc.topic.oracle.12: Yes, I do believe you truly have what is necessary to defeat Makrsh P'Tangh. All that remains is for you to "prepare" youself for the final conflict.
npc.topic.oracle.13: There is very little you must do really. simply tell me when you wish to make the "final" "step" and I will send you on your way. I must remind you that if you feel you are not yet ready, you may continue with the "test" in order to be reborn again.
npc.topic.oracle.14: Very well, the preparations are complete!
npc.topic.oracle.15: For your test, you will face Gabriel Archonis. You will fight him in a duel to the death inside a special arena. There are four doors surrounding the site, each of which will whisk you out of battle to a safe place should you so desire. To use one of these doors means that you forfeit the battle and will later have to start over. To reach the place of battle, you will require a "key".
npc.topic.oracle.16: Here you are then... I trust you understand what must be done now. Be steadfast and you shall surely succeed. Remember this when you enter the arena. Now go and best of luck to you.
npc.topic.oracle.17: This kind of behavior will not be tolerated within these walls. You get that one for free, %s.
npc.topic.oracle.18: May you find the path that will lead you to your destiny.
npc.topic.oracle.2: Once you are reborn, you will be gifted with wings, a part of your heritage as a Seraph. You will also gain the status of a Seraph, gaining access to certain places where you could not go before. Be warned, there is a price to pay for such a prestige. Upon gaining the status of Seraph, you will be demoted to an inexperienced adventurer and will have to begin your life anew. You will, however, begin this life with greatly increased mental and physical capabilities. Well now, there is not much more I can say to prepare you. When you are "ready" "to" "be" "reborn", simply tell me so and we shall begin.
npc.topic.oracle.3: Since the "beginning" "of" "time", I have worn many guises. Those who know me now refer to me as the "Oracle".
npc.topic.oracle.4: I am one with the flow of time. I see all that was, is and will be.
npc.topic.oracle.5: Show me... This is a sparring program, similar to the programmed reality of the matrix. It has the same basic rules. Rules like gravity. What you must remember is that these rules are no different than the rules of a computer system. Some of them can be bent, others can be broken. Understand? Then hit me, if you can...
npc.topic.oracle.6: Since the moment of Creation, I have watched over this world. I have seen great civilizations rise and fall and entire continents spring up out of great oceans, only to be swallowed up several millenia later.
npc.topic.oracle.7: I am the Keeper of Time. I have many tasks to perform, not the least of which is the oversight of the "balance" between Good and Evil.
npc.topic.oracle.8: There is "one" who deems himself outside of the flow of Time. His mere presence is a threat to the delicate scales of Good and Evil.
npc.topic.oracle.9: I speak of "Makrsh" "P'Tangh" of course. His desire for "death" and "destruction" is beyond understanding.
npc.topic.ortanalas.0: I am Ortanalas. What can I do for you?
npc.topic.ortanalas.1: I can pass on some of my knowledge if you are ready to learn.
npc.topic.ortanalas.2: Unfortunately, I am not yet experienced enough to teach. I can only train the skills that my master "Jagar" "Kar" teaches.
npc.topic.ortanalas.4: I have heard of that woman, but I never saw her myself.
npc.topic.ortanalas.5: Bah! He can barely fit through a door frame because of the size of his head! I tell you, if I could, I'd show him a thing or two. Luckily for him, the lord pays me well to be his assistant. He thinks he's a master warrior, but he's only a big lazy tub of turd. He makes me clean all his clothes, shine his old rusty armor collection, and I do all the work when it comes to training people. True, he had some days of glory when he was the king's assistant and he can be one tough lad in combat. It's a shame he doesn't put his talent to better use. Oh well, I guess it's all the better for me... That way it will be much easier to take his place *grin*.
npc.topic.ortanalas.6: Very good, then let's begin your training.
npc.topic.pig.0: I am A Pig. What can I do for you?
npc.topic.pig.1: I mind my own business and know the area well.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.1: We're currently not holding a lottery. You can always "buy" "a" "ticket" for the next one, though.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.10: Have a nice evening, %s. It is currently %u:%u in the world of Althea.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.11: It is currently %u:%u in the world of Althea.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.2: I cannot sell another lottery ticket until the winner "claims" the "jackpot".
npc.topic.pmtheisser.3: The lottery pick will be held in %u minutes.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.5: The lottery system is quite simple. First, you must "buy" "a" "ticket" from me for only 1000 gold pieces. I'll pick the winner exactly 2 hours after the first ticket has been bought. I can tell you the "lottery" "time" if you ask me. If the winner does not "claim" the "jackpot" after a while, the gold pieces are automatically added to the next jackpot.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.6: It is quite simple to play the game I host and be a very rich person. You tell me what number you wish to "pick" and give me 1000 gold pieces. Then, I pick 5 numbers out of this sack. Each time I pick your number, you win 1000 gold pieces! You can win up to {FIVE} times your wager. I'm telling you, this could be your lucky day!
npc.topic.pmtheisser.7: You have to tell me what is the number you wish to pick for the lottery. For example, if you want to pick number 10, just say {PICK} {10} and you are in business. The number you choose has to be between 1 and 10.
npc.topic.pmtheisser.8: Sorry but the Goblin Invasion Quest is currently running.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.0: What would satisfy you? Just name your reward, whether it's a "prayer", "healing", "curse" removal, or... "gold", and it will be so. Make your choice carefully.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.1: Oh... I should have expected someone like you would ask for something as mundane as money for a good deed. Are you certain this is what you want?
npc.topic.princessdelilah.10: My name is Delilah, daughter of "King Theodore".
npc.topic.princessdelilah.11: I am the king's daughter and a priestess of Artherk.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.12: Yes, the king is my father. Since he sleeps so much, I have taken it upon myself to pray for the peace and well-being of all the citizens of our beautiful kingdom.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.13: I'm afraid it's not possible to meet with my father. He is very busy with the affairs of the state and has no time for visitors.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.14: Oh, I wouldn't know, but Menark certainly would.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.16: Be well. May Artherk protect you.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.2: I see that you have been cursed by that evil demon, Balork. Perhaps I could repay your generous deed by helping you with that? Would that be agreeable with you?
npc.topic.princessdelilah.3: I've never been on the island of Stoneheim but I've heard rumors that it is the field of a great battle between the forces of good and evil.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.4: He is a bit eccentric but I sense that he is a good person at heart. Plus, he is a wizard of immense power. You should treat him with respect. I sure wouldn't want him to be mad at me.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.5: Bishop Crowbanner is a kind man. Because he has always been my "mentor", I feel it is my duty to see to it that he is treated with the same care as he would for me.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.6: Yes, he has been my tutor for many years now, in fact more than I can remember. Bishop Crowbanner knows more about the workings of the world than most men seek in their lifetime. Since you have been good to him, I am certain he would gladly teach you a thing or two.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.7: The Oracle has disappeared a long time ago, but could foretell the future. I'm afraid I know little of these matters. Perhaps Sorcerer Zhakar could help you.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.8: I will pray for you tonight, %s, and hope that Artherk will save your soul.
npc.topic.princessdelilah.9: You do not need healing, you have no wounds.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.0: Yes, Rablek is the name. I am the swiftest blade gold can buy around here. Using a special "technique" I have learned a while ago, I am able to deliver harmful blows even against an armored opponent.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.1: The technique is known as "armor" "penetration". I might "teach" this skill to you if you're willing to pay the price.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.10: Didn't I tell you that curiosity is a bad habit?
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.2: You haven't heard of me before? I am Rablek Swiftblade, the renowned thief.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.3: Curiosity is a bad habit. Around here, we do what we have to do and we keep our mouth shut about it.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.4: You need %u more levels, %u more strength, %u more agility and %u more intelligence to learn armor penetration.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.5: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.7: That's the guy over there who thinks he has some musical talent but obviously does NOT.
npc.topic.rablekswiftblade.8: Your tongue will get you killed someday.
npc.topic.ramirgo.0: That is what I am... nothing more, nothing less. I see that you have Artherk's Darkstone. As it is written, you may "enter" the shrine without any reprisal from me.
npc.topic.ramirgo.2: To guard this shrine until the end of time... such is my fate.
npc.topic.rawlin.0: Hello %s, I am pleased to make your acquaintance.
npc.topic.rawlin.10: You should ask someone else about that.
npc.topic.rawlin.11: Do not hesitate to come back if you need a good weapon.
npc.topic.rawlin.3: I wander around the country, selling my skillfully crafted "weapons" to whoever's wealthy enough to purchase one.
npc.topic.rawlin.4: I am sure that you won't be disappointed if you ever "buy" a weapon from me. Would you care to have a look at what I have?
npc.topic.rawlin.5: You'd like to buy a weapon, eh? I'm sure I have the perfect weapon to match your fighting style. Would you care to have a look at the weapons I have for sale?
npc.topic.rawlin.7: Raven's Dust is the name of this island.
npc.topic.rawlin.8: That is the town where the castle of King Theodore XIII is located. It is located somewhere to the south-east of the island.
npc.topic.rawlin.9: I doubt I'll make a sale with you today.
npc.topic.remortnpc1.0: I am the one called Alphan.
npc.topic.remortnpc1.1: I have been waiting for your arrival. I am here to "help" you prepare to start your new life.
npc.topic.remortnpc1.2: You have been granted a certain amount of energy that must be spent before you can move on to the next stage of evolution. Right now, you have a total of %u points of energy. Each of my associates will briefly explain to you how these may be spent to increase your abilities. Talk to each one and once you have spent all this energy, come back to talk to me and I shall arrange for your departure back into the world.
npc.topic.remortnpc1.3: The preparations are complete. Within a few seconds, you will be transported to Lighthaven to begin your life anew. I wish you good luck on your journey. May we one day meet again!
npc.topic.remortnpc1.4: Very well, return when you are ready to hear what I have to say.
npc.topic.remortnpc2.0: I am the one called Betran.
npc.topic.remortnpc2.1: I am here to help you increase your main "attributes" by focusing your energy.
npc.topic.remortnpc2.2: By focusing your new energies, I can help you increase any or all of your main attributes. The attributes you can increase are "strength", "endurance", "agility", "intelligence" and "wisdom". Note that the higher you decide to push an attribute, the more costly in energy the process will be. For example, raising all your attributes by 1 costs much less energy than raising one attribute by 5. Such is the price of specialization. Now, which attribute would you like to increase?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.3: To increase your strength attribute by 1, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.4: To increase your agility attribute by 1, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.5: To increase your endurance attribute by 1, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.6: To increase your intelligence attribute by 1, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.7: To increase your wisdom attribute by 1, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc2.8: If you wish to increase your main attributes more later, come back and see me.
npc.topic.remortnpc3.0: I am the one called Caplan.
npc.topic.remortnpc3.1: I am here to help you increase your elemental "powers" by focusing your energy.
npc.topic.remortnpc3.2: By focusing your new energies, I can help you increase any or all of your elemental powers. These directly reflect your spellcasting ability in each of the elements. The elemental powers you can increase are "fire", "water", "air", "earth", "light" and "dark". Note that the higher you decide to push an elemental power, the more costly in energy the process will be. For example, raising all your elemental powers by 5 costs much less energy than raising one elemental power by 30. Such is the price of specialization. Now, which power would you like to increase?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.3: To increase your fire power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.4: To increase your water power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.5: To increase your air power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.6: To increase your earth power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.7: To increase your light power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.8: To increase your dark power by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc3.9: If you wish to increase your elemental powers again later, come back and see me.
npc.topic.remortnpc4.0: I am the one called Delaan.
npc.topic.remortnpc4.1: I am here to help you increase your elemental "resistances" by focusing your energy.
npc.topic.remortnpc4.2: By focusing your new energies, I can help you increase any or all of your elemental resistances. These directly reflect your defensive abilities against each of the elements. The elemental resistances you can increase are "fire", "water", "air", "earth" and "dark". Each and every increase in your elemental resistances costs the same amount of energy. Now, which resistance would you like to increase?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.3: To increase your fire resistance by 10, you will need to spend 2 points of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.4: To increase your water resistance by 10, you will need to spend 2 points of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.5: To increase your air resistance by 10, you will need to spend 2 points of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.6: To increase your earth resistance by 10, you will need to spend 2 points of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.7: To increase your dark resistance by 10, you will need to spend 2 points of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc4.8: If you wish to increase your elemental resistances again later, come back and see me.
npc.topic.remortnpc5.0: I am the one called Epilan.
npc.topic.remortnpc5.1: I am here to help you increase your maximum "health" and "mana" by focusing your energy.
npc.topic.remortnpc5.2: To increase your maximum health by 10, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc5.3: To increase your maximum mana by 5, you will need to spend 1 point of energy. Is this acceptable?
npc.topic.remortnpc5.4: If you wish to increase your maximum health or mana again later, come back and see me.
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.1: Me Morgrath, me very strong. *snort* Me see, me kill.

npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.3: Powerful wizard he is. *snort* Me listen him or him be maaaaaaad... *grunt*
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.4: He very strong, but me better. *grunt*
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.5: *snort*.. H... He scary. Me don't like him. *grunt*

npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.7: Goblins are weak, but orc are *snort*... stronger.. Much stronger!
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.8: Morgrath not have pretty stone. Morgrath was attacked by mean brigands. Took pretty rock from Morgrath. Too many of them. Morgrath could not do anything. Asarr has rock. Master Jarko will be mad at Morgrath. Mad! Mad! *grunt* *snort*
npc.topic.renegadeorcleader.9: *snort* Lighthaven is small human town like Windhowl. *grunt*
npc.topic.resha.0: I have no time for chit-chats.
npc.topic.resha.10: I'll teach you some good manners.
npc.topic.resha.3: Forget about quests! What are you doing with "Bows" "of" "Centaur" "Slaying"?!?
npc.topic.resha.4: I see you've accumulated enough bows to earn your reward. I'll trade you a "Cloak" "of" "the" "Archer" against five of these bows. Agreed?
npc.topic.resha.5: *grumble* Yeah, I know of him. I went to him to ascend, a long time ago, but I did not succeed the challenges he put before me, so I returned here as a guard. Hope you'll have better luck!
npc.topic.resha.6: If you're an archer, this magically enhances your accuracy with a bow, and deflects some of the attacks against you. Since I used to be a champion archer, I've accumulated a lot of those, but I no longer need them since I use better gear, given to me by some of my centaur friends.
npc.topic.resha.7: My duty is to enforce the law and protect the citizens of Stonecrest from harm.
npc.topic.resha.8: He should be hanged and his entrails should be given to the bears in the forest.
npc.topic.resha.9: Did you know that Makrsh P'Tangh the Lich used to be an elven prince? He sure doesn't look like an elf anymore. They say that he is cursed but I am not sure it is a curse to have such awesome powers.
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.0: I'm called Reynen Aspicdart, but most people used to call me '"The" "Dart"' back in my *ahem* earlier career.
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.1: Right now, I'm looking for a way out of this cave, but the illusions keep on bringing me back here. Bloody darn annoying, if y'ask me. But if you're asking what I used to do for a living, I was a con artist. I've reformed, though, so you don't have to worry right now.
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.10: If you ever find a map of this cave, don't forget to bring it to me.
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.2: That's what they used to call me, back when I was a younger, more dashing rogue and hero. Now, I'm just Reynen, and I'd like nothing more than to get out of this cavern...
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.5: Heh heh... I'm sorry, I forgot to mention that the chest could be locked...
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.6: Heh heh... I'm sorry, I forgot to mention that the chest could be locked...
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.7: What is the problem with the chest?
npc.topic.reynen_aspicdart.9: Keep this up and you'll end up losing more than money! *smile*
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.0: The name is Rhodar Heatforge but people usually call me Rhodar.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.10: Brownbark is a woodcutter who lives somewhere in Ravenwood with his son, Anrak.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.11: Bane Blackblood wants to rule over the island of Raven's Dust but he won't as "King" "Theodore" "XIII"'s guards are using my weapons. *smile*
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.12: I heard he won the throne by sleeping. I wish I could do the same.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.14: Althea is the name of the world in which you are.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.15: Do not be afraid to come back to my shop if you need anything else.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.2: I am the weaponsmith of the village. I forge all my weapons myself from ore obtained in the mountains.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.3: You want to buy something, is that it?
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.4: Wait a minute! Lemme see that hammer you have... hey, that's mine!!! How did you find it?! Ah.. Qardos.. that wretched blackguard... of course! If I was a bit younger, I swear I'd put this hammer to good use. Now, will you give it back to me?
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.5: Hey, you've killed %u goblins, right? Looks like you hate them as much as I do. Come with me in the back of the store, I've got something to show you that might be useful. Look at this beautiful sword, it's a Goblin Slayer sword. It has the uncanny ability of literally destroying goblins. It's yours if you're willing to pay the fair price of 25000 gold pieces. Does that sound fair to you?
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.6: The desert of "Vulture's" "Den" is nearly as hot as my forge. You shouldn't go there or I'll lose yet another good customer.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.7: That's the name of the desert on the west part of the island.
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.8: What do you want to sell?
npc.topic.rhodarheatforge.9: I would not go there if I were you. Unless you're wielding one of my great weapons of course.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.0: I'm not sure about the magical properties of the Ring of the Seraph but I'll make a wild guess and say that it protects its wearer against harm.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.1: The name is Roen Greenleaf but Roen will do just fine.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.2: I hunt the wild animals in the forest when I have need of sustenance. I've also learned how to use the forest's vast resources to my advantage. For instance, I know how to mend my wounds using plants and roots found in the forest. If you want, I could "show" you how it's done.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.3: You need %u more levels, %u more intelligence and %u more wisdom to learn first aid.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.4: You must "learn" the skill before I can train you.
npc.topic.roengreenleaf.6: The young pup bares its fangs, eh? The old wolf will teach you some manners!
npc.topic.rolph.0: My name is Rolph, I am the greatest armorer around!
npc.topic.rolph.1: I own the best armor shop in all of "Goldmoon"! Although nowadays, with those damned "goblins", I'm not selling much.
npc.topic.rolph.10: I buy and sell armor. Do you wish to "buy" or "sell" any?
npc.topic.rolph.11: I forge the toughest armors in all of "Goldmoon"! Which one do you want?
npc.topic.rolph.12: What is it that you wish to sell?
npc.topic.rolph.13: Feel free to visit my shop again!
npc.topic.rolph.2: I heard that she has Elven blood running in her veins. Methinks it is untrue because we all know that Elves have been wiped out a long time ago. Or were they?
npc.topic.rolph.3: Balork's curse? That's horrible! Hmmm... Are sure you don't want to "buy" something?
npc.topic.rolph.4: Goldmoon is the kingdom regrouping all the villages on the islands of "Arakas" and "Raven's" "Dust", and I can tell you, you won't find a better armorer than me on any of these islands! Well, actually, maybe on Raven's Dust and the town of Windhowl too... Oh well.
npc.topic.rolph.5: It's the island where the castle of Theodore XIII is located.
npc.topic.rolph.6: Aye, that's the name of this island. It is home to the towns of Lighthaven and Windhowl.
npc.topic.rolph.7: Goblins... They are everywhere now! Some small groups sometimes succeed in passing Windhowl's defenses and terrorize the citizens. Usually, they get killed by brigands, or by our great guards, whom, I might add, are all equipped with gear from my fabulous shop.
npc.topic.rolph.8: You're still in Lighthaven? It is imperative that you deliver the report I gave you to Lord Sunrock's as soon as possible.
npc.topic.rolph.9: The lord's office is at the east side of town.
npc.topic.rondy.0: Ah'm the town's farmer. I have the uneasy yet rewarding task of tending t' my field and animals.
npc.topic.rondy.1: Ah'm Rondy, the best farmer you'll ever see in the East. No wheat can resist fer long t'my scythe and I.
npc.topic.rondy.10: I don't see why ya would want t' play m'ah game fer now.
npc.topic.rondy.11: I don't see why ya would want t' play m'ah game fer now.
npc.topic.rondy.12: Out of my sight or I'll make ya eat manure!
npc.topic.rondy.3: Ah'm a farmer allright. Ya can see the crops behind m'ah house.
npc.topic.rondy.4: Ah'm very proud of m'ah farm.
npc.topic.rondy.5: Ravenwood forest is cursed I tell ya. Mayhaps the "druids" will be able t' do somethin' 'bout it.
npc.topic.rondy.6: The druids' camp is located west of the town.
npc.topic.rondy.7: Oy! Methinks nothin' could grow there. Not enough water ya know.
npc.topic.rondy.9: I have absolutely no idea 'bout what ya are talkin'.
npc.topic.rylethcth.0: My name? Ignorant! I am R'yleth Cth and may you not forget it. I don't have time to babble while there is still so much work to "do".
npc.topic.rylethcth.1: Surely you jest! I am the greatest mage in this town, and maybe even in all of "Goldmoon".
npc.topic.rylethcth.5: Yes, researching new spells is a long and tiresome task, and as endless as time. Moreover, I have to "teach" would-be mages the great art, which is consuming much of my time.
npc.topic.rylethcth.6: Goldmoon is the kingdom which contains the islands of Raven's Dust and Arakas. Although it is a big kingdom, I am probably the highest ranking and most powerful mage in all of it.
npc.topic.rylethcth.7: Don't tell me you need to learn new spells? I'm rather busy at the moment, perhaps you should come back later.
npc.topic.safe.2: The safe's combination is composed of 3 numbers that can be anywhere between 1 and 100 inclusively. To rotate the safe's wheel, you can type {RIGHT} 10 to rotate the wheel 10 numbers to the right or type {LEFT} if you wish to rotate it in the opposite direction.
npc.topic.safe.5: If you wish to rotate the wheel to the right, you must provide a number. For example, you could type RIGHT 10 and you would rotate the wheel to the right by 10 numbers.
npc.topic.safe.6: If you wish to rotate the wheel to the left, you must provide a number. For example, you could type LEFT 10 and you would rotate the wheel to the left by 10 numbers.
npc.topic.samilalgder.0: I am called Samil Algder, and I am pleased to meet you.
npc.topic.samilalgder.1: My work, if it can be called that, is to follow the path set by "Artherk". I also have the task to bless our "troops" before they go into  a confrontation, and to attend to their wounds when they come back.
npc.topic.samilalgder.10: Druids can be very powerful, but they don't follow the true path of good. I do not dislike their ways, but I'd rather become a great priest.
npc.topic.samilalgder.11: May Artherk protect you in your visions.
npc.topic.samilalgder.2: Balork cursed you, you say? I'm sorry to hear that. If "Annabelle" the Blessed One was still here, she might be able to help you. But she's long gone, now. I hear a troll took her away to feast upon her.
npc.topic.samilalgder.3: I knew her well, that Annabelle. Lovelier than an Elf--not that I know what Elves look like, they left this world a long, long time ago. But yes, you'd love to meet her...
npc.topic.samilalgder.4: Yes, we have a rather big army here in Windhowl, but we need all the troops we can find, for the "goblins" are relentless in their assaults. As a result, our troops need godly blessing before they go into combat, to help them fight longer and harder.
npc.topic.samilalgder.5: The goblins are becoming increasingly deadly nowadays. I know not by what sadistic means they have accomplished it, but some of them have been seen wielding magical weapons!
npc.topic.samilalgder.7: He's the Archbishop of this church.
npc.topic.samilalgder.8: I spend most of my time with the troops, but another priest will gladly help you.
npc.topic.samilalgder.9: Artherk is a kind and just god. I would follow him beyond the edge of the world if I had to.
npc.topic.samuel.0: I have no time to spare for this.
npc.topic.samuel.10: You have already helped us. However, you should know that it is futile to fight the dead. The dark soul of the Death Jester simply have to enter another one of the many skeletal corpses in the dungeon to revive once more to trouble our nights.
npc.topic.samuel.11: You want an apple made of wax? What will you do with it? Nothing? Pardon me, but I do not have time to mold something that will end up in the trash can.
npc.topic.samuel.12: I could mold a candle of eternity but that would require five units of "wax" along with 5000 gold.
npc.topic.samuel.13: I am not sure who told you about my special hobby but I do enjoy creating various objects in wax such as candles, fruits, etc.
npc.topic.samuel.14: I have a few of those. It gives an additional protection to its wearear against all spells.
npc.topic.samuel.15: I have nothing to say about that poison-brewing witch.
npc.topic.samuel.16: Why would you want to know how to create poison?
npc.topic.samuel.17: The king has request some animal skin from you and you need someone to have it tanned? Let me see... hmmm.. I think that Drardos might be the man for the task.
npc.topic.samuel.18: He operates a small shop somewhere in the town.
npc.topic.samuel.19: I could have called the guards to throw you in the "prison" for such filthy words.
npc.topic.samuel.3: I should have you thrown out of the castle or even in the "prison" for your impoliteness!
npc.topic.samuel.4: I am the "King"'s advisor. I help him in the decision-making process.
npc.topic.samuel.5: What? How can you not know our great King "Theodore" the XIIIth? You must be a beggar then!
npc.topic.samuel.6: You will address his Majesty by his rightful title.
npc.topic.samuel.7: We don't get any unusual visitors in the castle! Well, now that you mention it, you look rather strange.
npc.topic.samuel.8: This is the castle of King Theodore XII.
npc.topic.samuel.9: The prison under the Castle is no longer in use. Dark creatures led by a malevolent being that goes by the name of "Death" "Jester" have taken over. We thought it was easier to simply condemn the prison rather than attempting to fight the de.. Hmmmm. I mean them...
npc.topic.sanctuaryguardian.0: Speak the word of power now and I shall grant you passage to the mausoleum.
npc.topic.sanctuaryguardian.1: You spoke the word of power and I am therefore instructed to let you pass. However, I must first warn you of the dangers you will face. Even though the God of Corruption is no more, its dreadful influence can still be felt throughout the endless corridors of the tainted sanctuary. You will encounter Gluriurl's followers who were once entombed alive and who are still devoted to him, even in their unlife. Thus, I must ask you if you still desire access to this foul place?
npc.topic.sanctuaryguardian.2: I have been given the task of guarding the mausoleum's entrance.
npc.topic.sanctuaryguardian.3: I see not why this would concern you.
npc.topic.sanctuaryguardian.5: I am here to guard the gate, not to provide answers.
npc.topic.scholar1.0: Excuse me? Ahh that's easy. That is elven for "To" "look" "upon" "one's" "self".
npc.topic.scholar1.1: What? I have no idea what you just said.
npc.topic.scholar2.0: Eh? Ahh that's easy. That is dwarven for "One" "must" "only" "have" "eyes".
npc.topic.scholar2.1: What? I have no idea what you just said.
npc.topic.scholar3.0: I beg your pardon? Ahh that's easy. That is fey for "To" "recognize" "one's" "own" "ignorance".
npc.topic.scholar3.1: What? I have no idea what you just said.
npc.topic.scholar4.0: What did you just say? Ahh that's easy. That is dragon for "One" "must" "open" "these" "eyes".
npc.topic.scholar4.1: What? I have no idea what you just said.
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.0: I go by the name of Seban Forgelot.
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.2: You haven't heard of the great Seban? Fine, I will tell you then. I make the very best "weapons" you'll find anywhere on this island. I forge them in my "workshop" and then sell them to whoever I meet in my travels. I'm sure you will want to "buy" some of them.
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.3: I will never reveal the location of my secret workshop to a simpleton like you!
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.4: Of course you want to buy, who wouldn't? Will you take a look at my selection?
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.5: Truly, I have the very best weapons you'll find anywhere on this island. Feel free to look around and "buy" what you like!
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.6: I don't see what you could possibly have to offer me, but I'll oblige you anyway.
npc.topic.sebanforgelot.7: Alright then, no need to stay around me any longer, off you go now!
npc.topic.shadeen.0: I'm Shadeen, sometimes just called The Dagger for flavor.
npc.topic.shadeen.1: I don't really work, I've got other people to do that for me. Let's say I'm... a businesswoman.
npc.topic.shadeen.10: You want to know more? Sure, why not. They're a group of discreet necromancers who are working for some powerful evil overlord. If you've met necromancers before, you can bet they were "not" members of the Obsidian Conclave. The Obsidian Wizards are discreet and almost never reveal themselves to the non-initiates. It took me twenty years to learn this, so you'd better be grateful.
npc.topic.shadeen.11: I know someone who's immortal... But if I tell you, you have to promise not to repeat it to anyone. You promise?
npc.topic.shadeen.12: Well, that was good work, got to admit it. Clever idea, that apple thing, got to hand it to you.
npc.topic.shadeen.13: Who? Who did you say? Kalastor? I... don't know what you're talking about. Hey, you strike me as a helpful kinda
npc.topic.shadeen.14: You're really a curious one, aren't you? Sure, Elves existed a long time ago, even if people are starting to believe they're just a fairy tale. Fact is--"LISTEN" "CAREFULLY", "HERE"--there are Elves left in the world, but they're mad and very, very hard to find.
npc.topic.shadeen.15: Menark is a chronicler who works in the town's library with his assistant, "Jeremiah". According to my sources, Menark has something quite valuable that I'd like to get my hands on.
npc.topic.shadeen.16: You might say that he is Menark's eyes and ears. He has the never-ending task of witnessing what happens and to report everything back to "Menark".
npc.topic.shadeen.17: Doremas is but a fool. However, he follows the orders much better than someone like "Baldric" "Silverknife" who is simply too impredictable.
npc.topic.shadeen.18: He's a real talented young man gifted with a loud mouth and a taste for troubles. He is too reckless for my taste, that is why I deal only with his henchman, "Doremas".
