npc.welcome.sufferingportal2: You must step closer to the portal to activate it.
npc.welcome.sundial: The sun is not up yet.
npc.welcome.tablenomad1: You search the table and discover a small key attached under it.
npc.welcome.terwin: You had better behave in front of the king!
npc.welcome.thea: How do you do my friend? Sit down and I'll be right with you.
npc.welcome.thelurker: Kalastor, that numbskull! You say he got the dreaded goblin fever? I need him at the best of his capacities, lest we lose contact with Lighthaven. I can sell you a cure for 800 gold pieces, just because it's for a friend. Do you want to buy the cure?
npc.welcome.theopold: A visitor... at last. What news bring thou from the world above?
npc.welcome.theoranironfaith: Prepare to defend yourself, spawn of darkness.
npc.welcome.thorbinwildheart: Welcome to the humble tavern of the "Troll's" "Armpit".
npc.welcome.thorglarefire: You're bringing a friend along? Get him out of my shop and we'll talk!
npc.welcome.tobias: Welcome to my humble abode. How may I be of service?
npc.welcome.torgas: How do you do my friend? Sit down and I'll be right with you.
npc.welcome.totak: Oh! You almost surprised me for an instant.
npc.welcome.trackerooglathraaglurh: Haar! Oogla not tink hummie wuud bring enuf tings tew treid fer skull. Very guud leetle hummie. Yew wanto treid fer skull den?
npc.welcome.treeofwisdom: You notice that a few branches have fallen from the Tree of Wisdom.
npc.welcome.tristan: You again? I really think you should investigate the caravan. As I've said, they took off with the remains taken from a corpse that bore wings just like yours. They went further East of Stonecrest, toward the edge of the creeping forest.
npc.welcome.ttayhmark: Step right in and look at the "greatest" weapons around.
npc.welcome.twinnevanis: I may "help" you, my friend, if you are in trouble.
npc.welcome.twinshovanis: Are you in trouble, my friend?
npc.welcome.uranos: Yes? You seek knowledge?  Then maybe I can help you.
npc.welcome.vargus: What's that you say? How can you possibly have gathered everything I asked? Oh well, I guess I must hold to my end of the bargain. Tell me then, is it still your desire to receive the Blood of Ogrimar?
npc.welcome.varguschest: The chest appears to be empty.
npc.welcome.venadar: Enough, please! If you want the ring so bad and you want to throw your life away then here it is. Now leave me be!
npc.welcome.vincentswiftblade: %s, I've heard you were part of the group who defeated the mercenary's leader. Very well done! I have the promised "reward" right here.
npc.welcome.whirlpoolmazeexitportal: You must step closer to the portal to activate it.
npc.welcome.windhowl_guard: We do not tolerate your kind here!
npc.welcome.windhowlsamaritan: Welcome to Windhowl, friend. How may I help you?
npc.welcome.windhowlsentry: Hmm, you look like you're a bit too weak to help in the fight against Hel...
npc.welcome.witchdoctorkwarlgloth: Hullo dere. Wut Kwarlgloth do fur yu?
npc.welcome.woodenchestnomad1: You open the chest but find nothing inside.
npc.welcome.woodenchestnomad2: You open the chest but find nothing inside.
npc.welcome.woodenchestnomad3: You open the chest but find nothing inside.
npc.welcome.worldwildhorse: You seem friendly enough... Since the Centaurs have given you so many Scrolls of Horse Friendship, I must assume you're a good fellow.
npc.welcome.xanth: Who goes there? ...I do not know your steps, but I can sense a trace of the dark arts flowing within you... are you one of Araknor's apprentices?
npc.welcome.yrian: You are welcome in our forest as long as you don't harm it.
npc.welcome.zionthunderheart: I have already told you all that concerns you. Leave now unless you have some other business to take care of.
npc.windhowl.guard.welcome: I'm sorry, but I don't have much time for talking.
npc.woodenchest.empty: You open the chest but find nothing inside.
npc.woodenchest.too_far: You must step closer to the chest to open it.
npc.worldwildhorse.insult: Well, so long and thanks for all the scrolls
npc.worldwildhorse.no_scroll: A horse I may be, a fool I am not. I can clearly see that you no longer have the Scrolls of Horse Friendship.
npc.xanth.potion.ok: Xanth combines the essence and scrolls to create a foul potion.
npc.xanth.power: You have grown in power and are reaching your full potential.
npc.xanth.returned: Ahh, I feel your presence. You have returned.
npc.xanth.ring.ask: Bring me more Essence of Bloodlust and anything else you find on the creature's corpse, and I will identify the ring.
npc.xanth.ring.done: The person I remember wearing this ring is none other than my old mentor, Mordenthal.
npc.xanth.stranger: Who goes there? You must be one of those wretches from Silversky.
npc.xanth.tutelage: Have you come here seeking my tutelage? Very well.
npc.yrian.odour.no: There must be a mistake. I must keep hoping the Traveler will come to us soon.
npc.yrian.odour.yes: You truly are a blessing! Forgive me, I mustn't get excited in my state.
npc.yrian.start.healed: You have healed the land, my child. I knew you were the Traveller sent by the Winds.
npc.yrian.start.nomad: The one you were seeking earlier probably went west, near the gypsy settlement.
npc.yrian.start.odour: Are you the Traveler sent by the Winds to help us get rid of this foul odour?
npc.yrian.start.staff: Did you get my staff back? Remember, the enemy camp is southeast near the water.
npc.yrian.start.staff.missing: Once again, I wish to thank you for your help in retrieving my staff. Now, about this Nomad...
npc.yrian.start.staff.returned: Your arrival is as warm as a summer day sunrise! I can feel Solinae's staff in your possession.
npc.yrian.start.travel: I wish you luck in your travels, friend. I know you have a long journey ahead of you.
npc.yrian.start.welcome: You are welcome in our forest as long as you don't harm it.
npc.yrian.stone.request: The Stone of Life protects nature. If it is stolen, you must retrieve it for us.
npc.yrian.stone.retrieved: You have retrieved the Stone of Life? Marvelous! Take this twisted dagger as your reward.
npc.yrian.stone.stolen: The Stone of Life has been stolen! You must retrieve it for us.
npc.zhakar.attacked.1: You can hurt me no more. Another experiment conducted SUCCESSFULLY!
npc.zhakar.attacked.2: Ha ha ha! I am invincible!!!
npc.zion.already: I have already told you where the skull is located.
npc.zion.cost: I require one Skull of Evil, one Crown of Corruption and two arcane spellbooks.
npc.zion.found: I see you have found the skull, congratulations.
npc.zion.skull.location: You have kept your part of the bargain. The Skull of Ogrimar is hidden under a false bottom in Vargus's chest.
npc.zion.weakling: That does not concern a weakling like you!
npc.zion.welcome: Speak hastily, for I have no time to spend with you.

spell.description.avalanche: Hurls an immense cascade of snow and ice at the target. This spell has a large area of effect.
spell.description.bless: Increases the target's maximum hit points as well as their attack and archery skills.
spell.description.blizzard: Creates a violent snowstorm centered on the target. This spell has a large area of effect.
spell.description.boulders: Drops several sizable boulders onto the target. This spell has a small area of effect.
spell.description.call_lightning: Summons a powerful bolt of lightning above the target and brings it crashing down.
spell.description.chain_lightning: Sends a powerful bolt of lightning through the target. This spell has a fairly wide area of effect.
spell.description.chaos_shield: A protective shield that retaliates against every physical attack with a powerful burst of fire.
spell.description.cure_poison: Eliminates all poisons present in the target's body.
spell.description.curse: Severely hinders the target's ability to use light spells, particularly healing spells.
spell.description.detect_hidden: Allows the caster to see hidden monsters, objects, and player characters.
spell.description.detect_invisible: Allows the caster to see invisible monsters and player characters.
spell.description.dispel: Dispels most harmful effects affecting the target.
spell.description.drain_life: Drains the target's hit points and heals the caster for the same amount.
spell.description.drake_s_blades_of_veng: This spell is reserved for Vircom staff and experienced game masters.
spell.description.druid_s_point_gateway: Teleports the caster to the stone circle at Druid's Point, on Arakas.
spell.description.druid_s_point_portal: Summons a portal allowing teleportation to the stone circle at Druid's Point, on Arakas.
spell.description.dust_devil: Creates a whirlwind of dust and air and hurls it at the target.
spell.description.earthquake: Violently shakes the ground around the caster without dealing damage. This spell has a very large area of effect.
spell.description.electric_shield: A protective shield that retaliates against every physical attack with a weak energy discharge.
spell.description.entangle: Temporarily reduces the target's ability to move and dodge attacks.
spell.description.entangle_effect: Temporarily reduces the target's ability to move and dodge attacks.
spell.description.essence_of_drake: A healing spell reserved for game masters.
spell.description.essence_of_seraph_effe: Increases the target's armor class, hit points, and mana regeneration. This effect is overwhelming for mortals.
spell.description.fervor: Fills the caster with fervor, multiplying experience gained by 10 and granting unlimited hit points and mana for a time.
spell.description.fire_bolt: Hurls a concentrated bolt of fire at the target.
spell.description.fire_dart: Hurls a small flaming projectile at the target.
spell.description.fire_shield: A protective shield that retaliates against every physical attack with a small burst of fire.

spell.description.firestorm: Creates a violent firestorm around the target. This spell has a large area of effect.

spell.description.flaming_arrow: Hurls a small flaming projectile at the target.
spell.description.flare: Sets the target ablaze from within.
spell.description.freeze: Sharply drops the temperature around the target.

spell.description.greater_drain: Drains the target's hit points and heals the caster for the same amount.

spell.description.heal_light: Restores hit points to the target.
spell.description.heal_serious: Restores hit points to the target.
spell.description.healing: Restores hit points to the target.

spell.description.hurricane: Strikes the target with violent winds and lightning. This spell has an extremely large area of effect.
